description.en:
Arrows are used with a weapon that has the ammunition property to make a ranged attack. Each time you attack with the weapon, you expend one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition from a quiver, case, or other container is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-handed weapon). At the end of the battle, you can recover half your expended ammunition by taking a minute to search the battlefield.
Arrows are typically stored in a Quiver (bought separately).
description.zh:
箭是与具有弹药特性的武器一起使用来进行远程攻击的。每次使用该武器攻击时，你都会消耗一件弹药。从箭袋、箭盒或其他容器中取出弹药是攻击动作的一部分（你需要一只空闲的手来装填单手武器）。在战斗结束时，你可以通过花一分钟时间搜索战场来回收你消耗的一半弹药。
箭矢通常存放在箭袋中（需单独购买）。

• 制造： 滑膛枪, 手枪, 铃铛, 牛眼提灯, 扁瓶, 附盖提灯, 捕猎陷阱, 锁, 镣铐, 镜子, 铲子, 信号笛, 火绒盒

description.en:
• Ability: Charisma
• Utilize: Play a known tune (DC 10), or improvise a song (DC 15)
description.zh:
• 属性： 魅力
• 操作： 演奏一首已知曲目（DC 10），或即兴创作一首歌曲（DC 15）

description.en:
• Ability: Dexterity
• Utilize: Mend a tear in clothing (DC 10), or sew a Tiny design (DC 10)
• Craft: Padded Armor, Basket, Bedroll, Blanket, Fine Clothes, Net, Robe, Rope, Sack, String, Tent, Traveler's Clothes
description.zh:
• 属性： 敏捷
• 操作： 修补衣服上的破口（DC 10），或是缝制一个微型图案（DC 10）
• 制造： 布甲, 篮子, 铺盖, 毯子, 高档服装, 捕网, 法袍, 绳索, 麻袋, 细线, 帐篷, 旅行服装

description.en:
• Ability: Dexterity
• Utilize: Carve a pattern in wood (DC 10)
• Craft: Club, Greatclub, Quarterstaff, Ranged weapons (except Pistol, Musket, and Sling), Arcane Focus, Arrows, Bolts, Druidic Focus, Ink Pen, Needles
description.zh:
• 属性： 敏捷
• 操作： 在木头上雕刻图案（DC 10）
• 制造： 短棒, 巨棒, 长棍, 远程武器（除手枪, 滑膛枪, 和投石索外）, 奥术法器, 箭矢, 弩箭, 德鲁伊法器, 墨水笔, 针刺

description.en: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a vial of Acid. Target one creature or object you can see within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or take 2d6 Acid damage.
description.zh: 当你执行攻击动作时，你可以将你的一次攻击替换为丢出一小瓶强酸。你可以选择位于你20尺内可见的一个生物或物件作为目标。该目标必须通过一次敏捷豁免（DC 8+你的敏捷调整值+你的熟练加值），否则承受2d6点强酸伤害。

description.en: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a flask of Alchemist's Fire. Target one creature or object you can see within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or take 1d4 Fire damage and start burning.
description.zh: 当你执行攻击动作时，你可以将你的一次攻击替换为丢出一扁瓶炽火胶。你可以选择位于你20尺内可见的一个生物或物件作为目标。该目标必须通过一次敏捷豁免（DC 8+你的敏捷调整值+你的熟练加值），否则承受1d4点火焰伤害并开始燃烧。

description.en: As a Bonus Action, you can drink a vial of Antitoxin to gain Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition for 1 hour.
description.zh: 以一个附赠动作，你可以喝下一小瓶抗毒剂来使你在避免或结束中毒状态的豁免中具有优势，持续一小时。

description.en: A creature subjected to Assassin's Blood makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 6 (1d12) Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition for 24 hours. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.
description.zh: 服用这种毒药的生物需要进行一次DC 10的体质豁免。豁免失败则受6（1d12）毒素伤害并陷入中毒状态24小时。豁免成功则只受半伤。

description.en: A Backpack holds up to 30 pounds within 1 cubic foot. It can also serve as a saddlebag.
description.zh: 一个背包最多能装入 30 磅重 1 立方尺大的东西。背包也能当作鞍囊使用。

description.en: As a Utilize action, you can spill Ball Bearings from their pouch. They spread to cover a level, 10-foot-square area within 10 feet of yourself. A creature that enters this area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition. It takes 10 minutes to recover the Ball Bearings.
description.zh: 以一个操作动作，你能把一小包滚珠撒至地面，并覆盖你周围 10 尺内的一处 10 尺方形区域。任何生物每回合首次进入这片区域时都必须通过一次DC 10的敏捷豁免，否则陷入倒地状态。重新收集这些滚珠需要花费 10 分钟时间。

description.en: A Barrel holds up to 40 gallons of liquid or up to 4 cubic feet of dry goods.
description.zh: 一个木桶能够至多装入 40 加仑的液体或 4 立方尺的干燥货物。

description.en: As a Bonus Action, you can use a vial of Basic Poison to coat one weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition. A creature that takes Piercing or Slashing damage from the poisoned weapon or ammunition takes an extra 1d4 Poison damage. Once applied, the poison retains potency for 1 minute or until its damage is dealt, whichever comes first.
description.zh: 以一个附赠动作，你可以将一小瓶基础毒药涂抹在一把武器或至多三枚弹药上。当一个生物受到由涂过毒的武器或弹药所造成的穿刺或劈砍伤害时，该生物将受到额外1d4点毒素伤害。毒药一旦被涂抹，毒效只会持续1分钟或直至造成了额外伤害。

description.en: A Basket holds up to 40 pounds within 2 cubic feet.
description.zh: 一个篮子能够至多装入 40 磅重 2 立方尺大的东西。

description.en: A Bedroll sleeps one Small or Medium creature. While in a Bedroll, you automatically succeed on saving throws against extreme cold (see the Dungeon Master's Guide).
description.zh: 一卷铺盖能睡下一个小型或中型生物。躺在铺盖中时，你自动通过抵抗极度寒冷的豁免检定（详见城主指南）。

description.en: When rung as a Utilize action, a Bell produces a sound that can be heard up to 60 feet away.
description.zh: 以一个操作动作，你可以摇响一个铃铛，铃铛会发出 60 尺内都能够听到的声音。

description.en: While wrapped in a blanket, you have Advantage on saving throws against extreme cold (see the Dungeon Master's Guide).
description.zh: 包裹在毯子中期间，你在抵抗极度寒冷的豁免检定上具有优势（详见城主指南）。

description.en: A Block and Tackle allows you to hoist up to four times the weight you can normally lift.
description.zh: 滑轮组允许你提起你正常能提动的四倍重量的物品。

description.en: A Book contains fiction or nonfiction. If you consult an accurate nonfiction Book about its topic, you gain a +5 bonus to Intelligence (Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion) checks you make about that topic.
description.zh: 一本书会记载虚构或非虚构的内容。如果你在某些事物上参考了一本内容准确而非虚构的书，你在相关事物上的智力（奥秘、历史、自然或宗教）检定则获得 +5 的加值。

description.en: A Bucket holds up to half a cubic foot of contents.
description.zh: 一个吊桶能装入至多半立方尺的东西。

description.en: A Bullseye Lantern burns Oil as fuel to cast Bright Light in a 60-foot Cone and Dim Light for an additional 60 feet.
description.zh: 一盏牛眼提灯使用燃油作为燃料，点着时能够发出60尺锥状区域的明亮光照以及额外60尺的微光光照。

description.en: A Burglar's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Ball Bearings, Bell, 10 Candles, Crowbar, Hooded Lantern, 7 flasks of Oil, 5 days of Rations, Rope, Tinderbox, and Waterskin.
description.zh: 窃贼套组包含以下物品：背包、滚珠、铃铛、10 根蜡烛、撬棍、附盖提灯、7 扁瓶燃油、五天份的口粮、绳索、火绒盒和水袋。

description.en: A creature subjected to Burnt Othur Fumes must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or take 10 (3d6) Poison damage, and it must repeat the save at the start of each of its turns. On each successive failed save, the creature takes 3 (1d6) Poison damage. After three successful saves, the poison ends.
description.zh: 受害于该毒药的生物必须成功通过一次DC 13的体质豁免，否则将受到10（3d6）毒素伤害，并在其每个回合开始时重复此豁免。此时每次豁免失败后该生物都将受3（1d6）毒素伤害。累计三次豁免成功后，毒药的效应终止。

description.en: As a Utilize action, you can spread Caltrops from their bag to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. A creature that enters this area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 1 Piercing damage and have its Speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. It takes 10 minutes to recover the Caltrops.
description.zh: 以一个操作动作，你能把一包铁蒺撒至地面并覆盖你周围5尺内的一处5尺方形区域。任何生物每回合首次进入这片区域时都必须通过一次DC 15的敏捷豁免，否则受到1点穿刺伤害，并且速度降至0，直到其下一回合开始为止。重新收集这些铁蒺藜需要花费10分钟时间。

description.en: For 1 hour, a lit Candle sheds Bright Light in a 5-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 5 feet.
description.zh: 一根蜡烛可以燃烧 1 小时，并发出 5 尺范围的明亮光照，以及额外 5 尺的微光光照。

description.en: A creature subjected to Carrion Crawler Mucus must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. The creature also has the Paralyzed condition while Poisoned in this way. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
description.zh: 接触到这种毒药的生物必须成功通过一次DC 13的体质豁免，否则将陷入中毒状态1分钟。以此中毒期间该生物还会陷入麻痹状态。该生物在其每个回合结束重复此豁免，豁免成功则终止其身上的此效应。

description.en: As a Utilize action, you can wrap a Chain around an unwilling creature within 5 feet of yourself that has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition if you succeed on a DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check. If the creature's legs are bound, the creature has the Restrained condition until it escapes. Escaping the Chain requires the creature to make a successful DC 18 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check as an action. Bursting the Chain requires a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check as an action.
description.zh: 以一个操作动作，你可以进行一次DC 13的力量（运动）检定。如果该检定成功，你能利用链条捆住一个位于你5尺内的非自愿生物，但该生物必须处于受擒、失能或束缚状态。如果你绑住了该生物的腿，该生物陷入束缚状态，直至挣脱。挣脱链条需要该生物使用动作来通过一次DC 18的敏捷（特技）检定。扯坏链条需要该生物使用动作来通过一次DC 20的力量（运动）检定。

description.en: A Chest holds up to 12 cubic feet of contents.
description.zh: 一个箱子至多能装入 12 立方尺的东西。

description.en: A Climber's Kit includes boot tips, gloves, pitons, and a harness. As a Utilize action, you can use the Climber's Kit to anchor yourself; when you do, you can't fall more than 25 feet from the anchor point, and you can't move more than 25 feet from there without undoing the anchor as a Bonus Action.
description.zh: 一套攀爬工具包含鞋子包头、手套、岩钉和系带。以一个操作动作，你可以使用攀爬工具锚定自己，此时你不会从锚定处摔落超过25尺，且在使用附赠动作解除锚定前无法从锚定处向外移动超过25尺。

description.en: A Component Pouch is watertight and filled with compartments that hold all the free Material components of your spells.
description.zh: 材料包是一种装有你法术所需的一切免费材料的防水小包。

description.en: While wearing a Costume, you have Advantage on any ability check you make to impersonate the person or type of person it represents.
description.zh: 若你穿着对应的戏服，你为模仿他人或模仿某一类人所作的任何属性检定都具有优势。

description.en: A Crossbow Bolt Case holds up to 20 Bolts.
description.zh: 一个弩矢匣至多能存放20根弩矢。

description.en: Using a Crowbar gives you Advantage on Strength checks where the Crowbar's leverage can be applied.
description.zh: 在能够撬动的地方使用撬棍可以给予你在这方面的力量检定优势。

description.en: A Diplomat's Pack contains the following items: Chest, Fine Clothes, Ink, 5 Ink Pens, Lamp, 2 Map or Scroll Cases, 4 flasks of Oil, 5 sheets of Paper, 5 sheets of Parchment, Perfume, and Tinderbox.
description.zh: 外交套组包含以下物品：箱子、高档服装、墨水、5 支墨水笔、油灯、2 个地图或卷轴匣、4 扁瓶燃油、5 张纸张、5 张羊皮纸、香水和火绒盒。

description.en: A Dungeoneer's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Caltrops, Crowbar, 2 flasks of Oil, 10 days of Rations, Rope, Tinderbox, 10 Torches, and Waterskin.
description.zh: 地城套组包含以下物品：背包、铁蒺藜、撬棍、2 扁瓶燃油、10 天份的口粮、绳索、火绒盒、10 支火把和水袋。

description.en: An Entertainer's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Bedroll, Bell, Bullseye Lantern, 3 Costumes, Mirror, 8 flasks of Oil, 9 days of Rations, Tinderbox, and Waterskin.
description.zh: 艺人套组包含以下物品：背包、铺盖、铃铛、牛眼提灯、3 件戏服、镜子、8 扁瓶燃油、9 天份的口粮、火绒盒和水袋。

description.en: A creature subjected to Essence of Ether must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition for 8 hours. The creature also has the Unconscious condition while Poisoned in this way. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.
description.zh: 吸入这种毒药的生物必须成功通过一次DC 15的体质豁免，否则将陷入中毒状态8小时。以此中毒期间该生物还会陷入昏迷状态。该生物会在受到伤害、或是其他生物用一个动作来将其摇醒时苏醒。

description.en: A saddle comes with a bit, a bridle, reins, and any other equipment needed to use the saddle. An Exotic Saddle is required for riding an aquatic or a flying mount.
description.zh: 鞍座包括嚼子、缰绳、笼头以及其他鞍座所需的装备。骑乘水生或飞行坐骑需要使用特种鞍座。

description.en: An Explorer's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Bedroll, 2 flasks of Oil, 10 days of Rations, Rope, Tinderbox, 10 Torches, and Waterskin.
description.zh: 探索套组包含以下物品：背包、铺盖、2 扁瓶燃油、10 份口粮、绳索、火绒盒、10 支火把和水袋。

description.en: Fine Clothes are made of expensive fabrics and adorned with expertly crafted details. Some events and locations admit only people wearing these clothes.
description.zh: 高档服装使用昂贵的材料和装饰物制成，并缝制着极其精密的细节。有些活动和场合仅允许穿着高档服装的人参与。

description.en: A Flask holds up to 1 pint.
description.zh: 一个扁瓶具有 1 品脱容量。

description.en: A Glass Bottle holds up to 1½ pints.
description.zh: 一个玻璃瓶至多能装入 1.5 品脱的东西。

description.en: As a Utilize action, you can throw the Grappling Hook at a railing, a ledge, or another catch within 50 feet of yourself, and the hook catches on if you succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. If you tied a Rope to the hook, you can then climb it.
description.zh: 以一个操作动作，你能将爪钩朝着位于自身50尺内的一处栏杆、突起的边缘或是一处能够挂住的位置扔出，并进行一次DC 13的敏捷（特技）检定。如果检定成功，爪钩则成功钩在上面。如果爪钩上还连了绳子，你则可以爬上去。

description.en: A Healer's Kit has ten uses. As a Utilize action, you can expend one of its uses to stabilize an Unconscious creature that has 0 Hit Points without needing to make a Wisdom (Medicine) check.
description.zh: 一个医疗包有十次使用次数。以一个操作动作，你可以花费一次使用次数用来稳定一名生命值为0的陷入昏迷的生物的伤势。你这么做时无需进行感知（医药）检定。

description.en: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a flask of Holy Water. Target one creature you can see within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or take 2d8 Radiant damage if it is a Fiend or an Undead.
description.zh: 当你执行攻击动作时，你可以将你的一次攻击替换为丢出一扁瓶圣水。你可以选择位于你20尺内可见的一个生物作为目标。该目标必须通过一次敏捷豁免（DC 8+你的敏捷调整值+你的熟练加值），并且如果这个目标是邪魔或亡灵生物，失败时承受2d8点光耀伤害。

description.en: A Hooded Lantern burns Oil as fuel to cast Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. As a Bonus Action, you can lower the hood, reducing the light to Dim Light in a 5-foot radius, or raise it again.
description.zh: 一盏附盖提灯使用燃油作为燃料，点着时能够发出半径30尺的明亮光照以及额外30尺的微光光照。以一个附赠动作，你可以盖上或掀开提灯的盖子。盖上盖子时，提灯的光亮降至半径5尺的微光光照。

description.en: As a Utilize action, you can set a Hunting Trap, which is a sawtooth steel ring that snaps shut when a creature steps on a pressure plate in the center. The trap is affixed by a heavy chain to an immobile object, such as a tree or a spike driven into the ground. A creature that steps on the plate must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 1d4 Piercing damage and have its Speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. Thereafter, until the creature breaks free of the trap, its movement is limited by the length of the chain (typically 3 feet). A creature can use its action to make a DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. Each failed check deals 1 Piercing damage to the trapped creature.
description.zh: 以一个操作动作，你可以在某处设下捕猎陷阱。捕猎陷阱是一组带有锯齿的铁环，当一个生物踩到中心的压力板时，两边的锯齿会迅速合上。这组陷阱需要用沉重的链条固定至某个无法移动的物件上——例如大树或刺入地面的固定钉。踩到压力板的生物必须通过一次DC 13的敏捷豁免，否则受到1d4点穿刺伤害，并且速度降至0，直至他的下一回合开始。直到该生物挣脱陷阱前，它的移动范围会被链条的长度限制（通常为3尺）。一个生物可以使用它的动作来进行一次DC 13的力量（运动）检定，检定成功时能够让自己或自己触及范围内的一个其他生物脱困。每次检定失败都会导致被困生物受到1点穿刺伤害。

description.en: Ink comes in a 1-ounce bottle, which provides enough ink to write about 500 pages.
description.zh: 墨水一般装在 1 盎司的瓶子里，足够撰写 500 页的内容。

description.en: Using Ink, an Ink Pen is used to write or draw.
description.zh: 墨水笔可以使用墨水来写字或绘画。

description.en: An Iron Pot holds up to 1 gallon.
description.zh: 铁壶具有一加仑的容量。

description.en: Iron Spikes come in bundles of ten. As a Utilize action, you can use a blunt object, such as a Light Hammer, to hammer a spike into wood, earth, or a similar material. You can do so to jam a door shut or to then tie a Rope or Chain to the Spike.
description.zh: 一组铁钉具有十支。以一个操作动作，你可以使用一把钝器，例如轻锤，来将铁钉锤入木头、土地或类似的材质。你能通过这种方式堵死一扇门，或将绳索或链条固定在铁钉上。

description.en: Iron Spikes come in bundles of ten. As a Utilize action, you can use a blunt object, such as a Light Hammer, to hammer a spike into wood, earth, or a similar material. You can do so to jam a door shut or to then tie a Rope or Chain to the Spike.
description.zh: 一组铁钉具有十支。以一个操作动作，你可以使用一把钝器，例如轻锤，来将铁钉锤入木头、土地或类似的材质。你能通过这种方式堵死一扇门，或将绳索或链条固定在铁钉上。

description.en: A Jug holds up to 1 gallon.
description.zh: 壶具有一加仑的容量。

description.en: A Ladder is 10 feet tall. You must climb to move up or down it.
description.zh: 一把梯子有 10 尺高。你只能在梯子上爬上或是爬下。

description.en: A Lamp burns Oil as fuel to cast Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.
description.zh: 一盏油灯使用燃油作为燃料，点着时能够发出半径15尺的明亮光照以及额外30尺的微光光照。

description.en: A Lock comes with a key. Without the key, a creature can use Thieves' Tools to pick this Lock with a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check.
description.zh: 每套锁都有对应的钥匙。如果没有对应的钥匙，一个生物还可以使用盗贼工具来通过一次DC 15的敏捷（巧手）检定开锁。

description.en: A creature subjected to Lolth's Sting must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition for 1 hour. If the creature fails the save by 5 or more, the creature also has the Unconscious condition while Poisoned in this way. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.
description.zh: 遭受这种毒药影响的生物必须成功通过一次DC 13的体质豁免，否则陷入中毒状态1小时。若该生物豁免失败且骰值比DC低5或更多，则该生物还会在以此法中毒期间陷入昏迷。该生物会在受到伤害、或是其他生物用一个动作来将其摇醒时苏醒。

description.en: A Magnifying Glass grants Advantage on any ability check made to appraise or inspect a highly detailed item. Lighting a fire with a Magnifying Glass requires light as bright as sunlight to focus, tinder to ignite, and about 5 minutes for the fire to ignite.
description.zh: 使用放大镜时，你为鉴定或检查精密物品所作的任何属性检定都会具有优势。想要使用放大镜点火，需要一束如同阳光般明亮的强光用于聚焦，还需要用于点燃的火绒，随后需要大约 5 分钟的时间来生火。

description.en: A creature subjected to Malice must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition for 1 hour. The creature also has the Blinded condition while Poisoned in this way.
description.zh: 吸入这种毒药的生物必须成功通过一次DC 15的体质豁免，否则将陷入中毒状态1小时，以此中毒期间该生物还会陷入目盲状态。

description.en:
As a Utilize action, you can use Manacles to bind an unwilling Small or Medium creature within 5 feet of yourself that has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition if you succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check. While bound, a creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls, and the creature is Restrained if the Manacles are attached to a chain or hook that is fixed in place. Escaping the Manacles requires a successful DC 20 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check as an action. Bursting them requires a successful DC 25 Strength (Athletics) check as an action.
Each set of Manacles comes with a key. Without the key, a creature can use Thieves' Tools to pick the Manacles' lock with a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check.
description.zh:
以一个操作动作，你能利用镣铐捆住一个位于你 5 尺内的非自愿的小型或中型生物，但该生物必须处于受擒、失能或束缚状态，并且你成功通过一次DC 13的敏捷（巧手）检定。如果该检定成功，如果你铐住了该生物，该生物进行的攻击检定会具有劣势。如果镣铐还被锁链或钩子固定在了某处，该生物还会陷入束缚状态。挣脱镣铐需要该生物使用动作来通过一次DC 20的敏捷（巧手）检定。扯坏镣铐需要该生物使用动作来通过一次DC 25的力量（运动）检定。
每套镣铐都有对应的钥匙。如果没有对应的钥匙，一个生物还可以使用盗贼工具来通过一次DC 15的敏捷（巧手）检定解开镣铐的锁。

description.en: If you consult an accurate Map, you gain a +5 bonus to Wisdom (Survival) checks you make to find your way in the place represented on it.
description.zh: 如果你在地图所绘制的地点参考了一张准确的地图，你为辨认位置所进行的感知（求生）检定获得 +5 的加值。

description.en: A Map or Scroll Case holds up to 10 sheets of paper or 5 sheets of parchment.
description.zh: 一个地图或卷轴匣至多能存放10张纸张或5张羊皮纸。

description.en: A creature that ingests Midnight Tears suffers no effect until the stroke of midnight. Any effect that ends the Poisoned condition neutralizes this poison. If the poison hasn't been neutralized before midnight, the creature makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 31 (9d6) Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
description.zh: 服用这种毒药的生物不会立即出现异样，其症状会一直潜伏到午夜钟声敲响时。任何能够解除中毒状态的效应都可以在此之前中和午夜之泪，然而如果毒素在午夜之前尚未中和，该生物就要进行一次DC 17的体质豁免，豁免失败则受到31（9d6）点毒素伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。

description.en: A saddle comes with a bit, a bridle, reins, and any other equipment needed to use the saddle. A Military Saddle gives Advantage on any ability check you make to remain mounted.
description.zh: 鞍座包括嚼子、缰绳、笼头以及其他鞍座所需的装备。军用鞍座可以在你为维持骑乘所作的一切属性检定上提供优势。

description.en: A handheld steel Mirror is useful for personal cosmetics but also for peeking around corners and reflecting light as a signal.
description.zh: 一面手持的钢镜不光可以用来化妆打扮，也可以用来窥视拐角或利用反光打信号。

description.en:
When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a Net. Target a creature you can see within 15 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or have the Restrained condition until it escapes. The target succeeds automatically if it is Huge or larger.
To escape, the target or a creature within 5 feet of it must take an action to make a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check, freeing the Restrained creature on a success. Destroying the Net (AC 10; 5 HP; Immunity to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage) also frees the target, ending the effect.
description.zh:
当你执行攻击动作，你可以将你的一次攻击替换为丢出一张捕网。你可以选择位于你15尺内可见的一个生物作为目标。该目标必须通过一次敏捷豁免（DC 8+你的敏捷调整值+你的熟练加值），否则陷入束缚状态，直至挣脱。体型是巨型及以上的目标将自动通过豁免。
被束缚的目标或者位于目标5尺内的生物，可以通过一个动作来进行一次DC 10的力量（运动）检定来挣脱捕网。若检定成功，被束缚的生物将被解放。摧毁捕网（AC 10；5 HP；免疫钝击、毒素和心灵伤害）也能解放被困目标并结束捕网的效果。

description.en:
You can douse a creature, object, or space with Oil or use it as fuel, as detailed below.
Dousing a Creature or an Object.
When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing an Oil flask. Target one creature or object within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or be covered in oil. If the target takes Fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute), the target takes an extra 5 Fire damage from burning oil.
Dousing a Space.
You can take the Utilize action to pour an Oil flask on level ground to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. If lit, the oil burns until the end of the turn 2 rounds from when the oil was lit (or 12 seconds) and deals 5 Fire damage to any creature that enters the area or ends its turn there. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.
Fuel.
Oil serves as fuel for Lamps and Lanterns. Once lit, a flask of Oil burns for 6 hours in a Lamp or Lantern. That duration doesn't need to be consecutive; you can extinguish the burning Oil (as a Utilize action) and rekindle it again until it has burned for a total of 6 hours.
description.zh:
你能将燃油泼在一个生物、物件或一处空间上，你也可以将燃油作为燃料使用。具体使用方法如下。
泼洒一个生物或一个物件.
当你执行攻击动作，你可以将你的一次攻击替换为丢出一个油瓶。你可以选择位于你20尺内可见的一个生物或物体作为目标。该目标必须通过一次敏捷豁免检定（DC 8 +你的敏捷调整值+你的 熟练加值），否则将被油覆盖。如果目标在油干燥前（1分钟后）受到火焰伤害，目标将因燃烧的油额外受到5点火焰伤害。
泼洒一处空间.
以一个操作动作，你可以将一扁瓶燃油泼在地面上，以覆盖一块边长5尺且保持水平的方形区域。点燃后，从点燃时算起，燃油会持续燃烧两轮并在回合结束时熄灭（或 12 秒）。点燃时，任何进入该区域或在该区域结束其回合的生物都会受到 5 点火焰伤害。同一生物每回合只受该伤害作用一次。
燃料.
燃油能作为油灯和提灯的燃料使用。一旦点着，一扁瓶的燃油可以在油灯和提灯中持续燃烧 6 小时。持续时长并不需要是连续的，你可以熄灭点着的燃油（以一个操作动作），并在之后再点燃，直到总共燃烧了 6 小时。

description.en: A creature subjected to Oil of Taggit must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition for 24 hours. The creature also has the Unconscious condition while Poisoned in this way. It wakes up if it takes damage.
description.zh: 接触到这种毒药的生物必须成功通过一次DC 13的体质豁免，否则将陷入中毒状态24小时。以此中毒期间该生物还会陷入昏迷状态。该生物会在受到伤害时苏醒。

description.en: A creature subjected to Pale Tincture must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (1d6) Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition. The Poisoned creature repeats the save every 24 hours, taking 3 (1d6) Poison damage on a failed save. The damage the poison deals can't be healed by any means while the creature remains Poisoned. After seven successful saves against the poison, the creature is no longer Poisoned.
description.zh: 服用这种毒药的生物必须成功通过一次DC 16的体质豁免，否则将受到3（1d6）毒素伤害并陷入中毒状态。以此中毒的生物每过24小时都需要重复此豁免，豁免失败则再受3（1d6）毒素伤害。此毒药造成的伤害在此中毒效应终止前无法以任何方式恢复。该生物累计豁免成功七次后即不再中毒。

description.en: One sheet of Paper can hold about 250 handwritten words.
description.zh: 一页纸张能够写满 250 个手写单词。

description.en: One sheet of Parchment can hold about 250 handwritten words.
description.zh: 一页羊皮纸能够写满 250 个手写单词。

description.en: Perfume comes in a 4-ounce vial. For 1 hour after applying Perfume to yourself, you have Advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to influence an Indifferent Humanoid within 5 feet of yourself.
description.zh: 香水通常装在4盎司的小瓶里。为自己拍上香水后的一小时里，你为影响对你态度冷漠的类人生物所作的魅力（游说）检定都具有优势，但这个生物必须位于你的5尺内。

description.en: A Pole is 10 feet long. You can use it to touch something up to 10 feet away. If you must make a Strength (Athletics) check as part of a High or Long Jump, you can use the Pole to vault, giving yourself Advantage on the check.
description.zh: 一柄长杆有10尺长。你可以用它去触碰10尺外的东西。如果你必须为一次跳高或跳远进行力量（运动）检定的话，你可以使用长杆进行跳远，来使这次检定具有优势。

description.en: You can use a Portable Ram to break down doors. When doing so, you gain a +4 bonus to the Strength check. One other character can help you use the ram, giving you Advantage on this check.
description.zh: 你可以使用便携式攻城锤撞破一扇门。当你这么做时，你在力量检定上获得 +4 加值。其他一名角色可以协助你使用攻城锤，并使你这次检定具有优势。

description.en: A Pouch holds up to 6 pounds within one-fifth of a cubic foot.
description.zh: 一个小包能够至多装入6磅重、五分之一立方尺大的东西。

description.en: A Priest's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Blanket, Holy Water, Lamp, 7 days of Rations, Robe, and Tinderbox.
description.zh: 祭司套组包含以下物品：背包、毯子、圣水、油灯、7天份的口粮、法袍和火绒盒。

description.en: A creature subjected to Purple Worm Poison makes a DC 21 Constitution saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
description.zh: 受该毒药影响的生物需要进行一次DC 21的体质豁免，豁免失败则受到35（10d6）毒素伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。

description.en: A Quiver holds up to 20 Arrows.
description.zh: 箭袋至多能装入20根箭矢。

description.en: Rations consist of travel-ready food, including jerky, dried fruit, hardtack, and nuts. See "Malnutrition" for the risks of not eating.
description.zh: 口粮由适合长途旅行携带的食物组成，包含肉干、风干水果、饼干和坚果等。不进食的危害详见"饥饿"。

description.en: A saddle comes with a bit, a bridle, reins, and any other equipment needed to use the saddle.
description.zh: 鞍座包括嚼子、缰绳、笼头以及其他鞍座所需的装备。

description.en: A Robe has vocational or ceremonial significance. Some events and locations admit only people wearing a Robe bearing certain colors or symbols.
description.zh: 长袍通常具有特别的职业或仪式意义。有些活动和场合仅允许穿着带有特定颜色或符号的长袍的人参与。

description.en:
As a Utilize action, you can tie a knot with Rope if you succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check. The Rope can be burst with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check.
You can bind an unwilling creature with the Rope only if the creature has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. If the creature's legs are bound, the creature has the Restrained condition until it escapes. Escaping the Rope requires the creature to make a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check as an action.
description.zh:
以一个操作动作，你可以进行一次DC 10的敏捷（巧手）检定。如果该检定成功，你能用绳索打一个结。扯坏绳索需要成功通过一次DC 20的力量（运动）检定。
你可以利用绳索捆住一个非自愿生物，但该生物必须处于受擒、失能或束缚状态。如果你绑住了该生物的腿，该生物陷入束缚状态，直至挣脱。挣脱绳索需要该生物使用动作来通过一次DC 15的敏捷（特技）检定。

description.en: A Sack holds up to 30 pounds within 1 cubic foot.
description.zh: 麻袋至多能够装入 30 磅 1 立方尺的东西。

description.en: A Scholar's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Book, Ink, Ink Pen, Lamp, 10 flasks of Oil, 10 sheets of Parchment, and Tinderbox.
description.zh: 学者套组包含以下物品：背包、书籍、墨水、墨水笔、油灯、10 扁瓶燃油、10 张羊皮纸和火绒盒。

description.en: A creature subjected to Serpent Venom must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
description.zh: 受该毒药影响的生物必须成功通过一次DC 11的体质豁免，否则将受到10（3d6）毒素伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。

description.en: Working for 1 hour, you can use a Shovel to dig a hole that is 5 feet on each side in soil or similar material.
description.zh: 你可以使用铲子来花费一小时时间在土壤或类似材质的地方挖出一个5尺边长的洞。

description.en: When blown as a Utilize action, a Signal Whistle produces a sound that can be heard up to 600 feet away.
description.zh: 以一个操作动作，你可以吹响一支信号笛，并使信号笛发出 600 尺外都可以听见的响声。

description.en: Objects viewed through a Spyglass are magnified to twice their size.
description.zh: 通过望远镜看到的物件要比原先的尺寸大上两倍。

description.en: String is 10 feet long. You can tie a knot in it as a Utilize action.
description.zh: 细线有 10 尺长。你能够以一个操作动作为它打一个结。

description.en: A Tent sleeps up to two Small or Medium creatures.
description.zh: 帐篷可以睡下两个小型或中型的生物。

description.en: A Tinderbox is a small container holding flint, fire steel, and tinder (usually dry cloth soaked in light oil) used to kindle a fire. Using it to light a Candle, Lamp, Lantern, or Torch—or anything else with exposed fuel—takes a Bonus Action. Lighting any other fire takes 1 minute.
description.zh: 火绒盒是一种装有打火石、火镰和火绒（通常是浸泡在燃油里的干布料）的小型容器，其中的物品可以用来点火。你可以使用附赠动作来用它点燃任何具有燃料的东西——例如蜡烛、油灯、提灯或火把。在没有燃料的情况下生火需要1分钟时间。

description.en: A Torch burns for 1 hour, casting Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. When you take the Attack action, you can attack with the Torch, using it as a Simple Melee weapon. On a hit, the target takes 1 Fire damage.
description.zh: 火把点燃后能够燃烧 1 小时，燃烧期间发出半径 20 尺的明亮光照以及额外 20 尺的微光光照。当你执行攻击动作时，你可以将火把当作简易近战武器，并使用火把发动攻击。命中时，目标受到 1 火焰伤害。

description.en: A creature subjected to Torpor poison must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition for 4d6 hours. The creature's Speed is halved while the creature is Poisoned in this way.
description.zh: 服用这种毒药的生物必须成功通过一次DC 15的体质豁免，否则将陷入中毒状态4d6小时。以此法中毒期间该生物的速度减半。

description.en: Traveler's Clothes are resilient garments designed for travel in various environments.
description.zh: 旅行服装是为应对在多种环境中的旅途而设计的结实服装。

description.en:
When you make your character, you can roll once on the Trinkets table to gain a Tiny trinket, a simple item lightly touched by mystery. The DM might also use this table. It can help stock a room in a dungeon or fill a creature's pockets.
Trinkets
1d100 | Trinket

03 | A gold coin minted in an unknown land
04 | A diary written in a language you don't know
05 | A brass ring that never tarnishes

39 | An empty glass vial that smells of perfume
40 | A gemstone that looks like a lump of coal when examined by anyone but you

55 | A miniature cage with no door

75 | A set of bone pipes

78 | An ornate scabbard that fits no blade you have found

83 | A bit of folded cloth that, when unfolded, turns into a stylish cap
84 | A receipt of deposit at a bank in a far-off city
85 | A diary with seven missing pages
86 | An empty silver snuffbox bearing the inscription "dreams" on its lid
87 | An iron holy symbol devoted to an unknown god
88 | A book about a legendary hero's rise and fall, with the last chapter missing
89 | A vial of dragon blood
90 | An ancient arrow of elven design
91 | A needle that never bends
92 | An ornate brooch of dwarven design
93 | An empty wine bottle bearing a pretty label that says, "The Wizard of Wines Winery, Red Dragon Crush, 331422-W"
94 | A mosaic tile with a multicolored, glazed surface

99 | A wooden box with a ceramic bottom that holds a living worm with a head on each end of its body
00 | A metal urn containing the ashes of a hero
description.zh:
在创作角色时，你可以根据饰品表掷骰来获得一件微型饰品——一件带点神秘色彩的简单物品。DM有时候也会用到本表格，比如用来点缀地下城的房间或者用来装满某个生物的口袋。
饰品
1d100 | 饰品
01 | 一只风干的地精手臂

description.en: A creature subjected to Truth Serum must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition for 1 hour. The Poisoned creature can't knowingly communicate a lie.
description.zh: 服用该毒药的生物必须成功通过一次DC 11的体质豁免，否则将陷入中毒状态1小时。以此中毒的生物不能故意说谎。

description.en: A Vial holds up to 4 ounces.
description.zh: 小瓶具有 4 盎司容量。

description.en: A Waterskin holds up to 4 pints. If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk dehydration.
description.zh: 水袋具有4品脱容量。如果你喝水不足，你会遭受脱水的危害（见规则详述）。

description.en: A creature subjected to Wyvern Poison makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
description.zh: 受这种毒药影响的生物需要进行一次DC 14的体质豁免，豁免失败则受到24（7d6）毒素伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。

roll20Modifiers: Item Type: Melee Weapon, Damage: 1d4, Damage Type: Piercing, Range: 20/60, Melee Attacks +1, Melee Damage +1

description.en:
You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.
You can take a Bonus Action to magically coat the blade with poison. The poison remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature. That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 2d10 Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. The weapon can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
description.zh:
你以此魔法武器进行的攻击检定和伤害掷骰获得+1加值。
你可以用附赠动作为匕首覆上毒液，持续1分钟。用这把武器发动的一次攻击成功命中生物后毒液也会消失。此时，被命中的生物必须成功通过一次DC 15的体质豁免否则受到2d10毒素伤害并陷入中毒状态1分钟。直至次日黎明前，该附赠动作都无法被再次使用。

attunement.en: Requires Attunement by a Dwarf or a Creature Attuned to a {@item Belt of Dwarvenkind|XDMG}
attunement.zh: 需要同调（需矮人或与{@item 矮人腰带|XDMG}同调的生物）

roll20Modifiers: Item Type: Melee Weapon, Damage: 1d8, Damage Type: Bludgeoning, Alternate Damage: 1d10, Alternate Damage Type: Bludgeoning, Range: 20/60, Melee Attacks +3, Melee Damage +3

description.en: You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has Thrown with a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet. When you hit with a ranged attack using this weapon, it deals an extra 1d8 Force damage, or an extra 2d8 Force damage if the target is a Giant. Immediately after hitting or missing, the weapon flies back to your hand.
description.zh: 你用该魔法武器发动的攻击检定和伤害掷骰获得+3加值。它具有投掷属性，常规射程为20尺，最大射程为60尺。当你用此武器发动远程攻击命中时，它将造成1d8的额外力场伤害。如果命中的目标是一个生物类型为巨人的生物，则额外伤害提升为2d8。攻击后，此武器将立即飞回你的手中。

roll20Modifiers: Item Type: Melee Weapon, Damage: 1d6, Damage Type: Piercing, Range: 30/120

description.en:
Each time you make an attack roll with this magic weapon and hit, you can have it deal Lightning damage instead of Piercing damage.
Lightning Bolt.
When you throw this weapon at a target no farther than 120 feet from you, you can forgo making a ranged attack roll and instead turn the weapon into a bolt of lightning. This bolt forms a 5-foot-wide Line between you and the target. The target and each other creature in the Line (excluding you) makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Immediately after dealing this damage, the weapon reappears in your hand. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.
description.zh:
当你用该武器发动的攻击检定命中时，你可以选择令其造成闪电伤害而非穿刺伤害。
闪电束.
当你向至多120尺内的一个目标投掷该武器时，你可以选择不进行远程攻击检定，而是改为将该武器变为一道闪电束。该闪电束会在你和目标之间形成一个5尺线状，目标及该线状内的每个生物（除你之外）都必须进行一次DC 13的敏捷豁免，豁免失败者受到4d6闪电伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。该武器会在造成该伤害后立即回到你的手中。直到次日黎明前，该词条都无法再使用。

roll20Modifiers: Item Type: Melee Weapon, Damage: 1d6, Damage Type: Bludgeoning

description.en:
When you hit a Fiend or an Undead with this magic weapon, that creature takes an extra 2d6 Radiant damage. If the target has 25 Hit Points or fewer after taking this damage, it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be destroyed. On a successful save, the creature has the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.
Light.
While you hold this weapon, it sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.
description.zh:
当你使用这把魔法武器命中一位邪魔或亡灵时，该生物会额外受到2d6光耀伤害。如果目标因受到该伤害而生命值被降至25及以下，则目标必须进行一次DC 15的感知豁免，豁免失败则被摧毁，豁免成功则该生物陷入恐慌状态，持续至你的下一回合结束。
光线.
在你持握这把武器期间，它会散发出20尺半径的明亮光照以及额外20尺微光光照。

roll20Modifiers: Item Type: Melee Weapon, Damage: 1d6, Damage Type: Bludgeoning, Melee Attacks +1, Melee Damage +1

description.en:
You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. The bonus increases to +3 when you use the weapon to attack a Construct.
When you roll a 20 on an attack roll made with this weapon, the target takes an extra 7 Bludgeoning damage, or 14 Bludgeoning damage if it's a Construct. If a Construct has 25 Hit Points or fewer after taking this damage, it is destroyed.
description.zh:
你使用这把魔法武器进行的攻击检定和伤害掷骰具有+1加值。如果你使用这把武器攻击一个构装生物，则加值提升为+3。
当你使用这把武器进行一次攻击检定并掷出20时，目标会额外受到7钝击伤害。如果目标为构装生物，则其受到的额外钝击伤害为14。如果一个构装生物因受到该伤害而生命值被降至25及以下，则该生物被摧毁。

roll20Modifiers: Item Type: Melee Weapon, Damage: 1d6, Damage Type: Bludgeoning

description.en: This magic weapon has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While holding the weapon, you can take a Magic action and expend 1 charge to release a wave of terror from it. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute. While Frightened in this way, a creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks. For its action, it can use only the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If it has nowhere it can move, the creature can take the Dodge action. At the end of each of its turns, a creature repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
description.zh: 这把魔法武器具有3充能，并在每日黎明时重获1d3已消耗的充能。持握这把武器期间，你可以使用一个魔法动作并消耗1充能，来从该武器中释放出一股恐惧波动。30尺内每个你所选择的生物都必须成功通过一次DC 15的感知豁免，否则将陷入恐慌状态，持续1分钟。以这种方式陷入恐慌的生物在其回合内必须尽可能的向远离你的方向移动，并且它不能发动借机攻击。它只能选择进行疾走动作，或尝试摆脱一个阻止其移动的效应。如果无处可逃，则它可以执行回避动作。该生物在每个自己的回合结束时可以再次进行此豁免，豁免成功则其身上的该效应提前结束。

roll20Modifiers: Item Type: Melee Weapon, Damage: 1d6, Damage Type: Bludgeoning, Alternate Damage: 1d8, Alternate Damage Type: Bludgeoning, Range: 30/120, Melee Attacks +2, Melee Damage +2, AC +5

description.en:
You have a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.
While holding this weapon, you can cause it to emit green Dim Light out to 10 feet, either as a Bonus Action or after you roll Initiative, or you can extinguish the light as a Bonus Action.
While holding this weapon, you can take a Bonus Action to alter its form, turning it into a 6-inch rod (for ease of storage) or a 10-foot pole, or reverting it a Quarterstaff; the weapon will elongate only as far as the surrounding space allows.
In certain forms, the weapon has the following additional properties.
Acrobatic Assist (Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole Forms Only).
While holding this weapon, you have Advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.
Attack Deflection (Quarterstaff Form Only).
When you are hit by an attack while holding the weapon, you can take a Reaction to twirl the weapon around you, gaining a +5 bonus to your Armor Class against the triggering attack, potentially causing the attack to miss you. You can't use this property again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.
Ranged Weapon (Quarterstaff Form Only).
This weapon has Thrown with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 120 feet. Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand.
description.zh:
你以此魔法武器进行的攻击检定和伤害掷骰具有+2加值。
持握此武器期间，你可以在骰先攻后令该长棍散发出10尺微光光照。你也可以用一个附赠动作使其散发出同样的光照，或使用附赠动作使该光照熄灭。
持握此武器期间，你可以用一个附赠动作转化其形态，将其变为一根6寸短杆（为便于储存）或一根10尺长杆，又或者将其恢复至一根长棍。此武器至多只能伸长至其周围空间所允许的长度。
在相应形态下，此武器具有以下额外词条：
援助特技（仅限长棍和10尺长杆形态）.
持握此武器期间，你在敏捷（特技）检定上具有优势。
偏斜攻击（仅限长棍形态）.
若你在持握此武器期间被一次攻击命中，你可以用一个反应让武器盘绕于己身，使你针对触发此反应的攻击中护甲等级+5，这可能导致该攻击变为未命中。该词条在你完成一次短或长休前无法再次使用。
远程武器（仅限长棍形态）.
此武器具有投掷（30/120）词条。你以此武器进行一次远程攻击之后，它会立即飞回你的手中。

roll20Modifiers: Item Type: Melee Weapon, Damage: 1d6, Damage Type: Slashing, Melee Attacks +2, Melee Damage +2

description.en: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, you can make one attack with it as a Bonus Action on each of your turns.
description.zh: 你用此魔法武器发动的攻击检定和伤害掷骰获得+2加值。此外，你在自己的每个回合中可以用一个附赠动作以该弯刀发动一次攻击。

attunement.en: Requires Attunement by a bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
attunement.zh: 需要同调（由吟游诗人、牧师、德鲁伊、术士、魔契师或法师）

roll20Modifiers: Item Type: Melee Weapon, Damage: 1d6, Damage Type: Bludgeoning, Alternate Damage: 1d8, Alternate Damage Type: Bludgeoning

description.en:
This staff has 10 charges. While holding the staff, you can use any of its properties:
• Cast Spell You can expend 1 of the staff's charges to cast Charm Person, Command, or Comprehend Languages from it using your spell save DC.
• Reflect Enchantment If you succeed on a saving throw against an Enchantment spell that targets only you, you can take a Reaction to expend 1 charge from the staff and turn the spell back on its caster as if you had cast the spell.
• Resist Enchantment If you fail a saving throw against an Enchantment spell that targets only you, you can turn your failed save into a successful one. You can't use this property of the staff again until the next dawn.
Regaining Charges.
The staff regains 1d8 + 2 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff crumbles to dust and is destroyed.
description.zh:
这根法杖具有10充能。持握这根法杖期间，你可以使用以下词条：
• 施法 你可以消耗1充能，从法杖中施展魅惑类人、命令术、或通晓语言 ，该法术使用你自己的法术豁免DC。
• 惑控反射 如果一道惑控学派法术仅以你为目标，而你豁免成功时，你可以执行反应并消耗1充能，将法术反射给原施法者，如同你施展了这道法术一般。
• 惑控抵抗 如果一道惑控学派法术仅以你为目标，而你豁免失败时，你可以将失败的豁免改为成功。法杖的这项词条一经使用，其直至次日黎明前都无法再次使用。
重获充能.
这根法杖在每日黎明时重获1d8 + 2已消耗的充能。当充能数耗尽时，骰一次1d20。如果骰值为1，法杖将崩解为尘土，并被摧毁。

attunement.en: Requires Attunement by a druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
attunement.zh: 需要同调（由德鲁伊、术士、魔契师或法师）

roll20Modifiers: Item Type: Melee Weapon, Damage: 1d6, Damage Type: Bludgeoning, Alternate Damage: 1d8, Alternate Damage Type: Bludgeoning

description.en:
You have Resistance to Fire damage while you hold this staff.
Spells.
The staff has 10 charges. While holding the staff, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it, using your spell save DC. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell.
Spell | Charge Cost
Burning Hands | 1
Fireball | 3
Wall of Fire | 4
Regaining Charges.
The staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff crumbles into cinders and is destroyed.
description.zh:
持握这根法杖期间，你获得火焰伤害的抗性。
法术.
这根法杖具有10充能。持握此法杖期间，你可以从法杖中施展以下表格中的一道法术，使用你自己的法术豁免DC。施展相应法术所需消耗的充能数如下表所示。
法术 | 消耗充能
燃烧之手 | 1
火球术 | 3
火墙术 | 4

The staff is destroyed and releases its magic in an explosion that fills a 30-foot Emanation originating from itself. You have a 50% chance to instantly travel to a random plane of existence, avoiding the explosion. If you fail to avoid the effect, you take Force damage equal to 16 times the number of charges in the staff. Each other creature in the area makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to 4 times the number of charges in the staff. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

description.en:
As a Magic action, you can throw this staff so that it lands in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you, causing the staff to become a Giant Constrictor Snake in that space. The snake is under your control and shares your Initiative count, taking its turn immediately after yours.
On your turn, you can mentally command the snake (no action required) if it is within 60 feet of you and you don't have the Incapacitated condition. You decide what action the snake takes and where it moves during its turn, or you can issue it a general command, such as to attack your enemies or guard a location. Absent commands from you, the snake defends itself.
As a Bonus Action, you can command the snake to revert to staff form in its current space, and you can't use the staff's property again for 1 hour. If the snake is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it dies and reverts to its staff form; the staff then shatters and is destroyed. If the snake reverts to staff form before losing all its Hit Points, it regains all of them.
description.zh:
以一个魔法动作，你可以将法杖扔到你周边10尺内一处未占据空间的地面上，并让其变为一条巨蟒蛇 。这条蛇将受你所控，其先攻值与你相同，并在你的回合结束后立即进行其回合。
在你的回合内，只要蛇在你身边60尺范围内且你未陷入失能状态，你便可以用精神给他下达命令（无需动作）。你将决定巨蟒在这一轮中执行什么动作以及如何移动，或者你可以下达一个宽泛的指令，例如攻击你的敌人或保护某个地点。如果你没有下达命令，蛇将保护自己。
以一个附赠动作，你可以命令蛇在当前的空间还原回法杖形态，之后你无法在1小时内再次使用法杖的词条。如果蛇的生命值被降为0，它将死亡并还原回法杖形态，随后法杖破碎并被摧毁。如果蛇在失去全部生命值之前还原回法杖形态，它会恢复所有失去的生命值。

description.en:
This staff can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. It also has the following additional properties. Once one of these properties is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
Lightning.
When you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can cause the target to take an extra 2d6 Lightning damage (no action required).
Thunder.
When you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can cause the staff to emit a crack of thunder audible out to 300 feet (no action required). The target you hit must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or have the Stunned condition until the end of your next turn.
Thunder and Lightning.
Immediately after you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can take a Bonus Action to use the Lightning and Thunder properties (see above) at the same time. Doing so doesn't expend the daily use of those properties, only the use of this one.
Lightning Strike.
You can take a Magic action to cause a bolt of lightning to leap from the staff's tip in a Line that is 5 feet wide and 120 feet long. Each creature in that Line makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 9d6 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
Thunderclap.
You can take a Magic action to cause the staff to produce a thunderclap audible out to 600 feet. Every creature within a 60-foot Emanation originating from you makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 Thunder damage and has the Deafened condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.
description.zh:

电闪.
当你用法杖发动近战攻击并命中时，你可以对目标造成额外2d6点闪电伤害（无需动作）。
雷鸣.
当你用法杖发动近战攻击并命中时，你可以让法杖爆发出距你300尺内都能听见的雷霆巨响（无需动作）。被你击中的目标必须通过一次DC 17的体质豁免，否则陷入震慑状态，持续至你的下个回合结束。
雷霆.
当你用法杖发动近战攻击并命中时，你可以立刻执行附赠动作来同时使用电闪和雷鸣词条（见上文）。这样做只会消耗雷霆词条的使用次数，而不会消耗电闪或雷鸣的使用次数。
闪电打击.
你可以执行魔法动作，让法杖从尖端射出一道覆盖宽5尺，长120尺线状区域的线状闪电束。所有在该线状区域内的生物都需要进行DC 17的敏捷豁免，豁免失败则其受到9d6闪电伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。
惊雷.
你可以执行魔法动作，让法杖制造一记在你600尺内都能听见的惊雷声响。以你为源点60尺光环区域内的所有生物都需要进行DC 17的体质豁免。豁免失败则其受到2d6雷鸣伤害并陷入耳聋状态，持续1分钟；豁免成功则仅受半伤。

attunement.en: Requires Attunement by a cleric, druid, or warlock
attunement.zh: 需要同调（由牧师、德鲁伊或魔契师）

roll20Modifiers: Item Type: Melee Weapon, Damage: 1d6, Damage Type: Bludgeoning, Alternate Damage: 1d8, Alternate Damage Type: Bludgeoning

description.en:
This staff has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.
The staff can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff. On a hit, it deals damage as a normal Quarterstaff, and you can expend 1 charge to deal an extra 2d10 Necrotic damage to the target and force it to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has Disadvantage for 1 hour on any ability check or saving throw that uses Strength or Constitution.
description.zh:
该法杖有3发充能，且每天黎明时恢复1d3发已消耗的充能。
这把法杖可作为一把魔法长棍使用。命中时，它造成与普通长棍相同的伤害，并且你可以消耗1发充能以对目标额外造成2d10点暗蚀伤害，并迫使其进行一次DC 15的体质豁免检定。豁免失败时，目标在1小时内，任何使用力量或体质的属性检定或豁免检定具有劣势。

roll20Modifiers: Item Type: Melee Weapon, Damage: 1d8, Damage Type: Radiant, Alternate Damage: 1d10, Alternate Damage Type: Radiant, Melee Attacks +2, Melee Damage +2

description.en:
This item appears to be a sword hilt.
Blade of Radiance.
While grasping the hilt, you can take a Bonus Action to cause a blade of pure radiance to spring into existence or make the blade disappear. While the blade exists, this magic weapon functions as a Longsword with Finesse. If you are proficient with Longswords or Shortswords, you are proficient with the Sun Blade.
You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this weapon, which deals Radiant damage instead of Slashing damage. When you hit an Undead with it, that target takes an extra 1d8 Radiant damage.
Sunlight.
The sword's luminous blade emits Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 15 feet. The light is sunlight. While the blade persists, you can take a Magic action to expand or reduce its radius of Bright Light and Dim Light by 5 feet each, to a maximum of 30 feet each or a minimum of 10 feet each.
description.zh:
这件物品看起来像是一把剑柄。
耀光剑刃.
持握剑柄时，你可以用一个附赠动作将这把剑纯粹由光芒构成的剑刃展开或是解除。展开剑刃的阳炎剑视为一把具有灵巧词条的魔法长剑。如果你拥有长剑或短剑的熟练，则你也拥有对阳炎剑的熟练。
你用该武器发动的攻击检定和伤害掷骰获得+2加值，但它造成光耀伤害而非挥砍伤害。被这把剑命中的亡灵将额外受到1d8点光耀伤害。
耀阳.
阳炎剑闪耀的剑刃会散发出15尺的明亮光照和额外15尺微光光照。这一光照视为日光。剑刃展开期间，你能够以一个魔法动作使明亮光照与微光光照半径各扩大或缩小5尺。光照范围上限为明亮和微光区域各30尺，下限为各10尺。

roll20Modifiers: Item Type: Melee Weapon, Damage: 1d8, Damage Type: Bludgeoning

description.en:
While you are attuned to this magic weapon, your Strength is 20 unless your Strength is already equal to or greater than that score. The weapon deals an extra 1d8 Thunder damage to any creature it hits and an extra 3d8 Thunder damage to objects it hits that aren't being worn or carried.
The weapon has the following additional properties.
Clap of Thunder.
As a Magic action, you can strike the weapon against a hard surface to create a loud clap of thunder audible out to 300 feet. You also create a 30-foot Cone of thunderous energy. Each creature in the Cone must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or have the Prone condition. Nonmagical objects in the Cone that aren't being worn or carried take 3d8 Thunder damage.
Earthquake.
As a Magic action, you can strike the weapon against the ground to create an intense seismic disturbance in a 50-foot-radius circle centered on the point of impact. Structures in contact with the ground in that area take 50 Bludgeoning damage, and each creature on the ground in that area must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition. If that creature is also Concentrating, it must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or its Concentration is broken. In addition, you can cause a 30-foot-deep, 10-foot-wide fissure to open up on the ground anywhere in the area. Any creature on a spot where the fissure opens must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, falling into the fissure on a failed save or moving with the fissure's edge on a successful one. Any structure on a spot where the fissure opens collapses into the fissure. Once you use this property, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
description.zh:
当你与这把魔法武器同调后，你的力量变为20，除非你的力量已经大于或等于此值。这把武器会对其命中的任何生物造成额外1d8雷鸣伤害，也会对其命中的未被穿着或携带的物件造成额外3d8雷鸣伤害。
这把武器具有以下附加词条：
雷霆霹雳.
以一个魔法动作，你可以使用这把武器击打一处坚硬表面，制造出在300尺内都能听见的雷鸣般巨响。并且，你制造出一个30尺锥状的雷霆能量区域。锥状区域内的每个生物都必须成功通过一次DC 15的力量豁免，豁免失败则其陷入倒地状态。锥状区域内未被穿着或携带的非魔法物件会受到3d8雷鸣伤害。
地震术.
以一个魔法动作，你可以使用这把武器敲击地面，在以敲击点为中心，半径50尺的范围内引起一阵强烈的地震扰动。该区域内与地面接触的建筑物会受到50点钝击伤害，并且该区域地面上的每个生物都必须成功通过一次DC 20的敏捷豁免，豁免失败则其陷入倒地状态。若该生物同时正在维持专注于，则其必须成功通过一次DC 20的体质豁免，豁免失败则其专注被打断。此外，你可以在该区域内任意一处的地面上打开一道30尺深，10 尺宽的裂缝。任何位于裂缝开口位置的生物都必须进行一次DC 20的敏捷豁免，豁免失败则其落入裂缝中，豁免成功则其会随着裂缝边缘移动。任何位于裂缝开口位置的建筑物都会坍塌落入裂缝中。这项词条一经使用，则其直至次日黎明前都无法再次使用。

roll20Modifiers: Item Type: Melee Weapon, Damage: 1d8, Damage Type: Piercing, Alternate Damage: 1d10, Alternate Damage Type: Piercing, Range: 20/60

description.en: This magic weapon has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While you carry it, you can expend 1 charge to cast Dominate Beast (save DC 15) from it on a Beast that has a Swim Speed.
description.zh: 这把魔法武器具有3充能，并在每日黎明时重获1d3已消耗的充能。当你携带这把武器时，你可以消耗1充能对一只具有游泳速度的野兽施展支配野兽（豁免DC 15）。

description.en:
You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage while you wear this armor.
Metal Shell.
You can take a Magic action to give yourself Immunity to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage for 10 minutes or until you are no longer wearing the armor. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
description.zh:
着装此护甲期间，你具有对钝击、穿刺和挥砍伤害的抗性。
金属外壳.
你能够以一个魔法动作 令你具有对钝击、穿刺和挥砍伤害的免疫，持续10分钟或在你不再着装该此护甲时提前结束。该词条一经使用，直至次日黎明你都无法再次使用。

description.en: While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class. You can also take a Bonus Action to cause the armor to assume the appearance of a normal set of clothing or some other kind of armor. You decide what it looks like—including color, style, and accessories—but the armor retains its normal bulk and weight. The illusory appearance lasts until you use this property again or doff the armor.
description.zh: 穿着这件护甲期间，你的护甲等级获得+1加值。你还可以用一个附赠动作使这件护甲的外观幻化为任何非金属的衣物或其他种类的护甲。幻化后的外观由你决定——包括颜色、样式和配饰——但其体积和重量不变。幻化外观的效应持续到你脱掉此护甲或再次改变护甲外观。

description.en: While holding this Shield, you can take a Bonus Action to cause it to animate. The Shield leaps into the air and hovers in your space to protect you as if you were wielding it, leaving your hands free. The Shield remains animate for 1 minute, until you take a Bonus Action to end this effect, or until you die or have the Incapacitated condition, at which point the Shield falls to the ground or into your hand if you have one free.
description.zh: 持握此盾牌期间，你可以用附赠动作使其活化。盾牌将飞到空中并悬浮在你所占据的空间中保护你，如同你正持用着它一般，且同时解放你的双手。盾牌保持活化1分钟，如果你陷入失能 、死亡 、或用附赠动作终止其效应时，活化会提前结束。如果活化结束时你有空闲的手空着，盾牌将落回你手里；否则它会掉落在地上。

description.en:
You gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class against ranged attack rolls while you wield this Shield. This bonus is in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC.
Whenever an attacker makes a ranged attack roll against a target within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to become the target of the attack instead.
description.zh:
持握此盾牌期间，你对抗远程攻击的护甲等级具有+2加值。该加值将加在盾牌通常提供的加值上。
此外，当一个攻击者对你周围5尺内的目标发动远程攻击时，你可以执行反应以替代该目标成为此次攻击的目标。

description.en: While holding this Shield, you have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks. The Shield is emblazoned with a symbol of an eye.
description.zh: 持握这面盾牌期间，你进行的先攻检定和感知（察觉）检定具有优势。这面盾牌上的纹章是一只眼睛的图案。

description.en:
While holding this Shield, you have Resistance to damage from attacks made with Ranged weapons.
Curse.
This Shield is cursed. Attuning to it curses you until you are targeted by a Remove Curse spell or similar magic. Removing the Shield fails to end the curse on you. Whenever an attack with a Ranged weapon targets a creature within 10 feet of you, the curse causes you to become the target instead.
description.zh:
持握这面盾牌期间，你对使用远程武器进行的攻击所造成的伤害具有抗性。
诅咒.
这面盾牌被诅咒了。与之同调会使你也被诅咒，直至你成为法术移除诅咒或类似魔法的目标。每当使用远程武器进行的攻击以你10尺内一个生物为目标时，诅咒会使你代替该生物成为目标。

description.en:
While holding this Shield, you have a +2 bonus to Armor Class. This bonus is in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC.
The Shield has the following additional properties that you can use while holding it.
Forceful Bash.
When you take the Attack action, you can make one of the attack rolls using the Shield against a target within 5 feet of yourself. Apply your Proficiency Bonus and Strength modifier to the attack roll. On a hit, the Shield deals Force damage to the target equal to 2d6 + 2 plus your Strength modifier, and if the target is a creature, you can push it up to 10 feet directly away from yourself. If the creature is your size or smaller, you can also knock it down, giving it the Prone condition.
Protective Field.
As a Reaction, when you or an ally you can see within 5 feet of you is targeted by an attack or makes a saving throw against an area of effect, you can use the Shield to create an immobile 5-foot Emanation originating from you. When the Emanation appears, any creatures or objects not fully contained within it are pushed into the nearest unoccupied spaces outside it. The attack or area of effect that triggered the Reaction has no effect on creatures and objects inside the Emanation, which lasts as long as you maintain Concentration, up to 1 minute. Nothing can pass into or out of the Emanation. A creature or object inside the Emanation can't be damaged by attacks or effects originating from outside, nor can a creature inside the Emanation damage anything outside it. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
description.zh:
持握这面盾牌期间，你的护甲等级获得+2加值。这是盾牌原本提供的AC加值外的额外加值。
持握这面盾牌期间，你可以使用以下额外词条。
强力猛击.
当你执行攻击动作时，你可以使用这面盾牌进行其中一次攻击，这次攻击的目标必须在你5尺之内。将你的熟练加值和力量调整值加入攻击检定。若命中，盾牌会对目标造成2d6 + 2+你力量调整值的力场伤害，如果目标是生物，你可以将其推离至多10尺；如果该生物的体型与你相同或更小，你还可以同时将它击倒，使其陷入倒地状态。
庇护力场.
当你或5尺内你可见的一位盟友成为一次攻击的目标，或为一次区域效应进行豁免检定时，你可以用反应使这面盾牌制造一个以你为源点的无法移动的5尺光环。当光环出现时，任何未完全位于其中的生物或物件都会被推至光环外最近的未占据空间中。触发此反应的攻击或区域效应将无法影响到光环内的生物和物件。光环需要你为之维持专注 ，并持续最多一分钟。没有任何东西可以进出光环，光环内的生物和物件不会受到来自外部的攻击或效应的伤害，光环内的生物也无法伤害其外部的任何东西。此词条一经使用，直至次日黎明前你都无法再次使用。

description.en: While holding this Shield, you have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and spell attack rolls have Disadvantage against you.
description.zh: 在你持握着这面盾牌期间，你为抵抗法术和其他魔法效应所进行的豁免具有优势，且对你发动的法术攻击检定具有劣势。

description.en:
This pointed hat has the following properties.
Spellcasting Focus.
While holding the hat, you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for your Wizard spells. Any spell you cast using the hat gains a special Somatic component: you must reach into the hat and "pull" the spell out of it.
Unknown Spell.
While holding the hat, you can try to cast a level 1+ spell you don't know. The spell must be on the Wizard spell list, it must be of a level you can cast, and it can't have Material components costing more than 1,000 GP. Once you decide on the spell, you must expend a spell slot of the spell's level. Then, to determine whether you cast the spell, make an Intelligence (Arcana) check (DC 10 plus the spell's level). On a successful check, you cast the spell using its normal casting time, and you can't use this property again until you finish a Short or Long Rest. On a failed check, you fail to cast the spell and a random effect occurs instead, determined by rolling on the following table.
Any spell you cast from the hat uses your spell save DC and spell attack bonus.
1d100 | Effect
01-50 | You cast a random spell determined by rolling 1d10: on a 1, Enlarge/Reduce (enlarge effect); on a 2, Enlarge/Reduce (reduce effect); on a 3, Faerie Fire; on a 4, Fireball; on a 5, Gust of Wind; on a 6, Invisibility (cast on yourself); on a 7, Lightning Bolt; on an 8, Phantasmal Force; on a 9, Polymorph; on a 10, Stinking Cloud.
51-55 | You have the Stunned condition until the end of your next turn, believing something awesome just happened.
56-60 | A harmless swarm of butterflies fills a 10-foot Cube within 30 feet of yourself. The swarm disperses after 1 minute.
61-65 | You pull a nonmagical object out of the hat. Roll 1d4 to determine the object: on a 1, a vial of Acid; on a 2, a flask of Alchemist's Fire; on a 3, a Crowbar; on a 4, a lit Torch.
66-70 | You suffer a bout of "magic sickness" and have the Poisoned condition for 1 hour.
71-75 | You have the Petrified condition until the end of your next turn.
76-80 | You pull a nonmagical object out of the hat. Roll 1d4 to determine the object: on a 1, a Dagger; on a 2, a Rope with a Grappling Hook tied to one end; on a 3, a bag of Caltrops; on a 4, a gem worth 50 GP.
81-85 | A creature appears in an unoccupied space as close to you as possible. The creature isn't under your control and acts as it normally would, and it disappears after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 Hit Points. Roll 1d4 to determine the creature: on a 1, a Camel; on a 2, a Constrictor Snake; on a 3, an Elephant; on a 4, a Mule.
86-90 | A Hostile Swarm of Bats flies out of the hat, occupies your space, and attacks you.
91-95 | A vertical, 10-foot-diameter, two-way portal to another plane of existence opens in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you and remains open until the end of your next turn. The DM determines where it leads.
96-00 | You pull a magic item out of the hat. Roll 1d6 to determine the item's rarity: on a 1-3, Common; on a 4-5, Uncommon; on a 6, Rare. The DM chooses the item, which disappears after 1 hour if it's not consumed or destroyed before then.
description.zh:
这顶尖顶帽具有以下词条：
法器.
持握这顶帽子期间，你可以将其作为你施展法师法术的法器使用。任何你通过这顶帽子施展的法术均具有特殊的姿势成分，即你必须将手伸入帽子之中以将法术从中"拽"出来。
未知法术.
持握这顶帽子期间，你可以尝试施展一道你并未已知的一环或以上法术。所选法术必须位于法师法表中，同时其环阶必须是你能够施展的法术环阶，其也不能具有多于1000GP的材料成分。一旦你决定了施展哪道法术，你必须消耗法术环阶所对应的一个法术位。随后，为了决定你是否施展该法术，进行一次智力（奥秘）检定（DC 10+法术环阶）。检定成功，则你以该法术的正常施法时间施展该法术，且你直到完成一次短或长休之前不能再次使用此词条。检定失败，则你施法失败，转而在下表掷骰以决定触发的随机效应。
你通过帽子施展的所有法术均使用你的法术豁免DC和法术攻击加值。
1d100 | 效应
01-50 | 你施展一道随机法术，具体法术骰1d10决定：骰值为1，变巨/缩小术（变巨术效应）；骰值为2，变巨/缩小术（缩小术效应）；骰值为3，妖火；骰值为4，火球术；骰值为5，造风术；骰值为6，隐形术（以自身为目标施展）；骰值为7，闪电束；骰值为8，魅影之力；骰值为9，变形术；骰值为10，臭云术。
51-55 | 你因相信刚刚发生了一些令人惊叹的事情而陷入震慑状态直至你的下个回合结束。
56-60 | 位于你30尺内的10尺立方充满一群无害的蝴蝶。蝴蝶在1分钟后消散。
61-65 | 你从帽子中拽出一个非魔法物件。骰1d4以决定物件是什么：骰值为1，一小瓶强酸；骰值为2，一小瓶炽火胶；骰值为3，一根撬棍；骰值为4，一根点燃的火把。
66-70 | 你忍受"魔法疾病"的发作，陷入中毒状态，持续1小时。
71-75 | 你陷入石化状态直至你的下个回合结束。
76-80 | 你从帽子中拽出一个非魔法物件。骰1d4以决定物件是什么：骰值为1，一把匕首；骰值为2，一根末端绑有爪钩的绳索；骰值为3，一包铁蒺藜；骰值为4，一颗价值50 GP的宝石。
81-85 | 一名生物出现在尽可能靠近你的一处未被占据的空间。此生物不受你控制，且会以其通常行动方式行事，并在1小时后或其生命值降为0时消失。骰1d4以决定生物是什么：骰值为1，一头骆驼；骰值为2，一条蟒蛇 ；骰值为3，一头大象；骰值为4，一匹骡子。
86-90 | 一群敌对的蝙蝠群从帽子中飞出，占据你的空间并对你发起攻击。
91-95 | 一扇通往另一个存在位面，10尺直径的直立双向传送门在一处位于你30尺内未被占据的空间打开，且直到你下个回合结束为止保持开启。DM决定其通往何方。
96-00 | 你从帽子中拽出一件魔法物品。骰1d6以决定物品的稀有度：骰值为1-3，普通；骰值为4-5，非普通；骰值为6，珍稀。DM选择魔法物品是什么，且该物品若未被消耗或摧毁则在1小时后消失。

description.en:
You can take a Magic action to blow the horn, which emits a thunderous blast in a 30-foot Cone that is audible out to 600 feet. Each creature in the Cone makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 5d8 Thunder damage and has the Deafened condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. Glass or crystal objects in the Cone that aren't being worn or carried take 10d8 Thunder damage.
Each use of the horn's magic has a 20% chance of causing the horn to explode. The explosion deals 10d6 Force damage to the user and destroys the horn.
description.zh:
你可以用一个魔法动作说出号角的命令语然后吹响号角。号角将产生30尺锥状的音爆，其声音可传播远达600尺。锥状内的每个生物必须进行一次DC 15的体质豁免。豁免失败的生物将受5d8点雷鸣伤害并耳聋1分钟，成功则伤害减半且不会耳聋。在锥状内由玻璃或晶体构成的生物或物件进行该豁免时具有劣势，且会受到10d8而非5d6的伤害。
每次使用号角的效应都有20%的概率导致它爆炸，号角也将因此被摧毁且对吹响它的人造成10d6点火焰伤害。

description.en:
You can take a Magic action to blow this horn. In response, warrior spirits from the plane of Ysgard appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of you. Each spirit uses the Berserker stat block and returns to Ysgard after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 Hit Points. The spirits look like living, breathing warriors, and they have Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions. Once you use the horn, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.
A brass horn summons 3 Berserkers. To meet the requirements of the brass horn, you must have Proficiency with all Simple weapons.
If you blow the horn without meeting its requirement, the summoned Berserkers attack you. If you meet the requirement, they are Friendly to you and your allies and follow your commands.
description.zh:
你可以用一个魔法动作吹响号角。作为回应，伊斯加德的武者英灵们将在你周围60尺内未占据的空间出现。这些英灵使用狂战士的数据，它们将会在1小时之后或生命值降低到0时返回伊斯加德。英灵们看起来就像是活着的，能够呼吸的战士，且它们免疫魅惑与恐慌状态。号角一经使用，需要经过7天才能再次使用。
黄铜号角可以召唤3个狂战士们。要满足黄铜号角的要求，你必须具有所有简易武器的熟练。
如果你在不满足先决条件的情况下吹响了号角，则召唤出的狂战士们将对你发动攻击。如果你满足先决条件，他们将对你和你的同伴态度友好，并听从你的命令。

一只白银号角召唤2个狂战士们。他们会对你和你的盟友持友好态度，并听从你的命令。

description.en:
When you drink this potion, you are cured of all magical contagions. In addition, the following conditions end on you: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, and Poisoned.
The clear, red liquid has tiny bubbles of light in it.
description.zh:
当你饮下这瓶药水时，你身上的所有魔法性疫病都会被治愈。此外，你身上的目盲、耳聋、麻痹与中毒状态都会结束。
这瓶清澈的红色液体中有着发光的微小气泡。

description.en:
One vial of this oil can cover one Medium or smaller creature, along with the equipment it's wearing and carrying (one additional vial is required for each size category above Medium). Applying the oil takes 10 minutes. The affected creature then gains the effect of the Etherealness spell for 1 hour.
Beads of this cloudy, gray oil form on the outside of its container and quickly evaporate.
description.zh:
一扁瓶的以太化之油可以覆盖住连带着其着装与携带的装备的一个中型或小型生物（生物体型每比中型大一级，就需要多用一扁瓶）。抹上油需要花费10分钟。被影响的生物将会获得以太化法术的效应，持续1小时。
与瓶中油膏类似的浑浊的灰色油珠会在其容器的外壁形成，并迅速蒸发。

description.en:
One vial of this oil can coat one Melee weapon or twenty pieces of ammunition, but only ammunition and Melee weapons that are nonmagical and deal Slashing or Piercing damage are affected. Applying the oil takes 1 minute, after which the oil magically seeps into whatever it coats, turning the coated weapon into a +3 Weapon or the coated ammunition into +3 Ammunition.
This clear, gelatinous oil sparkles with tiny, ultrathin silver shards.
description.zh:
一扁瓶的锐锋之油可以涂抹在一把近战武器或二十发弹药上，但只有在非魔法性且造成挥砍或穿刺伤害的近战武器或弹药上才能发挥效用。抹上油需要花费1分钟，那之后油将魔法性地渗入被涂抹的武器或弹药，将其变为+3武器或+3弹药。
这种透明的凝胶状油膏中掺杂着极其纤细而微小的银色碎片。

description.en:
One vial of this oil can cover one Medium or smaller creature, along with the equipment it's wearing and carrying (one additional vial is required for each size category above Medium). Applying the oil takes 10 minutes. The affected creature then gains the effect of the Freedom of Movement spell for 8 hours.
Alternatively, the oil can be poured on the ground as a Magic action, where it covers a 10-foot square, duplicating the effect of the Grease spell in that area for 8 hours.
This sticky, black unguent is thick and heavy, but it flows quickly when poured.
description.zh:
一扁瓶的滑溜之油可以覆盖住连带着其着装与携带的装备的一个中型或小型生物（生物体型每比中型大一级，就需要多用一扁瓶）。抹上油需要花费10分钟。被影响的生物将会获得行动自如法术的效应，持续8小时。
此外，以一个魔法动作，油可以被泼到地面上并覆盖10尺方形区域，并在此区域内复现出油腻术法术的效应，持续8小时。
这种粘稠的黑色油膏浑浊且厚重，但在被倒出来时却又流动迅速。

description.en:
The next time you see a creature within 10 minutes after drinking this philter, you are charmed by that creature and have the Charmed condition for 1 hour.
This rose-hued, effervescent liquid contains one easy-to-miss bubble shaped like a heart.
description.zh:
饮用此药水后，接下来10分钟内，你将被你看见的第一名生物魅惑。魅惑效应持续1小时。
这种玫瑰色的气泡状药液中包含着一个容易被忽略的心形气泡。

description.en: {#itemEntry Potion of Resistance|XDMG}
description.zh: {#itemEntry 抗性药水|XDMG}

description.en:
When you drink this potion, you can cast the level 3 version of the Animal Friendship spell (save DC 13).
Agitating this potion's muddy liquid brings little bits into view: a fish scale, a hummingbird feather, a cat claw, or a squirrel hair.
description.zh:
当你饮下这瓶药水时，你可以施展三环版本的化兽为友法术（豁免DC 13）。
搅动这瓶药水中的浑浊药液时可以看到细碎的残渣：一片鱼的鳞片、一根蜂鸟的羽毛、一只猫的爪子或是一根松鼠的毛发。

description.en:
When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the Clairvoyance spell (no Concentration required).
An eyeball bobs in this potion's yellowish liquid but vanishes when the potion is opened.
description.zh:
当你饮下这瓶药水时，你获得法术鹰眼术的效应（无需专注）。
一颗眼球在这瓶药水的泛黄药液中沉浮，但会在容器被打开期间消失。

description.en:
When you drink this potion, you gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed for 1 hour. During this time, you have Advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb.
This potion is separated into brown, silver, and gray layers resembling bands of stone. Shaking the bottle fails to mix the colors.
description.zh:
当你饮下这瓶药水时，你获得等同于你速度的攀爬速度，持续1小时。这段时间内，你在为攀爬进行的力量（运动）检定中具有优势。
这瓶药水会分离成类似岩层的褐、银、灰三层颜色。摇晃药水也无法将颜色混合。

description.en:
When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes to 27 for 1 hour. The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.
This potion's transparent liquid has floating in it a sliver of fingernail from a cloud giant.
description.zh:
饮用此药水后，1小时内，你的力量属性值将变为27。如果你的力量属性值已经大于或等于该数值，则药水无效。
这瓶药水的透明药液中漂着一缕像是云巨人指甲一般的光线。

description.en: {#itemEntry Potion of Resistance|XDMG}
description.zh: {#itemEntry 抗性药水|XDMG}

description.en:
When you drink this potion, you gain the "reduce" effect of the Enlarge/Reduce spell for 1d4 hours (no Concentration required).
The red in the potion's liquid continuously contracts to a tiny bead and then expands to color the clear liquid around it. Shaking the bottle fails to interrupt this process.
description.zh:
当你饮下这瓶药水时，你获得法术变巨/缩小术中的"缩小"效应，持续1d4小时（无需专注）。
药液中的红色部分不断收缩成一个小球，随后又膨胀起来，把周围的清澈药液染红。即使摇晃药水瓶也不会打断这个过程。

description.en:
When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes to 25 for 1 hour. The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.
This potion's transparent liquid has floating in it a sliver of fingernail from a fire giant.
description.zh:
饮用此药水后，1小时内，你的力量属性值将变为25。如果你的力量属性值已经大于或等于25，则药水无效。
这瓶药水的透明药液中漂着一缕像是火巨人指甲一般的光线。

description.en: {#itemEntry Potion of Resistance|XDMG}
description.zh: {#itemEntry 抗性药水|XDMG}

description.en:
When you drink this potion, you gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed for 1 hour and can hover. If you're in the air when the potion wears off, you fall unless you have some other means of staying aloft.
This potion's clear liquid floats at the top of its container and has cloudy white impurities drifting in it.
description.zh:
当你饮下这瓶药水时，你获得等同于你速度的飞行速度并可以悬浮，持续1小时。药水效果消失时，如果你仍在半空中，除非你有其他方式保持在空中，否则随即坠落。
这瓶药水中的透明药液漂浮在容器顶部，些许云雾状的白色杂质在其中飘荡。

description.en: {#itemEntry Potion of Resistance|XDMG}
description.zh: {#itemEntry 抗性药水|XDMG}

description.en:
When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes to 23 for 1 hour. The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.
This potion's transparent liquid has floating in it a sliver of fingernail from a frost giant.
description.zh:
饮用此药水后，1小时内，你的力量属性值将变为23。如果你的力量属性值已经大于或等于23，则药水无效。
这瓶药水的透明药液中漂着一缕像是霜巨人指甲一般的光线。

description.en:
When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the Gaseous Form spell for 1 hour (no Concentration required) or until you end the effect as a Bonus Action.
This potion's container seems to hold fog that moves and pours like water.
description.zh:
当你饮下这瓶药水时，你获得法术气化形体的效应，持续1小时（无需专注）或你以附赠动作结束这个效应为止。
这瓶药水的容器看上去装着流动与倾泻如水般的雾气。

description.en: You regain 4d4 + 4 Hit Points when you drink this potion. The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.
description.zh: 当你饮下这瓶药水时将恢复4d4 + 4生命值。这瓶药水的红色药液在摇晃时总会闪烁。

description.en:
When you drink this potion, you gain the "enlarge" effect of the Enlarge/Reduce spell for 10 minutes (no Concentration required).
The red in the potion's liquid continuously expands from a tiny bead to color the clear liquid around it and then contracts. Shaking the bottle fails to interrupt this process.
description.zh:
当你饮下这瓶药水时，你获得法术变巨/缩小术中的"变巨Enlarge"效应，持续10分钟（无需专注）。
药液中的红色部分从一个小球开始膨胀，随后又收缩起来，把周围的清澈药液染红。即使摇晃药水也不会打断这个过程。

description.en: This potion is a magic item. As a Bonus Action, you can drink it or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of yourself. The creature that drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 2d4 + 2 Hit Points. The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.
description.zh: 当你以附赠动作饮下这瓶药水时将恢复2d4 + 2生命值。这瓶药水的红色药液在摇晃时总会闪烁。

description.en:
When you drink this potion, you gain 10 Temporary Hit Points that last for 1 hour. For the same duration, you are under the effect of the Bless spell (no Concentration required).
This potion's blue liquid bubbles and steams as if boiling.
description.zh:
当你饮下这瓶药水时，你获得10临时生命值，持续1小时。在相同持续时间内，你将受到法术祝福术的效应影响（无需专注）。
这瓶药水的蓝色药液如同沸腾一般冒着气泡与蒸汽。

description.en:
When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes to 21 for 1 hour. The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.
This potion's transparent liquid has floating in it a sliver of fingernail from a hill giant.
description.zh:
饮用此药水后，1小时内，你的力量属性值将变为21。如果你的力量属性值已经大于或等于21，则药水无效。
这瓶药水的透明药液中漂着一缕像是山丘巨人指甲一般的光线。

description.en: This potion's container looks empty but feels as though it holds liquid. When you drink the potion, you have the Invisible condition for 1 hour. The effect ends early if you make an attack roll, deal damage, or cast a spell.
description.zh: 这瓶药水的容器看上去像是空的，但感觉上像是装着药液。当你饮下这瓶药水时，你获得隐形状态，持续1小时。效应将在你进行攻击检定、造成伤害或施展法术时提前结束。

description.en:
For 1 minute after you drink this potion, you have Resistance to all damage.
This potion's syrupy liquid looks like liquefied iron.
description.zh:
饮下这瓶药水后的1分钟内，你具有所有伤害的抗性。
这瓶药水的粘稠药液看上去像熔化的铁。

description.en: {#itemEntry Potion of Resistance|XDMG}
description.zh: {#itemEntry 抗性药水|XDMG}

description.en:
When you drink this potion, your physical age is reduced by 1d6 + 6 years, to a minimum of 13 years. Each time you subsequently drink a Potion of Longevity, there is 10 percent cumulative chance that you instead age by 1d6 + 6 years.
Suspended in this amber liquid is a tiny heart that, against all reason, is still beating. These ingredients vanish when the potion is opened.
description.zh:
当你饮下这瓶药水时，你的生理年龄减少1d6 + 6年，最低降至13岁。此后每当你再次饮下延寿药水时，都会累计10%的概率让你的年龄增加1d6 + 6年，而非减少。
一颗违反常理般跳动着的微型心脏悬浮在琥珀色的药液中。这些成分将在药水被打开时消失。

description.en:
When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the Detect Thoughts spell (save DC 13) for 10 minutes (no Concentration required).
This potion's dense, purple liquid has an ovoid cloud of pink floating in it.
description.zh:
当你饮下这瓶药水时，你获得法术侦测思想 的效应（豁免DC 13），持续10分钟（无需专注）。
这瓶药剂的深紫色液体中漂浮着一个卵形的粉红色云雾。

description.en: {#itemEntry Potion of Resistance|XDMG}
description.zh: {#itemEntry 抗性药水|XDMG}

description.en:
This concoction looks, smells, and tastes like a Potion of Healing or another beneficial potion. However, it is actually poison masked by illusion magic. Identify reveals its true nature.
If you drink this potion, you take 4d6 Poison damage and must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition for 1 hour.
description.zh:

如果你饮下这瓶药水，你受到4d6毒素伤害并必须通过DC 13的体质豁免否则陷入中毒状态，持续1小时。

description.en:
When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the Haste spell for 1 minute (no Concentration required) without suffering the wave of lethargy that typically occurs when the effect ends.
This potion's yellow fluid is streaked with black and swirls on its own.

当你饮下这瓶药水时，你获得法术加速术的效应，持续1分钟（无需专注），并且不会遭受通常在效应结束时泛起倦意的影响。
这瓶药水里黄黑相间的流体正自行旋转成漩涡状。

description.en:
When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes to 23 for 1 hour. The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.
This potion's transparent liquid has floating in it a sliver of fingernail from a stone giant.
description.zh:
饮用此药水后，1小时内，你的力量属性值将变为23。如果你的力量属性值已经大于或等于23，则药水无效。
这瓶药水的透明药液中漂着一缕像是石巨人指甲一般的光线。

description.en: You regain 10d4 + 20 Hit Points when you drink this potion. The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.
description.zh: 当你饮下这瓶药水时将恢复10d4 + 20生命值。这瓶药水的红色药液在摇晃时总会闪烁。

description.en:
When you drink this potion, it removes any Exhaustion levels you have and ends the Poisoned condition on you. For the next 24 hours, you regain the maximum number of Hit Points for any Hit Point Die you spend.
This potion's crimson liquid regularly pulses with dull light, calling to mind a heartbeat.
description.zh:
当你饮下这瓶药水时，它将移除你具有的任何力竭等级，并结束你的中毒状态。在接下来的24小时内，你消耗生命值骰来恢复生命值时将直接取用最大值。
这瓶药水的深红药液发出有节奏的微光，让人联想起心跳。

description.en:
You can breathe underwater for 24 hours after drinking this potion.
This potion's cloudy green fluid smells of the sea and has a jellyfish-like bubble floating in it.
description.zh:
饮下这瓶药水后的24小时内，你可以在水下呼吸。
这瓶药水里的浑浊绿色流体闻起来像海水，其中漂浮着一个水母形状的气泡。

description.en:
A Spell Scroll bears the words of a single spell, written in a mystical cipher. If the spell is on your spell list, you can read the scroll and cast its spell without Material components. Otherwise, the scroll is unintelligible. Casting the spell by reading the scroll requires the spell's normal casting time. Once the spell is cast, the scroll crumbles to dust. If the casting is interrupted, the scroll isn't lost.
If the spell is on your spell list but of a higher level than you can normally cast, you make a DC 10 ability check using your spellcasting ability to determine whether you cast the spell. On a failed check, the spell disappears from the scroll with no other effect.
If the spell requires a saving throw or an attack roll, the spell save DC is 13, and the attack bonus is +5.
description.zh:
每张法术卷轴都以神秘暗语记录了一道法术。如果这道法术在你的法术列表中，则你可以阅读该卷轴并施展其法术且无需任何材料成分；否则，你将无法理解该卷轴。通过阅读卷轴施展的法术同样需要遵循相应法术的正常施法时间。法术一经施展，卷轴本身就会化作尘土。如果施法被打断，则卷轴不会消失。
如果这道法术在你的法术列表中，但其环阶高于你当前能施展的水平，则你必须使用你的施法属性进行一次属性检定，以决定是否可以施展这道法术，DC 10+这道法术的环阶。如果检定失败，则卷轴上记载的法术会消失，并且不会产生任何效果。
如果法术需要进行豁免检定或攻击检定，法术豁免DC为13，攻击加值为+5。

如果法术需要进行豁免投掷或攻击检定，法术豁免DC为18，攻击加值为+10。
将卷轴抄录入法术书.
法术卷轴上的法师法术可以抄录到法术书中。当一个8环法术以这种方式被抄录时，抄录者必须通过一次DC 18智力（奥秘）检定。检定成功时，法术被抄录。无论检定是否成功，该法术卷轴都会被销毁。

description.en:
A Spell Scroll bears the words of a single spell, written in a mystical cipher. If the spell is on your spell list, you can read the scroll and cast its spell without Material components. Otherwise, the scroll is unintelligible. Casting the spell by reading the scroll requires the spell's normal casting time. Once the spell is cast, the scroll crumbles to dust. If the casting is interrupted, the scroll isn't lost.
If the spell is on your spell list but of a higher level than you can normally cast, you make a DC 19 ability check using your spellcasting ability to determine whether you cast the spell. On a failed check, the spell disappears from the scroll with no other effect.
If the spell requires a saving throw or an attack roll, the spell save DC is 19, and the attack bonus is +11.
Copying a Scroll into a Spellbook.
A Wizard spell on a Spell Scroll can be copied into a spellbook. When a level 9 spell is copied in this way, the copier must succeed on a DC 19 Intelligence (Arcana). On a successful check, the spell is copied. Whether the check succeeds or fails, the Spell Scroll is destroyed.

This ring has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can expend 1 charge to cast one of the following spells (save DC 13) from it:
• Animal Friendship
• Fear (affects Beasts only)
• Speak with Animals

这枚戒指具有3充能，并在每日黎明时重获1d3已消耗的充能。着装此戒指期间，你可以消耗1充能，从中施展以下法术之一（豁免DC 13）：
• 化兽为友
• 恐惧术（只影响野兽）
• 动物交谈

description.en:
While wearing this ring, you can take a Magic action to summon a particular Djinni from the Elemental Plane of Air. The djinni appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 120 feet of yourself. It remains as long as you maintain Concentration, to a maximum of 1 hour, or until it drops to 0 Hit Points.
While summoned, the djinni is Friendly to you and your allies, and it obeys your commands. If you fail to command it, the djinni defends itself against attackers but takes no other actions.
After the djinni departs, it can't be summoned again for 24 hours, and the ring becomes nonmagical if the djinni dies.
Rings of Djinni Summoning are often created by the djinn they summon and given to mortals as gifts of friendship or tokens of esteem.
description.zh:
着装此戒指期间，你能够以一个魔法动作从气元素位面召唤一名特定的气巨灵。该气巨灵将出现在位于你120尺内你选择的未占据空间中。只要你为之维持专注，气巨灵将持续存在，至多1小时，或在其生命值降至0时提前消失。
被召唤期间，气巨灵对你和你的盟友态度友好，并将服从你的命令。如果你没有下达命令，则它除在遭受攻击时自卫外不会执行任何动作。
气巨灵消失后，24小时内你都无法再次召唤它，若该气巨灵死亡，此戒指变为非魔法的。
召唤气巨灵戒指通常由戒指所召唤的气巨灵制造，用来作为友谊或尊重的象征赠予凡人。

description.en:
The Ring of Elemental Command (air) is linked to the Elemental Plane of Air. Every Ring of Elemental Command has the following two properties:
• Elemental Bane While wearing the ring, you have Advantage on attack rolls against Elementals and they have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you.
• Elemental Compulsion While wearing the ring, you can take a Magic action to try to compel an Elemental you see within 60 feet of yourself. The Elemental makes a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the Elemental has the Charmed condition until the start your next turn, and you determine what it does with its move and action on its next turn.
Elemental Focus.
While wearing the ring, you benefit from additional properties corresponding to the ring's linked Elemental Plane:
• Air You know Auran, you have Resistance to Lightning damage, and you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed and can hover.
Spellcasting.
The ring has 5 charges and regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can cast a spell from it. A spell cast from the ring has a save DC of 18. Choose the spell from the following list: Chain Lightning (3 charges), Feather Fall (0 charges), Gust of Wind (2 charges), Wind Wall (1 charge)
description.zh:
命令元素戒指（气）连接着气元素位面。每枚命令元素戒指都具有以下两种词条：
• 元素灾厄 着装戒指期间，你对元素的攻击检定具有优势，且元素对你的攻击具有劣势。
• 元素强令 着装戒指期间，你可以执行魔法动作来尝试强迫一个可见的，位于你60尺内的元素服从于你。该元素进行一次DC 18的感知豁免。豁免失败时，该元素直到你的下个回合开始前陷入魅惑状态，且你决定其下一回合他将使用移动和动作做什么。
元素集中.
着装戒指期间，你受益于与该戒指连接的元素位面对应的额外词条：
• 气 你懂气族语，你对闪电伤害具有抗性，你获得等于你的速度的飞行速度并且可以悬浮。
施法.
这枚戒指具有5充能，并在每日黎明时重获1d4 + 1已消耗的充能。着装戒指期间，你可以从中施展法术。施展相应法术所需的充能数如该表所示，法术的豁免DC为18。羽落术（0充能）、风墙术（1充能）、造风术（2充能）、连锁闪电（3充能）

In addition, you can move through solid earth or rock as if those areas were Difficult Terrain without disturbing the matter through which you pass. If you end your turn in solid earth or rock, you are shunted out to the nearest unoccupied space you last occupied.

description.en: When you fall while wearing this ring, you descend 60 feet per round and take no damage from falling.
description.zh: 着装此戒指期间，你在坠落时每轮只会下落60尺且不会受到坠落伤害。
