description.en: While you wear this ring, Difficult Terrain doesn't cost you extra movement. In addition, magic can neither reduce any of your Speeds nor cause you to have the Paralyzed or Restrained condition.
description.zh: 着装此戒指期间，你不会因困难地形而损耗额外的移动力。此外，魔法不能减少你的任何速度，也不能使你陷入麻痹或束缚状态。

description.en: While wearing this ring, you can take a Magic action to give yourself the Invisible condition. You remain Invisible until the ring is removed or until you take a Bonus Action to become visible again.
description.zh: 着装此戒指期间，你能够以一个魔法动作令自己获得隐形状态。隐形持续至戒指被摘下或你以一个附赠动作显形。

description.en: While wearing this ring, you can cast Jump from it, but can target only yourself when you do so.
description.zh: 着装此戒指期间，你可以从中施展跳跃术，但只能以自身为目标。

description.en:
While wearing this ring, you are immune to magic that allows other creatures to read your thoughts, determine whether you are lying, know your alignment, or know your creature type. Creatures can telepathically communicate with you only if you allow it.
You can take a Magic action to cause the ring to become imperceptible until you take another Magic action to make it perceptible, until you remove the ring, or until you die.
If you die while wearing the ring, your soul enters it, unless it already houses a soul. You can remain in the ring or depart for the afterlife. As long as your soul is in the ring, you can telepathically communicate with any creature wearing it. A wearer can't prevent this telepathic communication.
description.zh:
着装此戒指期间，你免疫能让其他生物阅读你的思想、辨别你在说谎、知晓你阵营或生物类型的魔法。只有在你允许时，生物才能与你进行心灵感应交流。
你可以执行魔法动作来让戒指变的无法被察觉，持续至你脱下戒指、死亡或执行另一个魔法动作使其可被察觉为止。
如果你在着装戒指期间死亡，你的灵魂将进入戒指中，除非其内已寄宿着其他灵魂。你可以留在戒指内或奔向来世。只要你的灵魂处在戒指中，你就可以与着装它的任何生物进行心灵感应交流。着装者无法阻止这种心灵感应交流。

description.en: While wearing this ring, you regain 1d6 Hit Points every 10 minutes if you have at least 1 Hit Point. If you lose a body part, the ring causes the missing part to regrow and return to full functionality after 1d6 + 1 days if you have at least 1 Hit Point the whole time.
description.zh: 着装此戒指期间，如果你至少拥有1生命值，则你每10分钟恢复1d6生命值。如果你失去了一部分肢体，这枚戒指会使你失去的部位自行再生。只要你在1d6 + 1天的时间里全程保有至少1生命值，该部位就会在这段时间后恢复原有的功能。

description.en:
You can cast Dancing Lights or Light from the ring.
The ring has 6 charges and regains 1d6 expended charges daily at dawn. You can expend its charges to use the properties below.
Faerie Fire.
You can expend 1 charge to cast Faerie Fire from the ring.
Lightning Spheres.
You can expend 2 charges as a Magic action to create up to four 3-foot-diameter spheres of lightning.
Each sphere appears in an unoccupied space you can see within 120 feet of yourself. The spheres last as long as you maintain Concentration, up to 1 minute. Each sphere sheds Dim Light in a 30-foot radius.
As a Bonus Action, you can move each sphere up to 30 feet, but no farther than 120 feet away from yourself. The first time the sphere comes within 5 feet of a creature other than you that isn't behind Total Cover, the sphere discharges lightning at that creature and disappears. That creature makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes Lightning damage based on the number of spheres you created, as shown in the following table. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.
Number of Spheres | Lightning Damage
1 | 4d12
2 | 5d4
3 | 2d6
4 | 2d4
Shooting Stars.
You can expend 1 to 3 charges as a Magic action. For every charge you expend, you launch a glowing mote of light from the ring at a point you can see within 60 feet of yourself. Each creature in a 15-foot Cube originating from that point is showered in sparks and makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d4 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
description.zh:
你可以从戒指中施展舞光术或光亮术。
这枚戒指具有6充能，并在每日黎明时重获1d6已消耗的充能。你可以消耗充能以使用以下词条。
妖火.
你可以消耗1充能以从戒指中施展妖火 。
球状闪电.
你可以消耗2充能，以一个魔法动作创造至多四个3尺直径的闪电球体。
每个球体都出现于120尺内你可见的未占据空间中。只要你为它们维持专注，球体就能持续存在至多1分钟。每个球体都会散发出半径30尺的微光光照。
以一个附赠动作，你可以移动每个球体至多30尺，但球体和你的距离不得超过120尺。球体初次进入一个除你以外的，未处于全身掩护后的生物5尺内时，球体对那个生物放出闪电并消失。该生物进行一次DC 15的敏捷豁免。豁免失败时，生物受到基于你创造出的球体数量的闪电伤害，如下表所示。豁免成功时，生物受到的伤害减半。
球体数量 | 闪电伤害
1 | 4d12
2 | 5d4
3 | 2d6
4 | 2d4
流星.
以一个魔法动作 ，你可以消耗1至3充能。每一发你消耗的充能都会变为一粒发光尘埃，从戒指处向着你60尺内的一点发射。以该点为源点，15尺立方内的所有生物将沐浴在火花之中，并进行一次DC 15的敏捷豁免，失败则受到5d4点光耀伤害，成功则伤害减半。

description.en:
This ring stores spells cast into it, holding them until the attuned wearer uses them. The ring can store up to 5 levels worth of spells at a time. When found, it contains 1d6 - 1 levels of stored spells chosen by the DM.
Any creature can cast a spell of level 1 through 5 into the ring by touching the ring as the spell is cast. The spell has no effect other than to be stored in the ring. If the ring can't hold the spell, the spell is expended without effect. The level of the slot used to cast the spell determines how much space it uses.
While wearing this ring, you can cast any spell stored in it. The spell uses the slot level, spell save DC, spell attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the original caster but is otherwise treated as if you cast the spell. The spell cast from the ring is no longer stored in it, freeing up space.
description.zh:
这枚戒指会储存对其施展的法术，将它们储存起来，直至同调的着装者使用。这枚戒指同时可以储存环阶总和最多为5的法术。被发现时，戒指中已储存了由DM选择的共1d6 - 1环阶的法术。
任何生物都可以向戒指内存入一至五环的法术，这需要施法者在施法的同时触碰该戒指。此时法术会被储存进戒指，不产生任何其他效果。如果戒指无法承载这道法术，则法术会被消耗并不产生任何效果。施展法术时使用的法术位决定其占用戒指中的多少空间。
着装此戒指期间，你可以施展任何其中储存的法术。这道法术使用原施法者的环阶，法术豁免DC，法术攻击加值与施法属性，但其他方面将如同你施展了法术一般处理。戒指中的法术一经施展即消失，释放它原本占用的空间。

description.en: While wearing this ring, you have Advantage on saving throws against spells. If you succeed on the save for a spell of level 7 or lower, the spell has no effect on you. If that spell targeted only you and didn't create an area of effect, you can take a Reaction to deflect the spell back at the spell's caster; the caster must make a saving throw against the spell using their own spell save DC.
description.zh: 着装此戒指期间，你为对抗法术所进行的豁免具有优势。若你对抗不超过七环的法术进行的豁免检定成功，该法术将不会对你产生任何效应；若该法术仅以你为目标且不会创造区域效应，你能够以反应将该法术朝其施法者反弹回去。原施法者必须进行一次豁免检定对抗该法术，该豁免使用原施法者自己的法术豁免DC。

description.en: You have a Swim Speed of 40 feet while wearing this ring.
description.zh: 着装此戒指期间，你获得40尺游泳速度。

description.en: While wearing this ring, you can cast Telekinesis from it.
description.zh: 着装此戒指期间，你可以从中施展心灵遥控。

description.en:
This ring has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 to 3 charges to make a ranged spell attack against one creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. The ring produces a spectral ram's head and makes its attack roll with a +7 bonus. On a hit, for each charge you spend, the target takes 2d10 Force damage and is pushed 5 feet away from you.
Alternatively, you can expend 1 to 3 of the ring's charges as a Magic action to try to break a nonmagical object you can see within 60 feet of yourself that isn't being worn or carried. The ring makes a Strength check with a +5 bonus for each charge you spend.
description.zh:
这枚戒指具有3充能，且在每日黎明时重获1d3已消耗的充能。着装此戒指期间，你可以执行魔法动作并消耗1至3充能，对60尺内的一个可见生物进行一次远程法术攻击。戒指创造出一个灵体公羊脑袋并进行具有+7加值的攻击检定。命中时，你每消耗1充能，目标就会受到2d10点力场伤害并且从你的方向被推离5尺。
作为另一种用法，你可以执行魔法动作并消耗1至3充能，以尝试破坏一件60尺内你可见且未被着装或携带的非魔法性的物体。戒指将进行力量检定，你每消耗1充能，此检定便具有+5加值。

description.en: While wearing this ring, you can expend 1 of its 3 charges to cast Wish from it. The ring becomes nonmagical when you use the last charge.
description.zh: 这枚戒指具有3充能；着装此戒指期间，你可以消耗1充能，从中施展祈愿术。充能耗尽时，此戒指变为非魔法的。

description.en: {#itemEntry Ring of Resistance|XDMG}
description.zh: {#itemEntry 抗性戒指|XDMG}

description.en:
If you take Cold damage while wearing this ring, the ring reduces the damage you take by 2d8.
In addition, while wearing this ring, you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower.
description.zh:
着装此戒指期间，当你受到寒冷伤害时，戒指将你所受的伤害减少2d8。
此外，着装此戒指期间，你以及你着装和携带的任何东西都不会被0华氏度及以下的温度所伤害。

description.en: While wearing this ring, you cast Water Walk from it, targeting only yourself.
description.zh: 着装此戒指期间，你可以从中施展水上行走，但目标只能为自身。

description.en:
While wearing this ring, you can take a Magic action to gain X-ray vision with a range of 30 feet for 1 minute. To you, solid objects within that radius appear transparent and don't prevent light from passing through them. The vision can penetrate 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, or up to 3 feet of wood or dirt. Thicker substances or a thin sheet of lead block the vision.
Whenever you use the ring again before taking a Long Rest, you must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or gain 1 Exhaustion level.
description.zh:
着装此戒指期间，你可以执行魔法动作以获得范围30尺的X射线视觉，持续1分钟。对你来说，半径内的固态物件变为透明，并且不会阻碍光线通过。这种视觉可以穿透1尺厚的石头，1寸厚的常见金属或最多3尺厚的木头或泥土。更厚的物质或一张薄铅片会阻挡这种视觉。
每当你在完成一次长休前再次使用这枚戒指时，你必须成功通过一次DC 15的体质豁免，否则获得1级力竭。

description.en: This iron rod has a button on one end. You can take a Utilize action to press the button, which causes the rod to become magically fixed in place. Until you or another creature takes a Utilize action to push the button again, the rod doesn't move, even if it defies gravity. The rod can hold up to 8,000 pounds of weight. More weight causes the rod to deactivate and fall. A creature can take a Utilize action to make a DC 30 Strength (Athletics) check, moving the fixed rod up to 10 feet on a successful check.
description.zh: 这根铁质权杖的一端具有一枚按钮。你可以执行操作动作按下按钮，让这根权杖魔法性地固定在原处。直到你或另一生物执行操作动作再次按下按钮前，即使违反了重力定律，权杖也不会移动。权杖最多能负载8000磅的重量。更重的负载则会让权杖的效应失效并掉落在地。一个生物可以执行操作动作来进行一次DC 30的力量（运动）检定，成功则可以将固定住的权杖移动最多10尺。

description.en:
While holding this rod, you can take a Reaction to absorb a spell that is targeting only you and doesn't create an area of effect. The absorbed spell's effect is canceled, and the spell's energy—not the spell itself—is stored in the rod. The energy has the same level as the spell when it was cast. A canceled spell dissipates with no effect, and any resources used to cast it are wasted. The rod can absorb and store up to 50 levels of energy over the course of its existence. Once the rod absorbs 50 levels of energy, it can't absorb more. If you are targeted by a spell that the rod can't store, the rod has no effect on that spell.
When you become attuned to the rod, you know how many levels of energy the rod has absorbed over the course of its existence and how many levels of spell energy it currently has stored.
If you are a spellcaster holding the rod, you can convert energy stored in it into spell slots to cast spells you have prepared or know. You can create spell slots only of a level equal to or lower than your own spell slots, up to a maximum of level 5. You use the stored levels in place of your slots but otherwise cast the spell as normal. For example, you can use 3 levels stored in the rod as a level 3 spell slot.
A newly found rod typically has 1d10 levels of spell energy stored in it. A rod that can no longer absorb spell energy and has no energy remaining becomes nonmagical.
description.zh:
持握这根权杖期间，你可以执行反应应来吸收一道仅以你为目标且不会创造范围效应的法术。被吸收的法术将被解除，且法术的能量（而非法术本身）将被储存进权杖中。这些能量与该法术施展时的环阶相同。被解除的法术消散且无效，而施展法术时使用的任何资源都将浪费掉。这根权杖在其被制造出来后最多能吸收并储存共计50环的能量。当权杖已经吸收了50环的能量后，它将无法再吸收法术。如果你被一道权杖无法储存的法术所选为目标，那么权杖将不会对其产生影响。
当你与权杖同调时，你会知晓权杖已经吸收过多少环的能量，以及它当前储存了多少环的法术能量。
持握此权杖期间，如果你是一名施法者，则你可以将权杖中储存的能量转化为法术位并用其施展你已准备的法术或已知的法术。此法可转化出的法术位其环阶不超过你拥有的最高法术位环阶，且最高为五环。你需要如常施展该法术，只是你消耗的是权杖储存的法术能量而非自己的法术位。例如，你可以将权杖储存的3环能量作为一个3环法术位使用。
新发现的吸收权杖通常已经储存了1d10环的法术能量。一根无法再吸收法术且其中没有剩余能量的吸收权杖将变为非魔法的权杖。

description.en:
This rod has the following properties.
Alertness.
While holding the rod, you have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on Initiative rolls.
Spells.
While holding the rod, you can cast the following spells from it:
• Detect Evil and Good
• Detect Magic
• Detect Poison and Disease
• See Invisibility
Protective Aura.
As a Magic action, you can plant the haft end of the rod in the ground, whereupon the rod's head sheds Bright Light in a 60-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 60 feet. While in that Bright Light, you and your allies gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws and can sense the location of any Invisible creature that is also in the Bright Light.
The rod's head stops glowing and the effect ends after 10 minutes or when a creature takes a Magic action to pull the rod from the ground. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.
description.zh:
这根权杖具有以下词条：
警觉.
当你持握此权杖时，你在感知（察觉）检定和先攻掷骰上具有优势。
法术.
当你持握此权杖时，你可以通过它施放以下法术：
• 侦测善恶
• 侦测魔法
• 侦测毒性和疾病
• 识破隐形
防护灵光.
以一个魔法动作，你可以将权杖的柄端插入地面，此时权杖的顶部将发出60尺半径的明亮光照和额外60尺微光光照。身处权杖发出的明亮光照中时，你与你的盟友在护甲等级和豁免中获得+1加值，并且可以感知到同样处于此明亮光照中的任何隐形生物的位置。
最多10分钟后或直至一个生物执行魔法动作将权杖从地面拔出后，权杖顶部会停止发光并结束这个效应。该词条一经使用，直至次日黎明前你都无法再次使用。

description.en:
This rod has a flanged head, and it functions as a magic Mace that grants a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. The rod has properties associated with six different buttons that are set in a row along the haft. It has three other properties as well, detailed below.
Buttons.
You can press one of the following buttons as a Bonus Action; a button's effect lasts until you push a different button or until you push the same button again, which causes the rod to revert to its normal form:
• Button 1 A fiery blade sprouts from the end opposite the rod's flanged head. The flames shed Bright Light in a 40-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 40 feet, and the blade functions as a magic Longsword or Shortsword (your choice) that deals an extra 2d6 Fire damage on a hit.
• Button 2 The rod's flanged head folds down and two crescent-shaped blades spring out, transforming the rod into a magic Battleaxe that grants a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it.
• Button 3 The rod's flanged head folds down, a spear point springs from the rod's tip, and the rod's handle lengthens into a 6-foot haft, transforming the rod into a magic Spear that grants a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it.
• Button 4 The rod transforms into a climbing pole up to 50 feet long (you specify the length), though the rod's buttons remain within your reach. In surfaces as hard as granite, a spike at the bottom and three hooks at the top anchor the pole. Horizontal bars 3 inches long fold out from the sides, 1 foot apart, forming a ladder. The pole can bear up to 4,000 pounds. More weight or lack of solid anchoring causes the rod to revert to its normal form.
• Button 5 The rod transforms into a handheld battering ram and grants its user a +10 bonus to Strength (Athletics) checks made to break through doors, barricades, and other barriers.
• Button 6 The rod assumes or remains in its normal form and indicates magnetic north. (Nothing happens if this function of the rod is used in a location that has no magnetic north.) The rod also gives you knowledge of your approximate depth beneath the ground or your height above it.
Drain Life.
When you hit a creature with a melee attack using the rod, you can force the target to make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes an extra 4d6 Necrotic damage, and you regain a number of Hit Points equal to half that Necrotic damage. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.
Paralyze.
When you hit a creature with a melee attack using the rod, you can force the target to make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the Paralyzed condition for 1 minute. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.
Terrify.
While holding the rod, you can take a Magic action to force each creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself to make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute. A Frightened target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.
description.zh:
这把权杖顶端有尖刺状凸起，其可以被用作一把魔法硬头锤。你用此魔法武器进行的攻击检定和伤害掷骰获得+3加值。王者权杖的杖柄上排列着六个不同的按钮，用来启动权杖的相应属性，它还有三个额外词条。词条的描述见下文：
按钮.
你能够以一个附赠动作按压下列按钮之一。按钮的效应将持续生效，直至你按压另一个按钮或再次按压同一个按钮。再次按压同一个按钮将使权杖变回通常形态。
• 按钮1 烈焰覆盖的刀刃从权杖凸缘的另一端伸出。火焰发出半径40尺的明亮光照以及额外40尺的微光光照，剑刃可以被用作一柄魔法长剑或短剑（由你选择），命中时额外造成2d6火焰伤害。
• 按钮2 权杖凸缘头向下折叠，弹出两片月牙状斧刃，这使得权杖变为一柄魔法战斧。你用此魔法武器进行的攻击检定和伤害掷骰获得+3加值。
• 按钮3 权杖凸缘头向下折叠，杖柄顶端弹出矛尖，杖柄伸长至6尺，将权杖变为一把魔法矛。你用此魔法武器进行的攻击检定和伤害掷骰获得+3加值。
• 按钮4 权杖将变为一根至多50尺长的爬杆（长度由你指定），但权杖的按钮仍在你触及内。在花岗岩一般坚硬的表面上，爬杆尾部的岩钉和顶部的三个爪钩可以固定住爬杆。爬杆上每隔1尺向侧面伸展出一根3寸长的水平杆，构成一架梯子。爬杆最多可以承受4000磅的重量。如果超重或是失去固定点，则爬杆将会变回权杖。
• 按钮5 权杖将变为一把手持式攻城锤。用它破坏门、路障或其他障碍时，持用者进行的力量（运动）检定获得+10加值。
• 按钮 6 权杖将变回或维持通常形态，并指出地磁北极。（如果权杖所在的地点并没有地磁北极的概念，则此功能无效。）权杖还会让你了解到自己在地下的大致深度或在地上的高度。
汲取生命.
当你以权杖发动的近战攻击命中一名生物时，你可以迫使目标进行一次DC 17的体质豁免。豁免失败则目标额外受到4d6暗蚀伤害，而你恢复等于此暗蚀伤害值一半的生命值。该词条一经使用，直至次日黎明你都无法再次使用。
麻痹.
当你以权杖发动的近战攻击命中一名生物时，你可以迫使目标进行一次DC 17的体质豁免。豁免失败则目标陷入麻痹状态，持续1分钟。目标在其每回合结束时都可以重新豁免，豁免成功则结束该效应。该词条一经使用，直至次日黎明你都无法再次使用。
惊骇.
持握此权杖期间，你能够以一个魔法动作迫使位于你30尺内你可见的每名生物进行一次DC 17的感知豁免。豁免失败则目标将陷入恐慌状态，持续1分钟。陷入恐慌状态的目标在其每回合结束时都可以重新豁免，豁免成功则结束其身上的该效应。该词条一经使用，直至次日黎明你都无法再次使用。

description.en:
The rod has 5 charges. While you hold it, you can cast one of the following spells from it: Heal (expends 1 charge) or Resurrection (expends 5 charges).
The rod regains 1 expended charge daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the rod disappears in a harmless burst of radiance.
description.zh:
此权杖具有5充能。持握权杖期间，你可以从中施展以下法术之一：医疗术（消耗1充能）或复生术（消耗5充能）。
权杖在每日黎明时重获1已消耗的充能。当权杖充能耗尽时，投掷1d20。若结果为1，则权杖在一阵无害的光芒中消失。

description.en: You can take a Magic action to present the rod and command obedience from each creature of your choice that you can see within 120 feet of yourself. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for 8 hours. While Charmed in this way, the creature regards you as its trusted leader. If harmed by you or your allies or commanded to do something contrary to its nature, a target ceases to be Charmed in this way. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.
description.zh: 你可以执行魔法动作来展示这根权杖，并向你可见的，周身120尺内你所指定的每个生物下令服从于你。每个目标必须通过一次DC 15的感知豁免，否则陷入魅惑状态8小时。在以这种方式被魅惑期间，生物将视你为值得托付信赖的领袖。如果你或你的盟友伤害了目标，或命令目标去做违反其天性的行为时，以此法造成的魅惑将终止。该词条一经使用，直至次日黎明前你都无法再次使用。

description.en:
While holding this rod, you can take a Magic action to activate it. The rod then instantly transports you and up to 199 other willing creatures you can see to a demiplane. You choose the form the demiplane takes. It could be a tranquil garden, a cheery tavern, an immense palace, a tropical island, a fantastic carnival, or whatever else you can imagine. Regardless of its nature, the demiplane contains enough water and food to sustain its visitors, and the demiplane's environment can't harm its occupants. Everything else that can be interacted with there can exist only there. For example, a flower picked from a garden there disappears if it is taken outside the demiplane.
For each hour spent in the demiplane, a visitor regains Hit Points as if it had spent 1 Hit Point Die. Also, creatures don't age while there, although time passes normally. Visitors can remain there for up to 200 days divided by the number of creatures present (round down).
When the time runs out or you take a Magic action to end the effect, all visitors reappear in the location they occupied when you activated the rod or an unoccupied space nearest that location. Once used, this property can't be used again until 10 days have passed.
description.zh:
当持握这根权杖时，你可以执行魔法动作来激活它。权杖会立刻将你和你可见的至多199名自愿生物传送入一个半位面。你选择半位面所呈现的形式。它可以是宁静的花园、热闹的酒馆、宏伟的宫殿、热带岛屿、梦幻般的嘉年华，或者任何你能想象的场景。无论性质如何，这个半位面有足够的食物和水供访客享用，并且半位面的任何环境都无法伤害到其中的居住者们。此处一切可交互的事物都只能存在于该半位面中。例如，把半位面中花园里摘的花带出半位面时，该花将消失。
在半位面里每度过一个小时，访客们都能如同花费了1个生命值骰一般地恢复生命值。并且尽管半位面中时间将正常流动，但其中的生物不会变老。访客们可以在此停留最多200除以生物数量的天数（向下取整）。
当停留时间耗尽或你执行魔法动作以结束该效应时，所有访客都会重新出现在权杖激活前的位置或该位置最近的未占据的空间里。该词条被使用后，直至过去10天时间才能再次使用。

description.en: While holding this wand, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls. In addition, you ignore Half Cover when making a spell attack roll.

For 1 minute, you know the direction of the nearest creature Hostile to you within 60 feet, but not its distance from you. The wand can sense the presence of Hostile creatures that are Invisible, ethereal, disguised, or hidden, as well as those in plain sight. The effect ends if you stop holding the wand.
Regaining Charges.
The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

description.en:

The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the Paralyzed condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of the target's turns, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Regaining Charges.
The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.
description.zh:

description.en:
This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge while choosing a point within 120 feet of yourself. That location becomes the point of origin of a spell or other magical effect determined by rolling on the Wand of Wonder Effects table. Spells cast from the wand have a save DC of 15. If a spell's maximum range is normally less than 120 feet, it becomes 120 feet when cast from the wand. If an effect has multiple possible subjects, the DM determines randomly which among them are affected.
Regaining Charges.
The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into dust and is destroyed.
Wand of Wonder Effects
1d100 | Effect
01-20 | You cast a spell originating from the chosen point. Roll 1d10 to determine the spell: on a 1-2, Darkness; on a 3-4, Faerie Fire; on a 5-6, Fireball; on a 7-8, Slow; on a 9-10, Stinking Cloud.
21-25 | Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, you have the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn, believing something awesome just happened.
26-30 | You cast Gust of Wind. The Line created by the spell extends from you to the chosen point of origin.
31-35 | Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, you take 1d6 Psychic damage.
36-40 | Heavy rain falls for 1 minute in a 120-foot-high, 60-foot-radius Cylinder centered on the chosen point of origin. During that time, the area of effect is Lightly Obscured.
41-45 | A cloud of 600 oversized butterflies fills a 60-foot-high, 30-foot-radius Cylinder centered on the chosen point of origin. The butterflies remain for 10 minutes, during which time the area of effect is Heavily Obscured.
46-50 | You cast Lightning Bolt. The Line created by the spell extends from you to the chosen point of origin.
51-55 | The creature closest to the chosen point of origin is enlarged as if you had cast Enlarge/Reduce on it. If the target isn't you and can't be affected by that spell, you become the target instead.
56-60 | A magically formed creature appears in an unoccupied space as close to the chosen point of origin as possible. The creature isn't under your control, acts as it normally would, and disappears after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 Hit Points. Roll 1d4 to determine which creature appears. On a 1, a Rhinoceros appears; on a 2, an Elephant appears; and on a 3-4, a Rat appears.
61-64 | Grass covers a 60-foot-radius circle of ground, with the center of that circle as close to the chosen point of origin as possible. Grass that's already there grows to ten times its normal size and remains overgrown for 1 minute.
65-68 | An object of the DM's choice disappears into the Ethereal Plane. The object must be neither worn nor carried, within 120 feet of the chosen point of origin, and no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. If there are no such objects in range, nothing happens.
69-72 | Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, you shrink as if you had cast Enlarge/Reduce on yourself and remain in that state for 1 minute.
73-77 | Leaves grow from the creature nearest to the chosen point of origin. Unless they are picked off, the leaves turn brown and fall off after 24 hours.
78-82 | Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, a burst of colorful, shimmering light extends from you in a 30-foot Emanation. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded condition for 1 minute. A creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
83-87 | Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, you cast Invisibility on yourself.
88-92 | Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, a stream of 1d4 × 10 gems, each worth 1 GP, shoots from the wand's tip in a Line 30 feet long and 5 feet wide toward the chosen point of origin. Each gem deals 1 Bludgeoning damage, and the total damage of the gems is divided equally among all creatures in the Line.
93-97 | You cast Polymorph, targeting the creature closest to the chosen point of origin. Roll 1d4 to determine the target's new form. On a 1, the new form is a Black Bear; on a 2, the new form is a Giant Wasp; on a 3-4, the new form is a Frog.
98-00 | The creature closest to the chosen point of origin makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has the Restrained condition and begins to turn to stone. While Restrained in this way, the creature repeats the save at the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the effect ends. On a failed save, the creature has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the Greater Restoration spell or similar magic.
description.zh:
这根魔杖具有7充能。持握它时，你可以执行魔法动作并消耗1充能，并选择位于你120尺内的一点。那个位置变为由惊异魔杖效应表中骰出的法术或其他魔法效应的源点。从魔杖中施展的法术的豁免DC为15。如果一个法术的最大射程在正常情况下不足120尺，则当被魔杖释放时其射程变为120尺。若一种效应有多个可选目标，则DM随机决定其中哪个目标将被效应影响。
重获充能.
这根魔杖在每日黎明时重获1d6 + 1已消耗的充能。当充能数耗尽时，骰一次1d20。如果骰值为1，魔杖将化作飞灰并被摧毁。
惊异魔杖效应
1d100 | 效应
01-20 | 你在选择的源点处释放一个法术。投掷1d10来决定法术：结果1-2为黑暗术；结果3-4为妖火；结果5-6为火球术；结果7-8为缓慢术；结果9-10为臭云术 。
21-25 | 在选择的源点处无事发生。取而代之的是，你相信刚刚发生了什么令人惊叹的事，因此直到你的下个回合开始前，你陷入震慑状态。
26-30 | 你施展造风术。法术创造的线状区域将从你的位置延伸到选择的源点位置。
31-35 | 在选择的源点处无事发生。取而代之的是，你受到1d6心灵伤害。
36-40 | 在以选择的源点为中心，120尺高，半径60尺的柱状区域内下起持续1分钟的暴雨。持续时间内，效应区域处于轻度遮蔽。
41-45 | 在以选择的源点为中心，60尺高，半径30尺的柱状区域内被一团共600只的巨大蝴蝶填满。蝴蝶在10分钟内持续存在，并在持续时间内使效应区域处于重度遮蔽。
46-50 | 你释放闪电束。法术创造的线状区域将从你的位置延伸到选择的源点位置。
51-55 | 距离选择的源点最近的生物被变大，如同你对其释放了变巨/缩小术中的变巨一般。如果目标不是你且目标不受该法术影响，则你将代替成为目标。
56-60 | 一个以魔法塑成的生物出现在离源点尽可能近的未占据空间中。这个生物不受你控制，按照其天性行动且在1小时后或生命值降为0时消失。投掷1d4来决定会出现什么生物。结果为1时，出现一头犀牛；结果为2时，出现一头大象；结果为3-4时，出现一只老鼠。
61-64 | 以尽可能靠近选定源点的一点为圆心，草地将覆盖半径60尺内的圆形地面。原先已经长在区域内的草将生长至通常的十倍长度并维持1分钟。
65-68 | DM选择的一个物件消失并进入以太位面。这个物件必须未被着装或携带，任一边长不超过10尺，且位于选择的源点120尺内。如果范围内没有符合条件的物件，则无事发生。
69-72 | 在选择的源点处无事发生。取而代之的是你将变小，你对自己释放了变巨/缩小术中的缩小一般，并在这个状态持续1分钟。
73-77 | 离选择的源点最近的生物身上长出树叶。树叶将在24小时后变黄并凋落，除非它们被提前摘下。
78-82 | 在选择的源点处无事发生。取而代之的是你的身上迸发出多彩而耀眼的光芒，充斥30尺光环区域。区域内的所有生物需要成功通过一次DC 15的体质豁免否则陷入持续一分钟的目盲状态。目标在其每回合结束时可以重新进行这次豁免，豁免成功则终止其身上的效应。
83-87 | 在选择的源点处无事发生。取而代之的是，你对自身施展隐形术。
88-92 | 在选择的源点处无事发生。取而代之的是，一股共计1d4 × 10颗宝石的激流（每颗价值1GP）从法杖的尖端向着选择的源点处以30尺长，5尺宽的线状区域激射过去。每颗宝石造成1钝击伤害，宝石造成的总伤害将平均分配给线状范围内的所有生物。
93-97 | 你以选择的源点最近的生物为目标释放变形术。投掷1d4来决定目标的新形态：结果为1时，新形态为黑熊；结果为2时，新形态为巨黄蜂；结果为3-4时，新形态为青蛙 。
98-00 | 离选择的源点最近的生物进行一次DC 15的体质豁免。失败时，这个生物陷入束缚状态并开始转变为石头。当被以这种方式束缚时，目标在其下个回合结束时重复该豁免。如豁免通过则结束该效应。如豁免失败，生物陷入石化状态来代替束缚状态。石化将持续至这个生物被高等复原术法术或类似的魔法所释放。

description.en: Your Constitution score is 19 while you wear this amulet. It has no effect on you if your Constitution is already 19 or higher without it.
description.zh: 佩戴此护符期间，你的体质变为19。如果你的体质在未佩戴护符时已经大于或等于19，则护符不会起效。

id: amulet of proof against detection and location|xdmg

name.en: Amulet of Proof against Detection and Location

description.en: While wearing this amulet, you can't be targeted by Divination spells or perceived through magical scrying sensors unless you allow it.
description.zh: 佩戴此护符期间，除非你允许，否则你不能成为预言法术的目标，也无法被魔法传感器察觉。

description.en:
While wearing this amulet, you can take a Magic action to name a location that you are familiar with on another plane of existence. Then make a DC 15 Intelligence (Arcana) check. On a successful check, you cast Plane Shift. On a failed check, you and each creature and object within 15 feet of you travel to a random destination determined by rolling 1d100 and consulting the following table.
1d100 | Destination
01-60 | Random location on the plane you named
61-70 | Random location on an Inner Plane determined by rolling 1d6: on a 1, the Plane of Air; on a 2, the Plane of Earth; on a 3, the Plane of Fire; on a 4, the Plane of Water; on a 5, the Feywild; on a 6, the Shadowfell
71-80 | Random location on an Outer Plane determined by rolling 1d8: on a 1, Arborea; on a 2, Arcadia; on a 3, the Beastlands; on a 4, Bytopia; on a 5, Elysium; on a 6, Mechanus; on a 7, Mount Celestia; on an 8, Ysgard
81-90 | Random location on an Outer Plane determined by rolling 1d8: on a 1, the Abyss; on a 2, Acheron; on a 3, Carceri; on a 4, Gehenna; on a 5, Hades; on a 6, Limbo; on a 7, the Nine Hells; on an 8, Pandemonium
91-00 | Random location on the Astral Plane
description.zh:
佩戴此护符期间，你能够以一个魔法动作指名一个位于其他存在位面的你所熟悉的地点。那之后你进行一次DC 15的智力（奥秘）检定。如检定通过，你施展位面转移。如检定失败，你和位于你15尺内的每个生物与物件将被传送至一个由投掷1d100并根据下表决定的随机目的地。
1d100 | 目的地
01-60 | 与你指名地点同一位面的随机地点。
61-70 | 投掷1d6决定某内层位面中的随机地点：1气之位面；2土之位面；3火之位面；4水之位面；5妖精荒野；6堕影冥界。
71-80 | 投掷1d8决定某外层位面中的随机地点：1奔放之野；2世外桃源；3万兽乡；4双生天堂；5极乐境；6机械境；7天堂山；8伊斯加德。
81-90 | 投掷1d8决定某外层位面中的随机地点：1无底深渊；2修罗场；3卡瑟利；4焦炎火狱；5哈迪斯；6混沌海；7九层地狱；8喧癫空隧。
91-00 | 星界位面中的随机地点。

description.en:
This item first appears to be a sealed iron barrel weighing 500 pounds. The barrel has a hidden catch, which can be found with a successful DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check. Releasing the catch unlocks a hatch at one end of the barrel, allowing two Medium or smaller creatures to crawl inside. Ten levers are set in a row at the far end, each in a neutral position, able to move up or down. When certain levers are used, the apparatus transforms to resemble a giant lobster.
The Apparatus of Kwalish is a Large object with the following statistics: AC 20; HP 200; Speed 30 ft., Swim 30 ft. (or 0 ft. for both if the legs aren't extended); Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage.
To be used as a vehicle, the apparatus requires one pilot. While the apparatus's hatch is closed, the compartment is airtight and watertight. The compartment holds enough air for 10 hours of breathing, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside.
The apparatus floats on water. It can also go underwater to a depth of 900 feet. Below that, the vehicle takes 2d6 Bludgeoning damage each minute from pressure.
A creature in the compartment can take a Utilize action to move as many as two of the apparatus's levers up or down. After each use, a lever goes back to its neutral position. Each lever, from left to right, functions as shown in the Apparatus of Kwalish Levers table.
Apparatus of Kwalish Levers
Lever | Up | Down
1 | Legs extend, allowing the apparatus to walk and swim. | Legs retract, reducing the apparatus's Speed and Swim Speed to 0 and making it unable to benefit from bonuses to speed.
2 | Forward window shutter opens. | Forward window shutter closes.
3 | Side window shutters open (two per side). | Side window shutters close (two per side).
4 | Two claws extend from the front side of the apparatus. | The claws retract.
5 | Each extended claw makes the following melee attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage. | Each extended claw makes the following melee attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15).
6 | The apparatus walks or swims forward provided its legs are extended. | The apparatus walks or swims backward provided its legs are extended.
7 | The apparatus turns 90 degrees counterclockwise provided its legs are extended. | The apparatus turns 90 degrees clockwise provided its legs are extended.
8 | Eyelike fixtures emit Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. | The light turns off.
9 | The apparatus sinks up to 20 feet if it's in liquid. | The apparatus rises up to 20 feet if it's in liquid.
10 | The rear hatch unseals and opens. | The rear hatch closes and seals.
description.zh:
这件物品最初看起来是一个密封的铁制木桶，重达500磅。木桶有一个隐藏的开关，可以通过成功的DC 20智力（调查）检定发现。释放开关会解锁木桶一端的舱口，允许两个中型或更小的生物爬入内部。远端排列着十个操纵杆，每个都处于中立位置，可以上下移动。当使用特定操纵杆时，该装置会变形为类似一个巨大龙虾的外观。
夸力许装置是一个大型物件，并具有以下数据：AC 20；HP 200；速度 30尺，游泳速度 30尺（若装置腿部未展开则均为0尺）；免疫毒素和心灵伤害。
要将夸力许装置用作载具，需要一个飞行员。当装置的舱门关闭时，舱室是气密且防水的。舱室内的空气足够供10小时的呼吸，由内部呼吸的生物数量均分。
夸力许装置可以浮在水面上。它也可以下潜至900尺深的水下。超过这个深度，载具每分钟会受到来自压力的2d6点钝击伤害。
隔间内的生物可以采取一个操作动作来移动夸力许装置的两个拉杆向上或向下。每次使用后，拉杆会回到绝对中立位置。从左到右的每个拉杆功能如夸力许装置拉杆表格所示。
夸力许装置拉杆
拉杆 | Up | 下
1 | 腿部伸展，使装置能够行走和游泳。 | 腿部收缩，将夸力许装置的速度和游泳速度降为0，且无法从速度增益中获益。
2 | 前窗百叶窗打开。 | 前窗百叶窗关闭。
3 | 侧窗百叶窗打开（每侧两个）。 | 侧窗百叶窗关闭（每侧两个）。
4 | 装置前侧伸出两只爪子。 | 爪子收回。
5 | 每只钳爪发动如下近战攻击：+8，触及5尺。命中：：7（2d6）钝击伤害。 | 每只钳爪发动如下近战攻击：+8，触及5尺。命中：：目标陷入受擒状态（逃脱DC 15）。
6 | 夸力许装置在腿部伸展的情况下可以向前行走或游泳。 | 夸力许装置在腿部伸展的情况下可以向后行走或游泳。
7 | 夸力许装置在腿部伸展的情况下可以逆时针旋转90度。 | 夸力许装置在腿部伸展的情况下可以顺时针旋转90度。
8 | 眼状装置会发出半径30尺的明亮光照和额外30尺的微光光照。 | 灯光熄灭。
9 | 夸力许装置在液体中会下沉至多20尺。 | 夸力许装置在液体中可上升至20尺高。
10 | 后舱门解锁并打开。 | 后舱门关闭并密封。

description.en:
This heavy cloth bag contains 3d4 dry beans when found. The bag weighs half a pound regardless of how many beans it contains and becomes a nonmagical item when it no longer contains any beans.
If you dump one or more beans out of the bag, they explode in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on them. All the dumped beans are destroyed in the explosion, and each creature in the Sphere, including you, makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d4 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
If you remove a bean from the bag, plant it in dirt or sand, and then water it, the bean disappears as it produces an effect 1 minute later from the ground where it was planted. The DM can choose an effect from the following table or determine it randomly.
1d100 | Effect
01 | 5d4 toadstools sprout. If a creature eats a toadstool, roll any die. On an odd roll, the eater must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 5d6 Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition for 1 hour. On an even roll, the eater gains 5d6 Temporary Hit Points for 1 hour.
02-10 | A geyser erupts and spouts water, beer, mayonnaise, tea, vinegar, wine, or oil (DM's choice) 30 feet into the air for 1d4 minutes.
11-20 | A Treant sprouts. Roll any die. On an odd roll, the treant is Chaotic Evil. On an even roll, the treant is Chaotic Good.
21-30 | An animate but immobile stone statue in your likeness rises and makes verbal threats against you. If you leave it and others come near, it describes you as the most heinous of villains and directs the newcomers to find and attack you. If you are on the same plane of existence as the statue, it knows where you are. The statue becomes inanimate after 24 hours.
31-40 | A campfire with green flames springs forth and burns for 24 hours or until it is extinguished.
41-50 | Three Shrieker Fungi sprout.
51-60 | 1d4 + 4 bright-pink toads crawl forth. Whenever a toad is touched, it transforms into a Large or smaller monster of the DM's choice that acts in accordance with its alignment and nature. The monster remains for 1 minute, then disappears in a puff of bright-pink smoke.
61-70 | A hungry Bulette burrows up and attacks.
71-80 | A fruit tree grows. It has 1d10 + 20 fruit, 1d8 of which act as randomly determined potions. The tree vanishes after 1 hour. Picked fruit remains, retaining any magic for 30 days.
81-90 | A nest of 1d4 + 3 rainbow-colored eggs springs up. Any creature that eats an egg makes a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, a creature permanently increases its lowest ability score by 1, randomly choosing among equally low scores. On a failed save, the creature takes 10d6 Force damage from an internal explosion.
91-95 | A pyramid with a 60-foot-square base bursts upward. Inside is a burial chamber containing a Mummy, a Mummy Lord, or some other Undead of the DM's choice. Its sarcophagus contains treasure of the DM's choice.
96-00 | A giant beanstalk sprouts, growing to a height of the DM's choice. The top leads where the DM chooses, such as to a great view, a cloud giant's castle, or another plane of existence.
description.zh:
这个沉重的布袋被找到时装着3d4颗干燥的豆子。不论布袋中装了多少颗豆子，它都重半磅，并在其内部不再包含豆子时变为非魔法物品。
如果你把一颗或更多豆子倒出，则它们将以自己为中心引发半径10尺球状的爆炸，其周围半径10尺球状包括你在内的每个生物进行一次DC 15的敏捷豁免。豁免失败者将受到5d4点力场伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。所有被倒出的豆子都将在爆炸中被摧毁。
如果你从布袋中取出1颗豆子，种入泥土或沙子中并浇上水，1分钟后，豆子将会消失并在其被种下的区域中产生一种效应。由DM在表格中选择或骰骰子在表格中随机决定。
1d100 | 效应
01 | 长出5d4个毒蕈。吃掉毒蕈的生物必须掷一个任意面数的骰子。如果骰值为奇数，则食用者必须进行一次DC 15的体质豁免，豁免失败则受5d6点毒素伤害并陷入中毒状态1小时。如果骰值为偶数，则食用者获得5d6点临时生命值，效应持续1小时。
02-10 | 喷出一股间歇泉喷涌达30尺高，持续1d4分钟，喷出的可以是水、啤酒、蛋黄酱、茶、醋、葡萄酒或者油（由DM决定）。
11-20 | 长出一个树人。掷一个任意面数的骰子，如果骰值为奇数，此树人的阵营为混乱邪恶；如果骰值为偶数，则此树人的阵营为混乱善良。
21-30 | 一座和你外表相仿但不可移动的活化石雕从地上升起。它会用言语威胁你。如果你离开石雕而其他人靠近它，它就会把你描述成最卑劣的恶棍并引导他们去攻击你。只要你和雕像身处同一位面，它就可以知道你的位置。雕像的活化状态在24小时后终止。
31-40 | 出现一团跃动着绿色火焰的篝火，其效应持续24小时或直到它被熄灭。
41-50 | 长出三只尖叫菌
51-60 | 爬出1d4 + 4只亮粉色的蟾蜍Toads。蟾蜍被触碰时会变成一只大型或更小体型的怪物（由DM选择）并依照其阵营和本性行动。怪物存在1分钟，然后消失在一阵粉红色的烟雾中。
61-70 | 一只饥饿的鲨蜥从地下爬出来并发起攻击。
71-80 | 长出一棵果树。树上有1d10 + 20个水果，其中1d8个作用相当于随机决定的药水。果树将在1小时后消失，但摘下来的水果仍保留，其魔法保持30天。
81-90 | 出现一窝1d4 + 3个彩虹色的蛋。任何食用了一颗蛋的生物进行一次DC 20的体质豁免，成功则其最低一项属性永久提升1，多个属性同为最低则随机选定。豁免失败则该生物体内发生爆炸，受到10d6点力场伤害。
91-95 | 一座占地为60尺方形区域的金字塔从地下升起。金字塔内的墓室中有一只木乃伊或一名木乃伊领主或其他由DM决定的亡灵。墓室石棺内的宝藏由DM决定。
96-00 | 一颗巨大的豌豆茎从地下长出，其高度由DM决定。茎的顶端通往DM选择的地点，例如一处宏伟的景点，一座云巨人的城堡，或是另一存在位面。

description.en:
This bag resembles a Bag of Holding but is a feeding orifice for a gigantic extradimensional creature. Turning the bag inside out closes the orifice.
The extradimensional creature attached to the bag can sense whatever is placed inside the bag. Animal or vegetable matter placed wholly in the bag is devoured and lost forever. When part of a living creature is placed in the bag, as happens when someone reaches inside it, there is a 50% chance that the creature is pulled inside the bag. A creature inside the bag can take an action to try to escape, doing so with a successful DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check. Another creature can take an action to reach into the bag to pull a creature out, doing so with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check, provided the puller isn't pulled inside the bag first. Any creature that starts its turn inside the bag is devoured, its body destroyed.
Inanimate objects can be stored in the bag, which can hold a cubic foot of such material. However, once each day, the bag swallows any objects inside it and spits them out into another plane of existence. The DM determines the time and plane.
If the bag is pierced or torn, it is destroyed, and anything contained within it is transported to a random location on the Astral Plane.
description.zh:
这个类似于次元袋的袋子实际上是某个巨大异次元生物的进食口。将袋子内外翻转就可以关闭进食口的通道。
与这个袋子关联的异次元生物可以感知到任何放入袋中的东西。完整放入袋中的动物或植物将被吞噬而永久消失。活物的一部分被放入袋中时（例如有人把手伸入袋子里时），该生物有50%概率被拖入袋中。进入袋中的生物能够以一个动作进行一次DC 15的力量（运动）检定以从中逃脱。另一个生物能够以一个动作 进行一次DC 20的力量（运动）检定来将被吞噬的生物拉出来，前提是该生物自己没被拖入袋中。任何在袋中开始其自己回合的生物都将被吞噬，其躯体被摧毁。
无生命物件可以存放在袋子里，袋子至多可容纳1立方尺的东西。此外，该袋子每日会有一次将其内的所有物件吐到另一存在位面。具体哪个位面由DM决定。
袋子被戳破或撕裂时即被摧毁。其内的所有东西都将被传送到星界位面的随机地点。

description.en:
This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its outside dimensions—roughly 2 feet square and 4 feet deep on the inside. The bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. The bag weighs 5 pounds, regardless of its contents. Retrieving an item from the bag requires a Utilize action.
If the bag is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it is destroyed, and its contents are scattered in the Astral Plane. If the bag is turned inside out, its contents spill forth unharmed, but the bag must be put right before it can be used again. The bag holds enough air for 10 minutes of breathing, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside.
Placing a Bag of Holding inside an extradimensional space created by a Heward's Handy Haversack, Portable Hole, or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where the one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on the gate is sucked through it to a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way and can't be reopened.
description.zh:
这个袋子有着比外表尺寸看起来更大的内部实际空间，从内部看，袋口约两平方尺，深约4尺，可以容纳至多500磅，体积不超过64立方尺的东西。无论装了什么，这个袋子总是重5磅。从袋子里取出东西需要花费一个操作动作。
如果次元袋超载，或是袋子被戳破、撕裂，它将因此被摧毁，它所装载的东西将散落到星界位面各处。如果袋子被内外翻转，则它所装载的东西将完好无损地掉落出来，但再次使用袋子之前必须将它恢复原状。次元袋内所容纳的空气量可供其内生物呼吸的分钟数为10除以袋内正在呼吸的生物数量，此后袋内的生物便开始窒息。
把次元袋放入霍华德便利袋、球状或其他类似物品内时，将会立即同时摧毁两件物品并打开一扇通往星界位面的传送门扉。门扉产生于放入另一物品的第一件物品的所在地。任何在门扉周边10尺球状区域内的生物将被吸入门内，并送往星界位面中的随机地点。然后门扉即时关闭，门的通道是单向的且无法被再次打开。

description.en:
This bag made from gray cloth appears empty. Reaching inside the bag, however, reveals the presence of a small, fuzzy object.
You can take a Magic action to pull the fuzzy object from the bag and throw it up to 20 feet. When the object lands, it transforms into a creature you determine by rolling on the table below. See the Monster Manual for the creature's stat block. The creature vanishes at the next dawn or when it is reduced to 0 Hit Points.
The creature is Friendly to you and your allies, and it acts immediately after you on your Initiative count. You can take a Bonus Action to command how the creature moves and what action it takes on its next turn, such as attacking an enemy. In the absence of such orders, the creature acts in a fashion appropriate to its nature.
Once three fuzzy objects have been pulled from the bag, the bag can't be used again until the next dawn.
1d8 | Creature
1 | Weasel
2 | Giant Rat
3 | Badger
4 | Boar
5 | Panther
6 | Giant Badger
7 | Dire Wolf
8 | Giant Elk
description.zh:
这种布袋由灰色布料制成。布袋看起来空无一物，但把手伸进去会摸到一个小小的毛绒物件。
你能够以一个魔法动作取出布袋里的毛绒物件，并把它扔出至多20尺远。当物件落地时，投骰子参考对应颜色布袋的表格决定物件变成的生物。相关生物的资料见怪物图鉴。该生物在次日黎明时分或者其生命值降至0时消失。
扔出的生物对你和你的盟友态度友好，且会在你的先攻序位后行动。你能够以一个附赠动作命令该生物在其下一回合执行特定的移动方式，做特定的动作，例如攻击你的敌人。没接到命令时，该生物按自己天性行动。
一旦袋子抽出三件毛绒物件后，直至次日黎明才可再次使用。
1d8 | 生物
1 | 鼬
2 | 巨鼠
3 | 獾
4 | 野猪
5 | 豹
6 | 巨獾
7 | 恐狼
8 | 巨赤鹿

2 | 猿
3 | 狒狒
4 | 斧嘴鸟
5 | 黑熊
6 | 巨鼬
7 | 巨鬣狗
8 | 老虎

description.en:
This small black sphere measures 3/4 of an inch in diameter and weighs an ounce. Typically, 1d4 + 4 Beads of Force are found together.
You can take a Magic action to throw the bead up to 60 feet. The bead explodes in a 10-foot-radius Sphere on impact and is destroyed. Each creature in the Sphere must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 5d4 Force damage. A sphere of transparent force then encloses the area for 1 minute. Any creature that failed the save and is completely within the area is trapped inside this sphere. Creatures that succeeded on the save or are partially within the area are pushed away from the center of the sphere until they are no longer inside it. Only breathable air can pass through the sphere's wall. No attack or other effect can pass through.
An enclosed creature can take a Utilize action to push against the sphere's wall, moving the sphere up to half the creature's Speed. The sphere can be picked up, and its magic causes it to weigh only 1 pound, regardless of the weight of creatures inside.
description.zh:
这个小型黑色球体直径3/4寸，重1/2盎司。被发现时通常都会有1d4 + 4颗珠子放在一起。
你能够以一个魔法动作把珠子扔出至多60尺远。珠子在落点处引发爆炸并因此被摧毁，其周围半径10尺球状内每个生物必须进行一次DC 15的敏捷豁免，豁免失败者受到5d4点力场伤害。此外，球型的隐形力场将封闭该球状1分钟。任何豁免失败且完全处于范围中的生物会被困在里面。豁免成功或部分处于范围中的生物会沿着远离球型中心的方向被推出范围。攻击或其他效应无法进入球型力场，但供呼吸的空气可以顺利流通。
被困在内部的生物能够以一个操作动作推动力场障壁，移动至多相当于该生物速度一半的距离。这个球型障壁也可以被拿起。无论内部的生物有多重，力场珠整体的重量都只有1磅。

description.en: This flavorless, gelatinous bead dissolves on your tongue and provides as much nourishment as 1 day of Rations.
description.zh: 这个没有味道的凝胶珠子在你的舌头上溶解时，它会为你提供等同于一天份口粮的营养。

description.en: While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 27. The item has no effect on you if your Strength without the belt is equal to or greater than the belt's score.
description.zh: 穿戴此腰带期间，你的力量值变为27。如果你未着装该腰带的情况下，力量值已经大于或等于腰带赋予的数值，则此物品无效。

description.en:
While wearing this belt, you gain the following benefits:
• Dwarvish You know Dwarvish.
• Friend of Dwarvenkind You have Advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to interact with dwarves and duergar.
• Toughness Your Constitution increases by 2, to a maximum of 20.
• In addition, while attuned to the belt, you have a 50% chance each day at dawn of growing a full beard if you can grow one, or a thicker beard if you already have one.
• If you aren't a dwarf or duergar, you gain the following additional benefits while wearing the belt:
• Darkvision You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.
• Resilience You have Resistance to Poison damage. You also have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.
description.zh:
穿戴此腰带期间，你获得以下增益：
• 矮人语 你懂得矮人语。
• 矮人之友 你进行与矮人和灰矮人互动的魅力（游说）检定时具有优势。
• 刚毅 你的体质提升2，至多提升至20。
• 此外，与此腰带同调期间，如果你能够长出胡须，则在每天的黎明时分你有50%的概率长出一大把胡子；如果你已经长有胡须，则你的胡须会明显变得更厚。
• 如果你不是一名矮人或灰矮人，你在着装此腰带期间获得以下额外的增益：
• 黑暗视觉 你拥有 60 尺黑暗视觉。
• 韧性 你具有毒素伤害的抗性。此外，你为避免/结束中毒状态所做的豁免检定具有优势。

description.en: While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 25. The item has no effect on you if your Strength without the belt is equal to or greater than the belt's score.
description.zh: 穿戴此腰带期间，你的力量值变为25。如果你未着装该腰带的情况下，力量值已经大于或等于腰带赋予的数值，则此物品无效。

description.zh: 穿戴此腰带期间，你的力量值变为29。如果你未着装该腰带的情况下，力量值已经大于或等于腰带赋予的数值，则此物品无效。

description.en: While you wear these boots, your steps make no sound, regardless of the surface you are moving across. You also have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
description.zh: 着装这双靴子期间，无论在何种表面上移动，你都不会发出脚步声。你进行敏捷（隐匿）检定时具有优势。

description.en: While you wear these boots, you can cast Levitate on yourself.
description.zh: 着装这双靴子期间，你可以对自身施放法术浮空术。

description.en:
While you wear these boots, you can take a Bonus Action to click the boots' heels together. If you do, the boots double your Speed, and any creature that makes an Opportunity Attack against you has Disadvantage on the attack roll. If you click your heels together again, you end the effect.
When you've used the boots' property for a total of 10 minutes, the magic ceases to function for you until you finish a Long Rest.
description.zh:
着装这双靴子期间，你可以使用一个附赠动作来互击脚后跟。若如此做，你的速度将加倍，且任何生物对你发动借机攻击时都具有劣势。若再次互击脚后跟则该效应终止。
在你使用该靴子的词条共计10分钟后，其魔法效应将不再对你生效，直至你完成一次长休。

description.en:
While you wear these boots, your Speed becomes 30 feet unless your Speed is higher, and your Speed isn't reduced by you carrying weight in excess of your carrying capacity or wearing Heavy Armor.
Once on each of your turns, you can jump up to 30 feet by spending only 10 feet of movement.
description.zh:
着装这双靴子期间，你的速度变为30尺，除非你原本的速度更快。且你的速度不会因为携带物品超重或者着装重甲而降低。
你的每个回合限一次，你可以只消耗10尺移动力来跳跃至多30尺。

description.en:
These furred boots are snug and feel warm. While wearing them, you gain the following benefits.
Cold Resistance.
You have Resistance to Cold damage and can tolerate temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower without any additional protection.
Winter Strider.
You ignore Difficult Terrain created by ice or snow.
description.zh:
这双加绒靴子温暖且舒适。着装这双靴子期间，你获得以下增益：
冷冻抗性.
你获得寒冷伤害的抗性，并且可以在没有额外保护的情况下忍受0华氏度及以下的温度。
冬日行者.
你可以无视冰雪造成的困难地形。

description.en:
While this bowl is filled with water and you are within 5 feet of it, you can take a Magic action to summon a Water Elemental. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the bowl as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action. The bowl can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
The bowl is about 1 foot in diameter and half as deep. It holds about 3 gallons.
description.zh:
当你位于这件水钵5尺内且其中盛满水期间，你能够以一个魔法动作来召唤一只水元素。水元素会出现在距离水钵最近的未被占据的空间、理解你所说的语言、服从你的命令、使用你的先攻值并在你之后立即执行其回合。水元素会在1小时后，或它死亡时，或你以一个附赠动作解消时消失。直到次日黎明前，水钵都无法再以该方式进行使用。
水钵直径约1尺，深约半尺。它的重量为3磅，能装承大约3加仑水。

description.en: While wearing these bracers, you have proficiency with the Longbow and Shortbow, and you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls made with such weapons.
description.zh: 着装这对护腕期间，你获得长弓和短弓的熟练项，且你使用这两种武器造成的伤害掷骰获得 +2 加值。

description.en: While wearing these bracers, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class if you are wearing no armor and using no Shield.
description.zh: 着装这对护腕期间，如果你没有穿着护甲也没有使用盾牌，则你的护甲等级获得 +2 加值。

description.en: While you are within 5 feet of this brazier, you can take a Magic action to summon a Fire Elemental. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the brazier as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action. The brazier can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
description.zh: 当你位于这座火盆5尺内期间，你能够以一个魔法动作来召唤一只火元素。火元素会出现在距离火盆最近的未被占据的空间、理解你所说的语言、服从你的命令、使用你的先攻值并在你之后立即执行其回合。火元素会在1小时后，或它死亡时，或你以一个附赠动作解消时消失。直到次日黎明前，火盆都无法再以该方式进行使用。

description.en: While wearing this brooch, you have Resistance to Force damage, and you have Immunity to damage from the Magic Missile spell.
description.zh: 佩戴此胸针期间，你获得对力场伤害的抗性，并免疫法术魔法飞弹的伤害。

description.en:
This wooden broom functions like a mundane broom until you stand astride it and take a Magic action to make it hover beneath you, at which time it can be ridden in the air. It has a Fly Speed of 50 feet. It can carry up to 400 pounds, but its Fly Speed becomes 30 feet while carrying over 200 pounds. The broom stops hovering when you land or when you're no longer riding it.
As a Magic action, you can send the broom to travel alone to a destination within 1 mile of you if you name the location and are familiar with it. The broom comes back to you when you take a Magic action and use a command word if the broom is still within 1 mile of you.
description.zh:
这把扫帚在平时如同一把普通的扫帚，你可以骑在它上面并使用一个魔法动作让它悬浮在你身下，此时它可以载着你在空中飞行。它的飞行速度为50尺，最多可载重400磅，但200磅以上的载重会将它的飞行速度降低到30尺。扫帚在你着陆或不再骑乘时便会停止悬浮。
以一个魔法动作，你可以指名1英里内一个你熟悉的地点，并令扫帚自行飞往该处。而如果扫帚在你周围1英里以内，你也能够以一个魔法动作让它自行回到你的身边。

description.en:
This candle's magic is activated when the candle is lit, which requires a Magic action. After burning for 4 hours, the candle is destroyed. You can snuff it out early for use at a later time. Deduct the time it burned in increments of 1 minute from its total burn time.
While lit, the candle sheds Dim Light in a 30-foot radius. While you are within that light, you have Advantage on D20 Tests. In addition, a Cleric or Druid in the light can cast level 1 spells they have prepared without expending spell slots.
Alternatively, when you light the candle for the first time, you can cast Gate with it. Doing so destroys the candle. The portal created by the spell links to a particular Outer Plane chosen by the DM or determined by rolling on the following table.
1d100 | Outer Plane
01-05 | Abyss
06-10 | Acheron
11-17 | Arborea
18-25 | Arcadia
26-33 | Beastlands
34-41 | Bytopia
42-46 | Carceri
47-54 | Elysium
55-59 | Gehenna
60-64 | Hades
65-69 | Limbo
70-77 | Mechanus
78-85 | Mount Celestia
86-90 | Nine Hells
91-95 | Pandemonium
96-00 | Ysgard
description.zh:
你可以用一个魔法动作点燃蜡烛，此时它的魔力便会被激活。蜡烛共可以燃烧4小时，你也可以提前吹灭蜡烛以备将来之用。以分钟为单位计算蜡烛已燃烧时间，并从总时间内扣除。
蜡烛燃烧期间，它会散发出半径30尺范围的微光光照光照。位于此光照范围内期间，你所进行的D20 检定具有优势。此外，此光照范围内的牧师和德鲁伊在施展它们准备了的1环法术时无需消耗法术位。
另外，当你首次点亮祈神蜡烛时，你可以用它施展一次法术异界之门。这样做会立刻摧毁这根蜡烛，而此法术所创造的传送门会连接至某一特定的外层位面，由DM选择或掷以下表格决定：
1d100 | 外层位面
01-05 | 无底深渊
06-10 | 修罗场
11-17 | 奔放之野
18-25 | 世外桃源
26-33 | 万兽乡
34-41 | 双生天堂
42-46 | 卡瑟利
47-54 | 极乐境
55-59 | 焦炎火狱
60-64 | 哈迪斯
65-69 | 混沌海
70-77 | 机械境
78-85 | 天界山
86-90 | 九层地狱
91-95 | 喧癫空隧
96-00 | 伊斯加德

description.en:
This cape smells faintly of brimstone. While wearing it, you can use it to cast Dimension Door as a Magic action. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.
When you teleport with that spell, you leave behind a cloud of smoke. The space you left is Lightly Obscured by that smoke until the end of your next turn.
description.zh:
这件披风闻起来有一股淡淡的硫磺味。着装该披肩期间，你可以用一个魔法动作施展法术任意门。该属性一经使用，直至次日黎明前都无法再次使用。
以此施展该法术时，你将在消失的原地留下一团烟雾，之后你伴随着一团类似的烟雾出现在目的地。出现在你离开和到达的位置上的烟雾会造成轻度遮蔽，它在下一个你的回合结束时消散。

description.en:
You can make this carpet hover and fly by taking a Magic action and using the carpet's command word. It moves according to your directions if you are within 30 feet of it.
A 3 ft. × 5 ft. carpet can carry up to 200 lb. at a fly speed of 80 feet. A carpet can carry up to twice the weight shown on the table, but its Fly Speed is halved if it carries more than its normal capacity.
description.zh:
你可以用一个魔法动作，说出飞毯的命令词来让它起飞或悬停。只要你在飞毯周围30尺内，它就会按照你的指示移动。
一块3英尺×5英尺的地毯可以承载最多200磅的重量，并以80英尺的速度飞行。飞毯的载重上限为正常载重的两倍，但超过正常载重时飞毯的飞行速度减半。

description.en:
You can make this carpet hover and fly by taking a Magic action and using the carpet's command word. It moves according to your directions if you are within 30 feet of it.
A 4 ft. × 6 ft. carpet can carry up to 400 lb. at a fly speed of 60 feet. A carpet can carry up to twice the weight shown on the table, but its Fly Speed is halved if it carries more than its normal capacity.
description.zh:
你可以用一个魔法动作，说出飞毯的命令词来让它起飞或悬停。只要你在飞毯周围30尺内，它就会按照你的指示移动。
一块4英尺×6英尺的地毯可以承载最多400磅的重量，飞行速度为60英尺。飞毯的载重上限为正常载重的两倍，但超过正常载重时飞毯的飞行速度减半。

description.en:
You can make this carpet hover and fly by taking a Magic action and using the carpet's command word. It moves according to your directions if you are within 30 feet of it.
A 5 ft. × 7 ft. carpet can carry up to 600 lb. at a fly speed of 40 feet. A carpet can carry up to twice the weight shown on the table, but its Fly Speed is halved if it carries more than its normal capacity.
description.zh:
你可以用一个魔法动作，说出飞毯的命令词来让它起飞或悬停。只要你在飞毯周围30尺内，它就会按照你的指示移动。
一块5英尺×7英尺的地毯最多可以承载600磅，飞行速度为40英尺。飞毯的载重上限为正常载重的两倍，但超过正常载重时飞毯的飞行速度减半。

description.en:
You can make this carpet hover and fly by taking a Magic action and using the carpet's command word. It moves according to your directions if you are within 30 feet of it.
A 6 ft. × 9 ft. carpet can carry up to 800 lb. at a fly speed of 30 feet. A carpet can carry up to twice the weight shown on the table, but its Fly Speed is halved if it carries more than its normal capacity.
description.zh:
你可以用一个魔法动作，说出飞毯的命令词来让它起飞或悬停。只要你在飞毯周围30尺内，它就会按照你的指示移动。
一张6英尺×9英尺的地毯可以携带最多800磅的重量，飞行速度为30英尺。飞毯的载重上限为正常载重的两倍，但超过正常载重时飞毯的飞行速度减半。

description.en: While gently swinging this censer, you can take a Magic action to summon an Air Elemental. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the censer as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action. The censer can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
description.zh: 当你轻轻挥动这件香炉期间，你可以用一个魔法动作来召唤一只气元素。气元素会出现在距离香炉最近的未被占据的空间、理解你所说的语言、服从你的命令、使用你的先攻并在你之后立即执行其回合。气元素会在1小时后、或它死亡时、或你用一个附赠动作解消时消失。直到次日黎明前，香炉都无法再以该方式进行使用。

description.en: This hollow metal tube measures about 1 foot long and weighs 1 pound. As a Magic action, you can strike the chime to cast Knock. The spell's customary knocking sound is replaced by the clear, ringing tone of the chime, which is audible out to 300 feet. The chime can be used 10 times. After the tenth time, it cracks and becomes useless.
description.zh: 这种空心金属管长约1尺，重1磅。你可以用一个魔法动作敲击它以施展法术敲击术。此时，该法术中响亮的敲击声将被钟琴清晰的声音所取代，其声响最远 300 尺内都能听见。开门钟琴可使用 10 次。使用 10 次后，它将碎裂并失去它的能力。

description.en: While wearing this circlet, you can cast Scorching Ray with it (+5 to hit). The circlet can't cast this spell again until the next dawn.
description.zh: 穿戴该头饰期间，你可以用其施展法术灼热射线（命中+5）。直到次日黎明前，头饰都无法施展该法术。

description.en:
This fine garment is made of black silk interwoven with faint, silvery threads. While wearing it, you gain the following benefits.
Poison Resistance.
You have Resistance to Poison damage.
Spider Climb.
You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed and can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings, while leaving your hands free.
Spider Walk.
You can't be caught in webs of any sort and can move through webs as if they were Difficult Terrain.
Web.
You can cast Web (save DC 13). The web created by the spell fills twice its normal area. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.
description.zh:
这件精美的服饰由黑色丝绸制成，其中交织着隐约可见的银色丝线。着装此斗篷期间，你获得以下增益：
毒素抗性.
你获得对毒素伤害的抗性。
蛛行术.
你获得与速度相等的攀爬速度，能够在垂直表面上下或横向移动，甚至可以在天花板上倒挂着移动而不需要用到双手。
蛛网行走.
你不会被任何种类的蛛网困住，在移动穿过蛛网时你将其视为等同于困难地形。
蛛网术.
你可以施展蛛网术（DC 13）。该法术创造的蛛网将覆盖普通蛛网术正常区域的两倍。该词条一经使用，直至次日黎明前都无法再次使用。

description.en: While you wear this cloak, it magically projects an illusion that makes you appear to be standing in a place near your actual location, causing any creature to have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. If you take damage, the property ceases to function until the start of your next turn. This property is suppressed while your Speed is 0.
description.zh: 着装此斗篷期间，它将魔法性地投射出你的幻影，使你看起来像是站在一个和你实际位置稍有偏差的地方。任何生物对你的攻击检定都将具有劣势。你受到伤害时斗篷会暂时失效，直至你的下一回合开始恢复效应。当你的速度为0时，该词条将被压制。

description.en: While you wear this cloak, Wisdom (Perception) checks made to perceive you have Disadvantage, and you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
description.zh: 着装此斗篷期间，任何为感知到你所做的感知（察觉）检定都将具有劣势，且你为躲藏所进行的敏捷（隐匿）检定具有优势。

description.en: This cloak has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the cloak, you can take a Magic action to pull its hood over your head and expend 1 charge to give yourself the Invisible condition for 1 hour. The effect ends early if you pull the hood down (no action required) or cease wearing the cloak.
description.zh: 这件斗篷有3点充能，并在每日拂晓时恢复1d3点已消耗的充能。当你穿着这件斗篷时，你可以用一个魔法动作拉起兜帽并消耗1点充能，使你获得隐形状态，持续1小时。如果你拉下兜帽（无需动作）或不再穿着这件斗篷，该效应提前结束。

roll20Modifiers: Item Type: Wondrous Item, AC +1, Saving Throws +1

description.en: You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws while you wear this cloak.
description.zh: 着装此斗篷期间，你的护甲等级和豁免获得+1加值。

description.en:
While wearing this cloak, you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. In an area of Dim Light or Darkness, you can grip the edges of the cloak and use it to gain a Fly Speed of 40 feet. If you ever fail to grip the cloak's edges while flying in this way, or if you are no longer in Dim Light or Darkness, you lose this Fly Speed.
While wearing the cloak in an area of Dim Light or Darkness, you can cast Polymorph on yourself, shape-shifting into a Bat. While in that form, you retain your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. The cloak can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
description.zh:
着装此斗篷期间，你的敏捷（隐匿）检定具有优势。在微光光照或黑暗的环境中，你可以抓住斗篷的边沿，利用它以获得40尺的飞行速度。如果你在以此法飞行时不再抓住斗篷边沿或不再处于微光光照或黑暗环境中，则你失去此飞行速度。
着装此斗篷且身处微光光照或黑暗环境期间，你可以用一个动作对自己施展法术变形术，并以此变成一只蝙蝠。你在变成蝙蝠时保留自身的智力、感知和魅力属性。该词条一经使用，直至次日黎明前都无法再次使用。

description.en: While wearing this cloak, you can breathe underwater, and you have a Swim Speed of 60 feet.
description.zh: 着装此斗篷期间，你能在水下呼吸，并具有60尺游泳速度。

description.en: While touching this crystal orb, you can cast Scrying (save DC 17) with it.
description.zh: 当你触摸这个水晶法球时，你可以通过它施展探知术（豁免DC 17）。

description.en: While touching this crystal orb, you can cast Scrying (save DC 17) with it. In addition, you can cast Detect Thoughts (save DC 17) targeting creatures you can see within 30 feet of the spell's sensor. You don't need to concentrate on this Detect Thoughts spell to maintain it during its duration, but it ends if the Scrying spell ends.
description.zh: 在你接触该水晶球期间，你可以用它施展法术探知术（豁免DC 17）。此外，你可以对该法术传感器周围30尺之内你可见的生物施展侦测思想（豁免DC 17）。该侦测思想法术持续期间你无需为其保持专注，但如果探知术法术终止，则它也将随之终止。

description.en: While touching this crystal orb, you can cast Scrying (save DC 17) with it. In addition, you can communicate telepathically with creatures you can see within 30 feet of the spell's sensor. You can also cast Suggestion (save DC 17) through the sensor on one of those creatures. You don't need to concentrate on this Suggestion to maintain it during its duration, but it ends if Scrying ends. You can't cast Suggestion in this way again until the next dawn.
description.zh: 在你接触该水晶球期间，你可以用它施展法术探知术（豁免DC 17）。此外，你可以与该法术传感器周围30尺之内你可见的生物以心灵感应的方式进行交流。你还可以通过传感器对这些生物中的一个施展暗示术（豁免DC 17）。该暗示术持续期间内你无需为它保持专注，但如果探知术终止它也将随之终止。以此法施展暗示术后，这颗水晶球直到次日黎明前都无法再次用于该用途。

description.en: While touching this crystal orb, you can cast Scrying (save DC 17) with it. In addition, you have Truesight with a range of 120 feet centered on the spell's sensor.
description.zh: 在你接触该水晶球期间，你可以用它施展法术探知术（豁免DC 17）。此外，你获得以该法术传感器为中心，半径120尺的真实视觉。

description.en:
This cube is about an inch across. Each face has a distinct marking on it. You can press one of those faces, expend the number of charges required for it, and thereby cast the spell associated with it (save DC 17), as shown in the Cube of Force Faces table.
The cube starts with 10 charges, and it regains 1d6 expended charges daily at dawn.
Cube of Force Faces
Spell | Charge Cost
Mage Armor | 1
Shield | 1
Leomund's Tiny Hut | 3
Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum | 4
Otiluke's Resilient Sphere | 4
Wall of Force | 5

这个立方体棱长约1寸，每个面上都有不同的标记。你可以按下立方体某一面，并消耗如下表所示的充能以施展对应的法术（豁免DC 17）。
该立方体共有10发充能，每天黎明时会恢复1d6发已消耗的充能次数。

欧提路克弹力法球 | 4

description.en:
This cube is 3 inches across and radiates palpable magical energy. The six sides of the cube are each keyed to a different plane of existence, one of which is the Material Plane. The other sides are linked to planes determined by the DM.
The cube has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. As a Magic action, you can expend 1 of the cube's charges to cast one of the following spells using the cube.
Gate.
Pressing one side of the cube, you cast Gate, opening a portal to the plane of existence keyed to that side.
Plane Shift.
Pressing one side of the cube twice, you cast Plane Shift, transporting the targets to the plane of existence keyed to that side.
description.zh:
这个边长3寸的立方体散发着明显的魔法能量。立方体的六个面分别连接到六个不同的存在位面，其中一面连接的是物质位面，而其他面所连接的位面则由DM决定。
立方体具有3充能，并在每日黎明时重获1d3已消耗的充能。以一个魔法动作，你可以消耗此立方体的1充能，从立方体中施展下列法术之一。
大门.
按压立方体的其中一面，你施展法术异界之门，打开连接到对应存在位面的传送门。
位面转移.
按压两次立方体的其中一面，你施展法术位面转移，将目标传送至对应存在位面。

description.en:
As a Magic action, you can place this 1-inch adamantine statuette on the ground and, using a command word, cause it to grow rapidly into a square adamantine tower. Repeating the command word causes the tower to revert to statuette form, which works only if the tower is empty. Each creature in the area where the tower appears is pushed to an unoccupied space outside but next to the tower. Objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried are also pushed clear of the tower.
The tower is 20 feet on a side and 30 feet high, with arrow slits on all sides and a battlement atop it. Its interior is divided into two floors, with a ladder, staircase, or ramp (your choice) connecting them. This ladder, staircase, or ramp ends at a trapdoor leading to the roof. When created, the tower has a single door at ground level on the side facing you. The door opens only at your command, which you can issue as a Bonus Action. It is immune to the Knock spell and similar magic.
Magic prevents the tower from being tipped over. The roof, the door, and the walls each have AC 20; HP 100; Immunity to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage except that which is dealt by siege equipment; and Resistance to all other damage. Shrinking the tower back down to statuette form doesn't repair damage to the tower. Only a Wish spell can repair the tower (this use of the spell counts as replicating a spell of level 8 or lower). Each casting of Wish causes the tower to regain all its Hit Points.
description.zh:
你可以用一个魔法动作，把这个1寸高的精金小雕像放在地上并说出其命令语，使其迅速长成一座方形的精金高塔。若塔内空间未被占据，再说一遍命令语会使其变回雕像形态。高塔出现时，其占据的区域空间内每个生物都会被推到塔外未被占据的空间里。该区域内未被着装或携带的物件也会被推出塔外。
高塔长宽各20尺，高30尺，各面墙上都有箭孔，顶端则为城垛。它的内部分为两层，其间由梯子、楼梯或斜坡（由你选择）连通。该梯子、楼梯或斜坡止于一扇通向此塔顶层的活板门。此塔生成时，其底层面向你的那一面会出现一扇门。只有你用一个附赠动作向其传令时，此门才会开启。这扇门免疫敲击术以及类似的魔法。
魔法保护着高塔，使其无法被推倒。高塔的顶部、门和每面墙都分别具有20AC和100点生命值，免疫不由攻城器械造成的挥砍、钝击、穿刺伤害，且对其他所有类型的伤害都具有抗性。将高塔变回雕像形态不会修复其受到的伤害。只有法术祈愿术能够修复高塔（这种用法视为复制一个不大于八环的法术）。每次施展祈愿术都能让高塔恢复所有生命值。

description.en:
This stoppered flask sloshes when shaken, as if it contains water. The decanter weighs 2 pounds.
You can take a Magic action to remove the stopper and issue one of three command words, whereupon an amount of fresh water or salt water (your choice) pours out of the flask. The water stops pouring out at the start of your next turn. Choose from the following command words:
• Splash The decanter produces 1 gallon of water.
• Fountain The decanter produces 5 gallons of water.
• Geyser The decanter produces 30 gallons of water that gushes forth in a Line 30 feet long and 1 foot wide. If you're holding the decanter, you can aim the geyser in one direction (no action required). One creature of your choice in the Line must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or take 1d4 Bludgeoning damage and have the Prone condition. Instead of a creature, you can target one object in the Line that isn't being worn or carried and that weighs no more than 200 pounds. The object is knocked over by the geyser.
description.zh:
这个带瓶塞的瓶子在摇晃时会发出液体晃动的声音，仿佛其中有水一般。此瓶重2磅。
你可以用一个魔法动作拔出瓶塞并说出其三个命令语之一，使瓶中涌出淡水或咸水（由你选择）。水将在你的下一回合开始时停止涌出。从下列命令语中进行选择：
• 溅射 此瓶产生1加仑的水。
• 喷泉 此瓶产生5加仑的水。
• 井喷 此瓶产生30加仑的水，以一道长30尺，宽1尺的线状水柱的形式喷涌而出。如果你正握持着此瓶，那么你可以将瓶口对准一处地方（无需动作）。你选择该线状内你的一名生物，该生物必须成功通过一次DC 13的力量豁免，否则受到1d4点钝击伤害并陷入倒地状态。除瞄准生物以外，你也可以用瓶口瞄准线状内一个不超过200磅，且未被着装或携带的物件。该物件将被水柱打翻。

description.en:
This box contains a set of cards. A full deck has 34 cards: 32 depicting specific creatures and two with a mirrored surface. A deck found as treasure is usually missing 1d20 - 1 cards.
The magic of the deck functions only if its cards are drawn at random. You can take a Magic action to draw a card at random from the deck and throw it to the ground at a point within 30 feet of yourself. An illusion of a creature, determined by rolling on the Deck of Illusions table, forms over the thrown card and remains until dispelled. The illusory creature created by the card looks and behaves like a real creature of its kind, except that it can do no harm. While you are within 120 feet of the illusory creature and can see it, you can take a Magic action to move it anywhere within 30 feet of its card.
Any physical interaction with the illusory creature reveals it to be false, because objects pass through it. A creature that takes a Study action to visually inspect the illusory creature identifies it as an illusion with a successful DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check. The illusion lasts until its card is moved or the illusion is dispelled (using a Dispel Magic spell or a similar effect). When the illusion ends, the image on its card disappears, and that card can't be used again.

description.zh:
这个匣子里装着一套卡牌。一套完整的牌组有34张卡牌：32张描绘着特定的生物，2张则是镜面牌。作为宝藏找到的牌组通常会缺失1d20 - 1张卡牌。
牌组的魔法只有在随机抽出时才会生效。你可以用一个魔法动作从牌组中随机抽出一张卡牌，并将其扔到距离你30尺范围以内的一处地面上。某一生物（根据"幻象牌组表格"掷骰来确定）的幻象会从被扔出的卡牌中显现，并将持续存在直至被解除。由卡牌创造出的幻象生物看起来活灵活现，和真实生物行为相仿，但无法造成伤害。如果你在幻象生物周围120尺范围内且你能看到它，你就可以用一个魔法动作令其移动到卡牌周围30尺内的任何地方。
由于物件可以穿透幻象，因此与幻象生物进行的任何物理互动都将揭示其幻象本质。任一生物都可以用一个研究动作来对幻象生物进行视觉性的观察，此时其成功通过一次DC 15的智力（调查）检定即可发现幻象的本质。幻象将持续存在，直至被解除（使用解除魔法或类似的效应）或其卡牌被移动。当幻象终止时，其卡牌上的图像也随之消失，该卡牌也无法再次使用。
