description.en: The medallion has 5 charges. While wearing it, you can expend 1 charge to cast Detect Thoughts (save DC 13) from it. The medallion regains 1d4 expended charges daily at dawn.
description.zh: 这块勋章具有5充能。佩戴它期间，你可以消耗1充能从中施展侦测思想（豁免DC 13）。这块勋章在每日黎明时重获1d4已消耗的充能。

description.en:
When this 4-foot-tall, 2-foot-wide mirror is viewed indirectly, its surface shows faint images of creatures. The mirror weighs 50 pounds, and it has AC 11, HP 10, Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage, and Vulnerability to Bludgeoning damage. It shatters and is destroyed when reduced to 0 Hit Points.
If the mirror is hanging on a vertical surface and you are within 5 feet of it, you can take a Magic action and use a command word to activate it. It remains activated until you take a Magic action and repeat the command word to deactivate it.
Any creature other than you that sees its reflection in the activated mirror while within 30 feet of the mirror must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be trapped, along with anything it is wearing or carrying, in one of the mirror's twelve extradimensional cells. A creature that knows the mirror's nature makes the save with Advantage, and Constructs succeed on the save automatically.
An extradimensional cell is an infinite expanse filled with thick fog that reduces visibility to 10 feet. Creatures trapped in the mirror's cells don't age, and they don't need to eat, drink, or sleep. A creature trapped within a cell can escape using magic that permits planar travel. Otherwise, the creature is confined to the cell until freed.
If the mirror traps a creature but its twelve extradimensional cells are already occupied, the mirror frees one trapped creature at random to accommodate the new prisoner. A freed creature appears in an unoccupied space within sight of the mirror but facing away from it. If the mirror is shattered, all creatures it contains are freed and appear in unoccupied spaces near it.
While within 5 feet of the mirror, you can take a Magic action to name one creature trapped in it or call out a particular cell by number. The creature named or contained in the named cell appears as an image on the mirror's surface. You and the creature can then communicate.
In a similar way, you can take a Magic action and use a second command word to free one creature trapped in the mirror. The freed creature appears, along with its possessions, in the unoccupied space nearest to the mirror and facing away from it.
Placing the mirror inside an extradimensional space created by a Bag of Holding, Portable Hole, or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where the one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within 10 feet of the gate and not behind Total Cover is sucked through it to a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way only and can't be reopened.
description.zh:
当以间接的方式看向这面4尺高，2尺宽的镜子时，其表面会显示出生物的模糊影像。这面镜子重50磅，AC11，HP10，免疫毒素和心灵伤害，对钝击伤害具有易伤。当生命值降至0时，镜子会粉碎且被摧毁。
如果镜子悬挂于一处垂直表面，且你在镜子周边5尺范围内时，你可以执行一个魔法动作并使用一个命令语激活它。它会一直保持激活状态，直至你执行一个魔法动作并重复命令语来取消激活。
如果除你之外的任何生物在镜子周边30尺范围内看到自己在已激活镜面中的倒影，该生物必须成功通过一次DC 15的魅力豁免，否则将会连同自己着装或携带的所有物品一起被困入镜中的十二个异次元牢房之一。了解摄心镜本质的生物在进行该豁免时具有优势，构装生物在进行该豁免时直接成功。
每个异次元牢房都是一处无限广阔的空间，里面充满了浓雾，能见度只有10尺。被困入镜中牢房的生物不会衰老，也无需饮食和睡眠。被困于牢房的生物可以使用位面旅行魔法进行逃脱，无法做到这件事的生物将被永远囚禁在牢房中，直至被释放为止。
如果镜子困住一个生物，而十二个异次元牢房又已被占满，则它将随机释放一名被困生物以容纳新囚犯。一个被释放的生物会背对镜子出现在镜子视野范围内一处未被占据的空间中。如果镜子被打碎，它囚禁的所有生物都会被释放，并出现在它附近未被占据的空间里。
位于镜子周边5尺范围内时，你可以使用一个魔法动作说出一位被囚禁生物的名字或呼喊一个特定牢房的编号。被说出名字或被囚禁于该编号牢房的生物会以一幅影像的形式出现在镜子表面，随后你可与该生物进行交流。
以类似的方式，你可以执行一个魔法动作并使用另一个命令语释放一位被困于镜中的生物。被释放的生物会连同其所有物出现离镜子最近的未被占据的空间里，背对着镜子。
将摄心镜放入次元袋、全身掩护或其他类似物品产生的异次元空间时，将立即摧毁这两件物品并打开一扇通往星光位面的门扉。门扉会产生在被放入另一件物品的前一件物品所在的空间位置。任何在门扉周边10尺范围内且不在全身掩护之后的生物将被吸入门内并送到星光位面的随机位置，随后该门关闭。这扇门扉只能单向通过且无法被再次打开。

description.en: While wearing this necklace, you can breathe normally in any environment, and you have Advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.
description.zh: 佩戴此项链期间，你能在任何环境中正常呼吸，并且你在为避免或结束中毒状态的豁免中具有优势。

description.en:
This necklace has 1d6 + 3 beads hanging from it. You can take a Magic action to detach a bead and throw it up to 60 feet away. When it reaches the end of its trajectory, the bead detonates as a level 3 Fireball (save DC 15).
You can hurl multiple beads, or even the whole necklace, at one time. When you do so, increase the damage of the Fireball by 1d6 for each bead after the first (maximum 12d6).
description.zh:
这条项链挂着1d6 + 3颗珠子。你可以执行魔法动作取下一颗珠子并将其投掷最多60尺距离。珠子会在投掷轨迹的末端引爆，效果等同于3环火球术（豁免DC 15）。
你可以同时把多枚珠子，甚至把整条项链一起投掷出去。这么做时，每有一颗额外投掷出的珠子，火球术的伤害就增加1d6点（最大12d6）。

attunement.en: Requires Attunement by a cleric, druid, or paladin
attunement.zh: 需要同调（需牧师，德鲁伊或圣武士）

description.en:
This necklace has 1d4 + 2 magic beads made from aquamarine, black pearl, or topaz. It also has many nonmagical beads made from stones such as amber, bloodstone, citrine, coral, jade, pearl, or quartz. If a magic bead is removed from the necklace, that bead loses its magic.
Six types of magic beads exist. The DM decides the type of each bead on the necklace or determines it randomly by rolling on the table below. A necklace can have more than one bead of the same type. To use one, you must be wearing the necklace. Each bead contains a spell that you can cast from it as a Bonus Action (using your spell save DC if a save is necessary). Once a magic bead's spell is cast, that bead can't be used again until the next dawn.
1d20 | Bead | Spell
1-6 | Bead of Blessing | Bless
7-12 | Bead of Curing | Cure Wounds (level 2 version)
13-16 | Bead of Favor | Greater Restoration
17-18 | Bead of Smiting | Shining Smite
19 | Bead of Summons | Guardian of Faith
20 | Bead of Wind Walking | Wind Walk
description.zh:
这条项链挂着1d4 + 2颗由海蓝宝石、黑珍珠或黄玉制成的魔法念珠。项链上同样串有许多由琥珀、血石、黄水晶、珊瑚石、玉石、珍珠或石英石制成的非魔法性的念珠。魔法念珠从项链中取下时将失去其魔法。
项链的每颗魔法念珠都可能是六种念珠之一，由DM决定或在下表中随机掷骰以确定每颗念珠的种类。一条项链可以拥有多颗同种类的念珠。要使用念珠，你必须佩戴着这条项链。每颗念珠容纳着一道法术，你能够以一个附赠动作从中施展它所容纳的法术（需要豁免的法术使用你的法术豁免DC）。一颗魔法念珠中的法术一经施展，那颗念珠直至次日黎明前都无法再次被使用。
1d20 | 念珠 | 法术
1-6 | 祝福之珠 | 祝福术
7-12 | 疗愈之珠 | 疗伤术（二环版本）
13-16 | 恩赐之珠 | 高等复原术
17-18 | 打击之珠 | 闪耀斩
19 | 召唤之珠 | 信仰守卫
20 | 风行之珠 | 御风而行

description.en:
This fine wooden box contains 1d4 pots of pigment and a brush (weighing 1 pound in total). Using the brush and expending 1 pot of pigment, you can paint any number of three-dimensional objects and terrain features (such as walls, doors, trees, flowers, weapons, webs, and pits), provided these elements are all confined to a 20-foot Cube. The effort takes 10 minutes (regardless of the number of elements you create), during which time you must remain in the Cube, and requires Concentration. If your Concentration is broken or you leave the Cube before the work is done, all the painted elements vanish, and the pot of pigment is wasted.
When the work is done, all the painted objects and terrain features become real. Thus, painting a door on a wall creates an actual door, which can be opened to whatever is beyond. Painting a pit creates a real pit, the entire depth of which must lie within the 20-foot Cube.
No object created by a pot of pigment can have a value greater than 25 GP, and the total value of all objects created by a pot of pigment can't exceed 500 GP. If you paint objects of greater value (such as a large pile of gold), they look authentic, but close inspection reveals they're made from paste, cookies, or some other worthless material.
If you paint a form of energy such as fire or lightning, the energy dissipates as soon as you complete the painting, doing no harm.
description.zh:
这个精美的木盒里装有1d4罐颜料以及一根画笔（共重1磅）。通过使用画笔并消耗1罐颜料，你可以在20尺立方的范围内画出任意数量的三维物体和地形特征（例如墙、门、树、鲜花、武器、蛛网和坑洞）。达成此效应需要10分钟（无论你创造了多少东西），而且在此期间，你必须留在这一立方中并保持专注。完成绘画前，若你的专注被打断或你离开此立方，你画出的所有东西都将消失，消耗的那罐颜料也会被浪费。
完成绘画时，你绘制的物件和地形将变为真实的事物。因此，画在墙上的门可以正常打开并通过，画在地上的坑也会变成真正的坑，其整个深度都必须在20尺立方的范围以内。
颜料不能创造出价值高于25金币的单个物件，你以一罐颜料创造出的所有物件的总价值也不能超过500金币。如果你试图画出价格更高昂的东西（例如一大堆金子），那么产生的物件仅仅看上去像是真的，但仔细检查就会发现它们是由浆糊、饼干或其他不值钱的材料制成的。
如果你画出某种形式的能量，例如火焰或闪电，则该能量在你完成绘制的那一瞬间消散，且不会造成任何伤害。

description.en:
Long ago, in the Dragonlance setting, elves and humans waged a terrible war against chromatic dragons. When the world seemed doomed, the wizards of the Towers of High Sorcery came together and forged five Orbs of Dragonkind to help defeat the dragons. One orb was taken to each of the five towers, and there they were used to speed the war toward a victorious end. The wizards used the orbs to lure dragons to them, then destroyed the dragons with powerful magic.
As the Towers of High Sorcery fell in later ages, the orbs were destroyed or faded into legend, and only three are thought to survive. Their magic has been warped over the centuries. Their primary purpose of calling dragons still functions, but they also allow some measure of control over dragons.
Each orb contains the essence of an evil dragon, a presence that resents any attempt to coax magic from it. Those who try to wield an orb's magic but lack sufficient force of personality might find themselves under the orb's control.
An orb is an etched crystal globe about 10 inches in diameter. When used, it grows to about 20 inches in diameter, and mist swirls inside it.
While attuned to an orb, you can take a Magic action to peer into the orb's depths. You must then make a DC 15 Charisma saving throw. On a successful save, you control the orb for as long as you remain attuned to it. On a failed save, the orb imposes the Charmed condition on you for as long as you remain attuned to it.
While you are Charmed by the orb, you can't voluntarily end your Attunement to it, and the orb casts Suggestion on you at will (save DC 18), urging you to work toward the evil ends it desires. The dragon essence within the orb might want many things: the annihilation of a particular society or organization, freedom from the orb, to spread suffering in the world, to advance the worship of Tiamat, or something else the DM decides.
Random Properties.
An Orb of Dragonkind has the following random properties:
• 2 minor beneficial properties
• 1 minor detrimental property
• 1 major detrimental property
Spells.
The orb has 7 charges and regains 1d4 + 3 expended charges daily at dawn. If you control the orb, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell.
Spell | Charge Cost
Cure Wounds (level 9 version) | 4
Daylight | 1
Death Ward | 2
Detect Magic | 0
Scrying (save DC 18) | 3
Call Dragons.
While you control the orb, you can take a Magic action to cause the orb to issue a telepathic call that extends in all directions for 40 miles. Chromatic dragons in range feel compelled to come to the orb as soon as possible by the most direct route. Dragon deities such as Tiamat are unaffected by this call. Chromatic dragons drawn to the orb might be Hostile toward you for compelling them against their will. Once you have used this property, it can't be used again for 1 hour.
Destroying an Orb.
An Orb of Dragonkind has AC 20 and is destroyed if it takes damage from a +3 Weapon or a Disintegrate spell. Nothing else can harm it.
description.zh:
很久以前，在龙枪的设定中，精灵与人类对色彩巨龙发动了一场惨烈的战争。在最后世界接近崩溃之际，大法师诸塔的法师们齐聚一堂，铸造了五颗龙珠来帮助击败巨龙。五颗龙珠分给了五座法师塔，他们凭借龙珠的力量克敌制胜。法师们用龙珠引诱龙族，然后以强大的法术轰杀之。
随着大法师诸塔在后来的年代中倒塌，其持有的五颗龙珠也相继被摧毁或遗失在传说之中。相传仍然有三颗保存完好的龙珠流传在世。虽然它们的魔法在几个世纪中被扭曲变换，但其呼唤巨龙的原始功能却依然健全，还能在一定程度上控制龙族。
每颗龙珠内都包含着一条邪恶巨龙的精神，对任何尝试从中引出魔法的企图怀有愤恨。那些试图使用龙珠但意志不坚定的人有时会发现自身实为被龙珠所蛊惑。
龙珠是一枚直径约10寸的蚀刻水晶球。使用时，其直径增长至20寸，并且在内部萦绕着迷雾。
与龙珠维持同调期间，你能够以魔法动作窥视龙珠深处。然后你必须进行一次DC 15的魅力豁免。若豁免成功，你将可以控制龙珠直至同调中断。若豁免失败，你将被龙珠魅惑直至同调中断。
被龙珠魅惑期间，你不能自行中断同调，而龙珠可以对你随意施展暗示术（豁免DC 18），并蛊惑你助推其邪恶目标。龙珠里的巨龙精神有着各种需求：歼灭某个特定社团或组织；从龙珠中解放；四处折磨世人；传播提亚马特信仰，或是由DM决定的其他事情。
随机词条.
龙珠具有下列随机词条：
• 2项次要增益词条
• 1项次要减益词条
• 1项主要减益词条
法术.
龙珠具有7充能，并在每日黎明时重获1d4 + 3已消耗的充能。你能以龙珠施展下表中的法术（豁免DC18）。表中表明了你施展对应的法术需要消耗多少充能。
法术 | 消耗充能
疗伤术（9环版本） | 4
昼明术 | 1
防死结界 | 2
侦测魔法 | 0
探知术（豁免DC 18） | 3
呼唤巨龙.
控制龙珠期间，你能够以魔法动作令龙珠发出心灵感应呼唤，此呼唤向所有方向延伸40英里。范围内的色彩龙族将被迫以最直接的路线尽可能快的来到龙珠处。龙族神祇（如提亚马特）不受此呼唤影响。被龙珠唤来的色彩龙族可能因其非自愿的到来与你敌对。该词条一经使用，一小时内你都无法再次使用。
摧毁此珠.
龙珠的AC为20，当其受到+3魔法武器或法术解离术的伤害时，龙珠被摧毁。其余任何事物都无法摧毁龙珠。

description.en: While this pearl is on your person, you can take a Magic action to regain one expended spell slot of level 3 or lower. Once you use the pearl, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
description.zh: 在你随身携带这颗珍珠期间，你可以使用一个魔法动作来恢复一枚已消耗的三环或更低环阶的法术位。这颗珍珠一经使用，则其直至次日黎明前都无法再次使用。

description.en:
While wearing this pendant, you can take a Magic action to regain 2d4 + 2 Hit Points. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.
In addition, you have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition while you wear this pendant.
description.zh:
佩戴此吊坠期间，你可以执行魔法动作来恢复2d4 + 2生命值。一经使用，则其直至次日黎明前都无法再次使用。
此外，佩戴着此吊坠期间，你在为避免或结束中毒状态的豁免中具有优势。

description.en: This delicate silver chain has a brilliant-cut black gem pendant. While you wear it, you have Immunity to the Poisoned condition and Poison damage.
description.zh: 这条精致的银链上挂着一颗璀璨切割的黑宝石吊坠。当你佩戴它时，你对中毒状态和毒素伤害具有免疫。

description.en:
While wearing this pendant, you gain the following benefits.
Life Preservation.
Whenever you make a Death Saving Throw, you can change a roll of 9 or lower to a 10, turning a failed save into a successful one.
Natural Healing Boost.
Whenever you roll a Hit Point Die to regain Hit Points, double the number of Hit Points it restores.
description.zh:
佩戴此吊坠期间，你获得以下增益：
维持生命.
每当你进行死亡豁免检定时，你都可以将掷骰中9及以下的骰值改为10，以此让失败的豁免改为成功。
加速自愈.
每当你投掷一颗生命值骰来恢复你的生命值时，你生命值恢复量翻倍。

description.en: These pipes have 3 charges and regain 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. You can take a Magic action to play them and expend 1 charge to create an eerie, spellbinding tune. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute. A creature that fails the save repeats it at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on its save is immune to the effect of these pipes for 24 hours.
description.zh: 颤栗乐笙具有3充能，并在每日黎明时重获1d3已消耗的充能。你可以使用一个魔法动作演奏该乐笙，并消耗其1充能来创作一首怪诞且令人着迷的曲调。你周边30尺范围内每个你选择的生物都必须成功通过一次DC 15的感知豁免，豁免失败者会陷入恐慌状态，持续1分钟。豁免失败的生物可以在其每个回合结束时重复该豁免，豁免成功则结束对自身的影响。豁免成功的生物将在24小时内免疫该乐笙的效应。

description.en:
While these pipes are on your person, ordinary rats and giant rats are Indifferent toward you and won't attack you unless you threaten or harm them.
The pipes have 3 charges and regain 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. If you play the pipes as a Magic action, you can take a Bonus Action to expend 1 to 3 charges, calling forth one Swarm of Rats with each expended charge if enough rats are within half a mile of you to be called in this fashion (as determined by the DM). If there aren't enough rats to form a swarm, the charge is wasted. Called swarms move toward the music by the shortest available route but aren't under your control otherwise.
Whenever a Swarm of Rats that isn't under another creature's control comes within 30 feet of you while you are playing the pipes, the swarm makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the swarm behaves as it normally would and can't be swayed by the pipes' music for the next 24 hours. On a failed save, the swarm is swayed by the pipes' music and becomes Friendly to you and your allies for as long as you continue to play the pipes each round as a Magic action. A Friendly swarm obeys your commands. If you issue no commands to a Friendly swarm, it defends itself but otherwise takes no actions. If a Friendly swarm starts its turn more than 30 feet away from you, your control over that swarm ends, and the swarm behaves as it normally would and can't be swayed by the pipes' music for the next 24 hours.
description.zh:
在你随身携带这只乐笙期间，老鼠和巨鼠对你的态度为冷漠。除非你威胁或伤害它们，否则它们不会主动攻击你。
唤鼠乐笙具有3充能，并在每日黎明时重获1d3已消耗的充能。你可以使用一个魔法动作演奏该乐笙，并使用一个附赠动作消耗1~3充能。如果你周围半里内有足够可供召唤的老鼠（由DM决定），那么每消耗1充能就能召唤1组鼠群。如果范围内鼠的数量不足以形成集群，则该次充能被浪费。被召唤的集群会沿着最短的可用路线向音乐移动，但除此之外不受你的控制。
在你使用魔法动作演奏乐笙期间，每当一个未被其他生物控制的鼠群进入到你周边30尺范围内时，该鼠群就必须进行一次DC 15的感知豁免。如果豁免成功，该鼠群就会像平常一样行动，并在接下来的24小时内不再受到乐笙音乐的影响。如果豁免失败，鼠群就会受到乐笙音乐的影响，并且只要你每轮继续使用一个魔法动作演奏乐笙，鼠群就会对你和你的盟友保持友好。一个友好的鼠群会遵从你的命令。当你没对一个友好的鼠群下达命令时，它们会尽力保护自己，但不会执行其他动作。如果一个友好的鼠群在距离你30尺以外的地方开始其回合，则你对该鼠群的控制就会终止，鼠群会像平常一样行动，并在接下来的24小时内不再受到乐笙音乐的影响。

description.en:
This fine black cloth, soft as silk, is folded up to the dimensions of a handkerchief. It unfolds into a circular sheet 6 feet in diameter.
You can take a Magic action to unfold a Portable Hole and place it on or against a solid surface, whereupon the Portable Hole creates an extradimensional hole 10 feet deep. The cylindrical space within the hole exists on a different plane of existence, so it can't be used to create open passages. Any creature inside an open Portable Hole can exit the hole by climbing out of it.
You can take a Magic action to close a Portable Hole by taking hold of the edges of the cloth and folding it up. Folding the cloth closes the hole, and any creatures or objects within remain in the extradimensional space. No matter what's in it, the hole weighs next to nothing.
If the hole is folded up, a creature within the hole's extradimensional space can take an action to make a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check. On a successful check, the creature forces its way out and appears within 5 feet of the Portable Hole. A closed Portable Hole holds enough air for 1 hour of breathing, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside.
Placing a Portable Hole inside an extradimensional space created by a Bag of Holding, Heward's Handy Haversack, or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where the one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within 10 feet of the gate and not behind Total Cover is sucked through it and deposited in a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way only and can't be reopened.
description.zh:
这块如丝绸般顺滑的精致黑色布料，折叠起来只有手帕大小。布料展开后为直径6尺的圆形盖布。
你可以使用一个魔法动作展开次元洞，并将其放置在或靠着一处坚固表面。次元洞会随即打开一个10尺深的异次元孔洞。次元洞内的圆柱形空间存在于异位面，因此无法用于创造开放通道。任何位于一个打开的次元洞内的生物都可以通过攀爬从洞口离开。
你可以使用一个魔法动作通过抓住布料的边缘将其折叠起来以关闭次元洞。折叠布料会关闭洞口，里面的任何生物或物件都会留在异次元空间中。无论内部装了什么，次元洞的重量都可以忽略不计。
如果次元洞被折叠起来，一个位于洞内异次元空间的生物可以使用一个动作进行一次DC 10的力量（运动）检定。如果检定成功，该生物就会强行离开，并出现在次元洞周边5尺范围内。一个关闭的次元洞可容纳足够呼吸1小时的空气，除以洞内呼吸生物的数量。
将次元洞放入次元袋、霍华德便利袋或其他类似物品产生的异次元空间时，将立即摧毁这两件物品并打开一扇通往星光位面Astral Plane的门扉。门扉会产生在被放入另一件物品的前一件物品所在的空间位置。任何在门扉周边10尺范围内且不在全身掩护之后的生物将被吸入门内并送到星光位面的随机位置，随后该门关闭。这扇门扉只能单向通过且无法被再次打开。

description.en:
This object looks like a feather.
You can take a Magic action to touch the token to a boat or ship. For the next 24 hours, the vessel can't be moved by any means. Touching the token to the vessel again ends the effect. When the effect ends, the token disappears.
description.zh:
这枚物件看上去像一根羽毛。
你可以执行魔法动作来用羽符触碰一艘小艇或船只。接下来的24小时内，该船不会被任何方式移动。效应结束时，羽符也随之消失。

description.en:
This object looks like a feather.
You can take a Magic action to toss the token 5 feet into the air. The token disappears and an enormous, multicolored bird takes its place. The bird has the statistics of a Roc, but it can't attack. It obeys your simple commands and can carry up to 500 pounds while flying at its maximum speed (16 miles per hour for a maximum of 144 miles per day, with a 1-hour rest for every 3 hours of flying) or 1,000 pounds at half that speed. The bird disappears after flying its maximum distance for a day or if it drops to 0 Hit Points. You can dismiss the bird as a Magic action.
description.zh:
这枚物件看上去像一根羽毛。
你可以执行魔法动作将羽符抛至5尺高的空中。羽符将消失，并且一只五彩斑斓的巨鸟取而代之。这只鸟使用鹏鸟的数据，但它无法进行攻击。它会遵从你的简单命令且能在负载至多500磅的同时全速前进（16里/小时，每飞行3小时休息1小时，最高144里/日），或在负载至多1000磅的同时以半速前进。鸟将在达到其一日能飞行的最远距离或生命值降为0时消失。你也可以用魔法动作将其遣散。

description.en:
This object looks like a feather.
If you are on a boat or ship, you can take a Magic action to toss the token up to 10 feet in the air. The token disappears, and a giant flapping fan takes its place. The fan floats and creates a strong wind. This wind can fill the sails of one ship, increasing its speed by 5 miles per hour for 8 hours. You can dismiss the fan as a Magic action.
description.zh:
这枚物件看上去像一根羽毛。
如果你在小艇或船只上，你可以执行魔法动作将羽符抛至10尺高的空中。羽符将消失，一把巨大的扇子取而代之。这把扇子会漂浮并制造一股强风。强风会吹满帆船的风帆，使其速度增加5里/小时，持续8小时。你可以执行魔法动作将扇子遣散。

description.en:
This object looks like a feather.
You can take a Magic action to touch the token to a body of water at least 60 feet in diameter. The token disappears, and a 50-foot-long, 20-foot-wide boat shaped like a swan takes its place. The boat is self-propelled and moves across water at a speed of 6 miles per hour. You can take a Magic action while on the boat to command it to move or to turn up to 90 degrees. The boat remains for 24 hours and then disappears. You can dismiss the boat as a Magic action.
description.zh:
这枚物件看上去像一根羽毛。
你可以执行魔法动作来用羽符触碰直径至少60尺的水体。羽符将消失，并且一艘50尺长，20尺宽，形状类似天鹅的船取而代之。这艘船可以自行推进并以6英里/小时的速度穿越水体。在船上时，你可以执行魔法动作以命令它移动或转向最多90度。这艘船持续24小时，随后消失。你可以执行魔法动作遣散这艘船。

description.en:
This object looks like a feather.
You must be outdoors to use this token. You can take a Magic action to touch it to an unoccupied space on the ground. The token disappears, and in its place a nonmagical oak tree springs into existence. The tree is 60 feet tall and has a 5-foot-diameter trunk, and its branches at the top spread out in a 20-foot radius.
description.zh:
这枚物件看上去像一根羽毛。
要使用这枚羽符，你必须身处室外。你可以执行魔法动作来用羽符触碰地面上的未占据空间。羽符将消失，取而代之的是该地长出一棵非魔法性的橡树。这棵树高60尺，树干直径5尺，顶端的树冠以20尺半径向外延伸。

description.en:
This object looks like a feather.
You can take a Magic action to throw the token to a point within 10 feet of yourself. The token disappears, and a floating whip takes its place. You can then take a Bonus Action to make a melee spell attack against a creature within 10 feet of the whip, with an attack bonus of +9. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 + 5 Force damage.
As a Bonus Action, you can direct the whip to fly up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a creature within 10 feet of the whip. The whip disappears after 1 hour, when you take a Magic action to dismiss it, or when you die or have the Incapacitated condition.
description.zh:
这枚物件看上去像一根羽毛。
你可以执行魔法动作将羽符扔向位于你10尺内的一点。羽符消失，取而代之的是一根漂浮的鞭子，然后你可以用附赠动作对鞭子10尺内的一个生物发动一次近战法术攻击（攻击加值+9）。命中时，目标受到1d6 + 5力场伤害。
以一个附赠动作，你可以命令鞭子飞行至多20尺并再次攻击其10尺内的一个生物。鞭子将在经过一小时、你执行魔法动作将其遣散、你死亡或陷入失能状态后消失。

description.en:
Each of the quiver's three compartments connects to an extradimensional space that allows the quiver to hold numerous items while never weighing more than 2 pounds. The shortest compartment can hold up to 60 Arrows, Bolts, or similar objects. The midsize compartment holds up to 18 Javelins or similar objects. The longest compartment holds up to 6 long objects, such as bows, Quarterstaffs, or Spears.
You can draw any item the quiver contains as if doing so from a regular quiver or scabbard.
description.zh:
这个箭袋有三个大小不一的隔层，每个隔层都连接着一个异次元空间。无论其中存放着多少东西，箭袋的总重量都永远都不会超过2磅。最小的隔层可以容纳至多60支箭矢、弩矢或类似的物件；中等大小的隔层可以容纳至多18支标枪或类似的物件；最大的隔层可以容纳至多6件长条型的物件，例如弓、长棍的、三叉枪等。
你可以如同从普通的箭袋或剑鞘中抽出物品一般抽出艾罗娜箭袋中的物品。

description.en:
This robe is adorned with eyelike patterns. While you wear the robe, you gain the following benefits:
• All-Around Vision The robe gives you Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
• Special Senses You have Darkvision and Truesight, both with a range of 120 feet.
Drawbacks.
A Light spell cast on the robe or a Daylight spell cast within 5 feet of the robe gives you the Blinded condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of your turns, you make a Constitution saving throw (DC 11 for Light or DC 15 for Daylight), ending the condition on yourself on a success.
description.zh:
这件长袍上绘满了眼睛的图案。着装这件长袍期间，你获得以下增益：
• 全域视野 你在依赖视觉的感知（察觉）检定中具有优势。
• 特殊感官 你具有120尺的黑暗视觉和真实视觉。
缺点.
对法袍施展光亮术或在其周围5尺内施展昼明术将使你陷入目盲，持续1分钟。在你的每个回合结束时，你可以进行一次体质豁免（对光亮术时DC 11，对昼明术时DC 15），成功则终止你身上的该效应。

description.en: This robe has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While you wear it, you can take a Magic action and expend 1 charge to cause the garment to display a shifting pattern of dazzling hues until the end of your next turn. During this time, the robe sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet, and creatures that can see you have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. Any creature in the Bright Light that can see you when the robe's power is activated must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the Stunned condition until the effect ends.
description.zh: 这件长袍具有3充能，并每日黎明时重获1d3已消耗的充能。着装这件长袍期间，你可以使用一个魔法动作并消耗1充能，让长袍不断变幻出各种耀眼的色彩图案，持续至你的下个回合结束。在此期间，长袍提供30尺明亮光照和额外30尺微光光照，能看到你的生物对你发动的攻击检定具有劣势。此外，长袍效应启用期间，任何处于长袍产生的明亮光照区域内且可以看到你的生物必须进行一次DC 15的感知豁免，豁免失败则陷入震慑状态，直到长袍的效应终止。

roll20Modifiers: Item Type: Wondrous Item, Saving Throws +1

description.en:
This black or dark-blue robe is embroidered with small white or silver stars. You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws while you wear it.
Six stars, located on the robe's upper-front portion, are particularly large. While wearing this robe, you can take a Magic action to remove one of the stars and expend it to cast the level 5 version of Magic Missile. Daily at dusk, 1d6 removed stars reappear on the robe.
While you wear the robe, you can take a Magic action to enter the Astral Plane along with everything you are wearing and carrying. You remain there until you take a Magic action to return to the plane you were on. You reappear in the last space you occupied or, if that space is occupied, the nearest unoccupied space.
description.zh:
这件黑色或深蓝色的长袍上点缀着白色或银色的星星。着装这件长袍期间，你的豁免具有+1加值。
法袍的前襟附近有六枚较大的星星。着装这件长袍期间，你可以使用一个魔法动作消耗其中一颗星星，以此施展五环版本的魔法飞弹。每日黄昏时分，1d6颗被消耗的星星将重新出现在法袍上。
着装这件长袍期间，你可以用一个魔法动作使你和你着装或携带的物件一起进入星界，直至你再次使用一个魔法动作回到你原本所在的位面。此时你出现在自己之前占据的空间中，如果该空间已被占据，则你出现在最近的未占据空间。

attunement.en: Requires Attunement by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
attunement.zh: 需要同调（由术士、魔契师或法师）

roll20Modifiers: Item Type: Wondrous Item, Spell Attack +2, Spell DC +2

description.en:
This elegant garment is made from exquisite cloth and adorned with runes.
You gain these benefits while wearing the robe.
Armor.
If you aren't wearing armor, your base Armor Class is 15 plus your Dexterity modifier.
Magic Resistance.
You have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
War Mage.
Your spell save DC and spell attack bonus each increase by 2.
description.zh:
这件典雅的长袍由精美的布料制成，并以符文装饰。
着装此长袍时，你获得下列增益：
护甲.
若你未着装护甲，你的基础护甲等级为15+你的敏捷调整值。
魔法抗性.
你对抗法术和其他魔法效应时进行的豁免检定具有优势。
战法师.
你的法术豁免DC和法术攻击加值均提升2。

description.en:
This robe has cloth patches of various shapes and colors covering it. While wearing the robe, you can take a Magic action to detach one of the patches, causing it to become the object or creature it represents. Once the last patch is removed, the robe becomes an ordinary garment.
The robe has two of each of the following patches:
• Bullseye Lantern (filled and lit)
• Dagger
• Mirror
• Pole
• Rope (coiled)
• Sack
In addition, the robe has 4d4 other patches. The DM chooses the patches or determines them randomly by rolling on the following table.
1d100 | Patch
01-08 | Bag of 100 GP
09-15 | Silver coffer (1 foot long, 6 inches wide and deep) worth 500 GP
16-22 | Iron door (up to 10 feet wide and 10 feet high, barred on one side of your choice), which you can place in an opening you can reach; it conforms to fit the opening, attaching and hinging itself
23-30 | 10 gems worth 100 GP each
31-44 | Wooden ladder (24 feet long)
45-51 | Riding Horse with a Riding Saddle
52-59 | Open pit (a 10-foot Cube), which you can place on the ground within 10 feet of yourself
60-68 | 4 Potions of Healing
69-75 | Rowboat (12 feet long)
76-83 | Spell Scroll containing one spell of level 1, 2, or 3 (your choice)
84-90 | 2 Mastiffs
91-96 | Window (2 feet by 4 feet, up to 2 feet deep), which you can place on a vertical surface you can reach
97-00 | Portable Ram
description.zh:
这件长袍上打着各种颜色和形状的补丁。着装这件长袍期间，你可以使用一个魔法动作拆下其中一块补丁，使其变成它所代表的物件或生物。当长袍上的所有补丁都被拆下后，它将变为一件平凡的衣物。
杂货法袍有着如下补丁各两个：
• 牛眼提灯（装满燃料且点燃）
• 匕首
• 镜子
• 长杆
• 绳索（卷起）
• 麻袋
此外，杂货法袍还有4d4个其他补丁。由DM选择补丁种类或通过在下表中掷骰以随机决定补丁种类。
1d100 | 补丁
01-08 | 装有100 gp的袋子
09-15 | 价值500GP的银柜（高1尺，宽、深各6寸）
16-22 | 铁门（宽最多10尺、高最大10尺，且你选择的一面装有门闩），你可将其安置在一处你触及内的开口处，它将自动改变形状贴合开口并设置铰链。
23-30 | 10枚宝石，每枚价值100GP
31-44 | 木梯（24尺长）
45-51 | 一匹乘用马，配有一个乘坐乘用鞍座
52-59 | 露天陷坑（10尺立方），你可将其布置在你周边10尺范围内的地面上
60-68 | 4 治疗药水
69-75 | 划艇（12尺长）
76-83 | 记载有一道一环、二环或三环法术（由你选择）的法术卷轴
84-90 | 2 獒犬
91-96 | 窗户（2尺×4尺，最多2尺深），你可将其布置在一处你能触及的垂直表面上。
97-00 | 便携式攻城锤

description.en:
This 60-foot length of rope can hold up to 3,000 pounds. While holding one end of the rope, you can take a Magic action to command the other end of the rope to animate and move toward a destination you choose, up to the rope's length away from you. That end moves 10 feet on your turn when you first command it and 10 feet at the start of each of your subsequent turns until reaching its destination or until you tell it to stop. You can also tell the rope to fasten itself securely to an object or to unfasten itself, to knot or unknot itself, or to coil itself for carrying.
If you tell the rope to knot, large knots appear at 1-foot intervals along the rope. While knotted, the rope shortens to a 50-foot length and grants Advantage on ability checks made to climb using the rope.
The rope has AC 20, HP 20, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. It regains 1 Hit Point every 5 minutes as long as it has at least 1 Hit Point. If the rope drops to 0 Hit Points, it is destroyed.
description.zh:
这根60尺长的绳索可承受3000磅的重量。当你持握这根绳索的一端时，你可以使用一个魔法动作命令绳索的另一端活化并向你指定的目的地移动，目的地与你的距离不能超过绳索的长度。在你第一次命令时，绳索末端会在你的回合内移动10尺，并在随后每个你的回合开始时移动 10 尺，直至到达目的地或直至你命令它停止。你也可以命令绳索将自身牢固系绑住一个物件或松绑，将自身打结或解结，或将自身盘卷以便携带。
如果你命令攀爬绳打结，绳索将每隔1尺打一个大结。打结将使绳索的长度缩短至50尺，但此时为用此绳索攀爬所进行的属性检定具有优势。
这根绳索具有AC20、HP20以及毒素和心灵伤害免疫。只要绳索还剩至少1生命值，它就能每5分钟恢复1生命值。如果绳索的生命值降至0，则它被摧毁。

description.en:
This rope is 30 feet long. While holding one end of the rope, you can take a Magic action to command the other end to dart forward and entangle one creature you can see within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or have the Restrained condition. You can release the target by letting go of your end of the rope (causing the rope to coil up in the target's space) or by using a Bonus Action to repeat the command (causing the rope to coil up in your hand).
A target Restrained by the rope can take an action to make its choice of a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. On a successful check, the target is no longer Restrained by the rope. If you're still holding onto the rope when a target escapes from it, you can take a Reaction to command the rope to coil up in your hand; otherwise, the rope coils up in the target's space.
The rope has AC 20, HP 20, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. It regains 1 Hit Point every 5 minutes as long as it has at least 1 Hit Point. If the rope drops to 0 Hit Points, it is destroyed.
description.zh:
这根绳索长30尺。当你持握这根绳索的一端时，你可以使用一个魔法动作命令其另一端向前疾冲并缠住位于你20尺内一个你可见的生物。目标必须成功通过一次DC 15的敏捷豁免，豁免失败则其陷入束缚状态。你可以通过松开绳索的一端（使绳索盘绕着掉落在目标的空间）或使用一个附赠动作重复命令（使绳索回到你手中并盘绕起来）来释放目标。
一个被绳索束缚的目标可以使用一个动作进行一次DC 15的力量（运动）或敏捷（特技）检定。若检定成功，目标不再被绳索束缚。如果目标逃脱时你仍然持握着绳索，则你可以使用一个反应命令绳索回到你手中并盘绕起来；否则，绳索会盘绕着掉落在目标的空间中。
这根绳索具有AC20、HP20以及毒素和心灵伤害免疫。只要绳索还剩至少1生命值，它就能每5分钟恢复1生命值。如果绳索的生命值降至0，则它被摧毁。

description.en:
This beetle-shaped medallion provides three benefits while it is on your person.
Defense.
You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.
Preservation.
The scarab has 12 charges. If you fail a saving throw against a Necromancy spell or a harmful effect originating from an Undead, you can take a Reaction to expend 1 charge and turn the failed save into a successful one. The scarab crumbles into powder and is destroyed when its last charge is expended.
Spell Resistance.
You have Advantage on saving throws against spells.
description.zh:
在你携带这枚甲虫形徽章于身上期间，它为你提供三项增益：
防御.
你的护甲等级获得+1加值。
存护.
圣甲虫具有12充能，如果你在对抗一道死灵系法术或亡灵造成的有害效应时豁免失败，你能够以反应消耗1充能，令此次豁免改为成功。充能耗尽时，圣甲虫将被摧毁并化为灰烬。
法术抗性.
你对法术进行的豁免具有优势。

description.en:
Sending Stones come in pairs, with each stone carved to match the other so the pairing is easily recognized. While you touch one stone, you can cast Sending from it. The target is the bearer of the other stone. If no creature bears the other stone, you know that fact as soon as you use the stone, and you don't cast the spell.
Once Sending is cast using either stone, the stones can't be used again until the next dawn. If one of the stones in a pair is destroyed, the other one becomes nonmagical.
description.zh:
短讯石两颗一对，这两块石头经过雕刻而相互匹配，因此它们的配对非常容易辨认。触摸其中一块短讯石期间，你可以用它施展短讯术，目标为另一块短讯石的携带者。如果另一块短讯石没有被任何生物携带，则你在使用短讯石时会得知这一情况，而短讯术将不会被施展。
一旦使用其中一块短讯石施展了短讯术，则两块短讯石直至次日黎明前都无法再次被使用。如果一块短讯石被摧毁，则与它配对的另一块石头也会失去其魔法。

description.en: While you wear these light shoes, you can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings, while leaving your hands free. You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed. However, the slippers don't allow you to move this way on a slippery surface, such as one covered by ice or oil.
description.zh: 着装这双便鞋期间，你无需借助双手即可上下移动，以及穿过垂直表面和沿着天花板移动。你获得等同于你速度的攀爬速度。不过，你无法以此法在滑溜的表面上移动，例如被冰或油覆盖的表面。

description.en:
This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects. It must be stored in a jar or flask that has been coated inside with Oil of Slipperiness. When found, a container contains 1d6 + 1 ounces.
One ounce of the glue can cover a 1-foot square surface. Applying an ounce of Sovereign Glue takes a Utilize action, and the applied glue takes 1 minute to set. Once it has done so, the bond it creates can be broken only by the application of Universal Solvent or Oil of Etherealness, or with a Wish spell.
description.zh:
这种乳白色的粘稠物质可以把任何两个物件永久性地粘在一起。至尊胶必须被储存在一个内壁涂满了滑溜之油的瓶子或罐子中。被发现时，容器中装有1d6 + 1盎司的至尊胶。
每盎司至尊胶可以覆盖1平方尺的表面。涂抹一盎司至尊胶需要一个操作动作，涂抹的胶水将在1分钟后凝固。一旦至尊胶凝固，被粘在一起的东西就只能用万溶剂、以太化之油或法术祈愿术才能分开。

description.en:
This 2-foot-diameter black sphere is a hole in the multiverse, hovering in space and stabilized by a magical field surrounding it.
The sphere obliterates all matter it passes through and all matter that passes through it. Artifacts are the exception. Unless an Artifact is susceptible to damage from a Sphere of Annihilation, it passes through the sphere unscathed. Anything else that touches the sphere but isn't wholly engulfed and obliterated by it takes 8d10 Force damage.
Controlling the Sphere.
A Sphere of Annihilation is stationary until someone takes control of it. If you are within 60 feet of a sphere, you can take a Magic action to make a DC 25 Intelligence (Arcana) check. On a successful check, you control the sphere until the start of your next turn, and if it was under another creature's control, that creature loses control of the sphere. On a failed check, the sphere moves 10 feet toward you in a straight line.
While in control of the sphere, you can take a Bonus Action to cause it to move in one direction of your choice, up to a number of feet equal to 5 times your Intelligence modifier (minimum 5 feet). Any creature whose space the sphere enters must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be touched by it, taking 8d10 Force damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage is obliterated, leaving its possessions behind but no other physical remains.
Sphere Interactions.
If the sphere comes into contact with a planar portal (such as that created by the Gate spell) or an extradimensional space (such as that within a Portable Hole), the DM determines randomly what happens using the following table.
1d100 | Result
01-50 | The sphere is destroyed.
51-85 | The sphere moves through the portal or into the extradimensional space.
86-00 | A spatial rift sends the sphere and each creature and object within 180 feet of the sphere to a random plane of existence.
description.zh:
这个直径2尺的黑色球体是多元宇宙中的一个空洞，它悬浮在空间中，由一个围绕在它周围的魔法场维持稳定。
湮灭法球会毁灭任何穿过它或被它穿过的事物，只有神器例外：除非某件神器的弱点正是湮灭法球，否则神器均可以不受影响地穿过法球。任何触碰到法球但未被完全吞没或毁灭的东西将受到8d10力场伤害。
控制法球.
湮灭法球总是保持静止，除非受到人控制。如果你位于法球60尺内，你能够以一个魔法动作进行一次DC 25的智力（奥秘）检定。成功则你控制法球直至你的下个回合开始，若法球已处于一名其他生物的控制之下，则该生物失去控制权。失败则法球向你直线移动10尺。
控制法球期间，你能够以一个附赠动作令法球向一个你选择的方向移动一定尺数，具体尺数等于5×你的智力调整值（至少5尺）。法球进入一名生物的占据空间时，该生物必须成功通过一次DC 19的敏捷豁免，否则将触碰到法球，受到8d10力场伤害。因受此伤害而生命值降至0的生物将被毁灭，它携带的财物将留在原地，尸体则灰飞烟灭。
法球碰撞.
如果湮灭法球与位面传送门（如异界之门制造的传送门）或是异位面空间（如次元洞内部）接触，则由DM根据下表随机决定发生的事件：
1d100 | 结果
01-50 | 法球被摧毁了。
51-85 | 法球穿过位面传送门或进入异位面空间
86-00 | 一个空间裂缝出现，将湮灭法球和位于其180尺内的所有生物和物件送到一个随机存在位面。

description.en: While touching this 5-pound stone to the ground, you can take a Magic action to summon an Earth Elemental. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 30 feet of yourself, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action. The stone can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
description.zh: 在你用这块5磅重的石核接触地面期间，你能够以一个魔法动作召唤一只土元素。土元素会出现在你30尺内一处由你选择的未占据空间、理解你所说的语言、服从你的命令、使用你的先攻值并在你之后立即执行其回合。土元素会在1小时后、它死亡时、或你用一个附赠动作将其解消时消失。直到次日黎明前，石核都无法再以该方式进行使用。

roll20Modifiers: Item Type: Wondrous Item, Saving Throws +1, Ability Checks +1

description.en: While this polished agate is on your person, you gain a +1 bonus to ability checks and saving throws.
description.zh: 吉运之石是一块光亮的玛瑙，携带它于身上期间，你在属性检定和豁免检定上获得+1加值。

attunement.en: Requires Attunement by a cleric or paladin
attunement.zh: 需要同调（由牧师或圣武士）

roll20Modifiers: Item Type: Wondrous Item, Spell Attack +2

description.en:
This talisman is a mighty symbol of goodness. A Fiend or an Undead that touches the talisman takes 8d6 Radiant damage and takes the damage again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman.
Holy Symbol.
You can use the talisman as a Holy Symbol. You gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls while you wear or hold it.
Pure Rebuke.
The talisman has 7 charges. While wearing or holding the talisman, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge and target one creature you can see on the ground within 120 feet of yourself. A flaming fissure opens under the target, and the target makes a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. If the target is a Fiend or an Undead, it has Disadvantage on the save. On a failed save, the target falls into the fissure and is destroyed, leaving no remains. On a successful save, the target isn't cast into the fissure but takes 4d6 Psychic damage from the ordeal. In either case, the fissure then closes, leaving no trace of its existence. When you expend the last charge, the talisman disperses into motes of golden light and is destroyed.
description.zh:
这枚护符是良善的象征。触碰护符的亡灵或邪魔生物将受到8d6光耀伤害，每当该生物持握或携带此护符结束其回合时，将再次受到此伤害。
圣徽.
你可以将护符当作圣徽使用。着装或持握护符期间，你进行的法术攻击检定获得+2加值。
至纯审判.
护符具有7充能。着装或持握护符期间，你能够以一个魔法动作，消耗1充能并以一名位于你120尺内的地面上的你可见的生物为目标，使目标脚下张开一道火焰裂隙。目标必须进行一次DC 20的敏捷豁免，若目标是邪魔或亡灵，其进行此豁免具有劣势。豁免失败则目标坠入裂隙，灰飞烟灭；成功则目标不会坠入裂隙，但因审判受到4d6心灵伤害。无论情况如何，裂隙随后将不留痕迹地闭合。充能耗尽时，护符将被摧毁，化为闪耀金光的尘埃。

description.en: While holding or wearing this talisman, you have Advantage on any Intelligence (Arcana) check you make to control a Sphere of Annihilation. In addition, when you start your turn in control of a Sphere of Annihilation, you can take a Magic action to move it 10 feet plus a number of additional feet equal to 10 times your Intelligence modifier. This movement doesn't have to be in a straight line.
description.zh: 持握或着装此护符期间，你为操控湮灭法球而进行的智力（奥秘）检定具有优势。此外，你的回合开始时，若你正在操控湮灭法球，你能够以一个魔法动作将法球移动一定尺数，具体尺数等于10+10×你的智力调整值。以此法移动法球时，其不必以直线进行运动。

roll20Modifiers: Item Type: Wondrous Item, Spell Attack +2

description.en:
This item symbolizes unrepentant evil. A creature that isn't a Fiend or an Undead that touches the talisman takes 8d6 Necrotic damage and takes the damage again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman.
Holy Symbol.
You can use the talisman as a Holy Symbol. You gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls while you wear or hold it.
Ultimate End.
The talisman has 6 charges. While wearing or holding the talisman, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge and target one creature you can see on the ground within 120 feet of yourself. A flaming fissure opens under the target, and the target makes a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. If the target is a Celestial, it has Disadvantage on the save. On a failed save, the target falls into the fissure and is destroyed, leaving no remains. On a successful save, the target isn't cast into the fissure but takes 4d6 Psychic damage from the ordeal. In either case, the fissure then closes, leaving no trace of its existence. When you expend the last charge, the talisman dissolves into foul-smelling slime and is destroyed.
description.zh:
这枚护符是至恶的象征。触碰护符的非亡灵非邪魔生物将受到8d6暗蚀伤害，每当该生物持握或携带此护符结束其回合时，将再次受到此伤害。
圣徽.
你可以将护符当作圣徽使用。着装或持握护符期间，你进行的法术攻击检定获得+2加值。
万物终焉.
护符具有6充能。着装或持握护符期间，你能够以一个魔法动作，消耗1充能并以一名位于你120尺内的地面上的你可见的生物为目标，使目标脚下张开一道火焰裂隙。目标必须进行一次DC 20的敏捷豁免，若目标是天族，其进行此豁免具有劣势。豁免失败则目标坠入裂隙，灰飞烟灭；成功则目标不会坠入裂隙，但因审判受到4d6心灵伤害。无论情况如何，裂隙随后将不留痕迹地闭合。充能耗尽时，护符将被摧毁，化为散发着恶臭的粘液。

description.en: This book contains memory and logic exercises, and its words are charged with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book's contents and practicing its guidelines, your Intelligence increases by 2, to a maximum of 30. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.
description.zh: 这本书记载了训练记忆和逻辑的方法，其文字蕴含魔力。如果你在不长于6日的时间段内花费了48小时研读这本书并实践其中的方针，则你的智力提升2，至多提升至30。之后这本手册将失去魔力，直到一个世纪后才能恢复。

description.en: This book contains guidelines for influencing and charming others, and its words are charged with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book's contents and practicing its guidelines, your Charisma increases by 2, to a maximum of 30. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.
description.zh: 这本书记载了影响和吸引他人的指导，其文字蕴含魔力。如果你在不长于6日的时间段内花费了48小时研读这本书并实践其中的方针，则你的魅力提升2，至多提升至30。之后这本手册将失去魔力，直到一个世纪后才能恢复。

description.en: This book contains intuition and insight exercises, and its words are charged with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book's contents and practicing its guidelines, your Wisdom increases by 2, to a maximum of 30. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.
description.zh: 这本书记载了训练直觉和洞察力的方法，其文字蕴含魔力。如果你在不长于6日的时间段内花费了48小时研读这本书并实践其中的方针，则你的感知提升2，至多提升至30。之后这本手册将失去魔力，直到一个世纪后才能恢复。

description.en:
This tube holds milky liquid with a strong alcohol smell. When found, a tube contains 1d6 + 1 ounces.
You can take a Utilize action to pour 1 or more ounces of solvent from the tube onto a surface within reach. Each ounce instantly dissolves up to 1 square foot of adhesive it touches, including Sovereign Glue.
description.zh:
这管乳白色的液体散发着浓烈的酒精气味。被发现时，管中装有1d6 + 1盎司的万溶剂。
你能够以一个操作动作将管中1盎司或更多的液体倒在触及内的某表面上。每盎司万溶剂将立刻溶解它接触到的至多1尺立方的粘合剂（包括至尊胶sovereign glue）。

description.en:
This fine black cloth, soft as silk, is folded up to the dimensions of a handkerchief. It unfolds into a circular sheet 6 feet in diameter.
You can take a Magic action to unfold the Well of Many Worlds and place it on a solid surface, whereupon it forms a two-way, 6-foot-diameter, circular portal to another world or plane of existence. Each time the item opens a portal, the DM decides where it leads. The portal remains open until a creature within 5 feet of it takes a Magic action to close it by taking hold of the edges of the cloth and folding it up.
Once the Well of Many Worlds has opened a portal, it can't do so again for 1d8 hours.
description.zh:
这块如丝绸般顺滑的精致黑色布料，折叠起来只有手帕大小。布料展开后为直径6尺的圆形盖布。
你能够以一个魔法动作展开诸界之井，将它布置在坚实表面上，产生一扇直径6尺、通向另一个世界或存在位面的圆形双向传送门。每次此物品打开传送门时，由DM决定它所连接的地方。传送门保持开启，直至位于其5尺内的一名生物以一个魔法动作抓住布料的边缘把它折叠起来，来将传送门关闭。
诸界之井一经使用，在1d8小时内都无法再次打开传送门。

description.en: While holding this fan, you can cast Gust of Wind (save DC 13) from it. Each subsequent time the fan is used before the next dawn, it has a cumulative 20% chance of not working; if the fan fails to work, it tears into useless, nonmagical tatters.
description.zh: 持握这把扇子时，你可以用它施展造风术（豁免DC 13）。在次日黎明之前，随后每再次使用这把扇子都会累积20%的几率失效；如果扇子失效，则其会被撕裂成无用的非魔法碎纸。

description.en: These boots have 4 charges and regain 1d4 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the boots, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge, gaining a Fly Speed of 30 feet for 1 hour. If you are flying when the duration expires, you descend at a rate of 30 feet per round until you land.
description.zh: 这双靴子具有4充能，并在每日黎明时恢复1d4已消耗的充能。着装这双靴子期间，你能够以一个魔法动作消耗1充能，获得30尺飞行速度，持续1小时。如果持续时间结束时你正飞行，则你将以每轮30尺的速度下降直至着陆。

description.en: While wearing this cloak, you can take a Magic action to turn the cloak into a pair of wings on your back. The wings lasts for 1 hour or until you end the effect early as a Magic action. The wings give you a Fly Speed of 60 feet. If you are aloft when the wings disappear, you fall. When the wings disappear, you can't use them again for 1d12 hours.
description.zh: 着装这件斗篷期间，你能够以一个魔法动作将斗篷转变为你背上的一对翅膀。这对翅膀会持续1小时，或直至你使用一个魔法动作提前结束效应。这对翅膀会赋予你60尺飞行速度。如果翅膀消失时你仍在空中则你会坠落。翅膀消失后，你在1d12小时内无法再次使用它们。
